116: @@ -464,10 +464,20 @@ Containerlab will configure the `netconf-mgmt` ssh server running over port 830
117:  SR Linux container can run without a license emulating the datacenter types (7220 IXR) :partying_face:.  
118:  In that license-less mode, the datapath is limited to 1000 PPS and the `sr_linux` process will restart once a week.
119:  
120:  The license file lifts these limitations as well as unlocks chassis-based platform variants and a path to it can be provided with [`license`](../nodes.md#license) directive.
121:  
122: +### Reboot
123: +
124: +A reboot issued from within the node, for example with `tools platform chassis reboot`, restarts the SR Linux container. The node comes back with its links, saved configuration and management address intact.
125: +
126: +To support that, SR Linux nodes default to the `unless-stopped` [restart policy](../nodes.md#restart-policy), and containerlab keeps the links and the management address of each node in an internal `<node-name>-netns` container. The internal container is only listed by `containerlab inspect --all`, and it is removed together with the node.
127: +
128: +Use `containerlab stop`, `start` and `restart` to manage the lifecycle of SR Linux nodes instead of restarting the containers with the container runtime directly.
129: +
130: +Nodes with a user-defined [`network-mode`](../nodes.md#network-mode) do not use the internal container.
131: +
132:  ## Container configuration
133:  
134:  To start an SR Linux NOS containerlab uses the configuration that is described in SR Linux Software Installation Guide

140: +++ b/docs/manual/nodes.md
141: @@ -140,11 +140,11 @@ Valid values are:
142:  - `no` - Don't automatically restart the container.
143:  - `on-failure` - Restart the container if it exits due to an error, which manifests as a non-zero exit code. The on-failure policy only prompts a restart if the container exits with a failure. It doesn't restart the container if the daemon restarts.
144:  - `always` - Always restart the container if it stops. If it's manually stopped, it's restarted only when Docker daemon restarts or the container itself is manually restarted.
145:  - `unless-stopped` Similar to always, except that when the container is stopped (manually or otherwise), it isn't restarted even after Docker daemon restarts.
146:  
147: -`no` is the default restart policy value for all kinds, but `linux`. Linux kind defaults to `always`.

159: @@ -0,0 +1,52 @@
160: +package nodes
161: +
162: +import (
163: +	"context"
164: +	"fmt"
165: +
166: +	clabruntime "github.com/srl-labs/containerlab/runtime"
167: +	clabtypes "github.com/srl-labs/containerlab/types"
168: +)
169: +
170: +// NetnsHolder is an internal container that owns the network namespace of a node. The node's
171: +// containers join it, so the links and the management address outlive their restarts.
172: +type NetnsHolder struct {
173: +	DefaultNode
174: +}
175: +
176: +func (n *NetnsHolder) Init(cfg *clabtypes.NodeConfig, opts ...NodeOption) error {
177: +	n.DefaultNode = *NewDefaultNode(n)
178: +	n.Cfg = cfg
179: +	n.StopSignal = clabtypes.SIGTERM
180: +
181: +	for _, o := range opts {
182: +		o(n)
183: +	}
184: +
185: +	return nil
186: +}
187: +
188: +// EnsureRunning starts or unpauses the holder, so that the containers of node can join it.
189: +func (n *NetnsHolder) EnsureRunning(ctx context.Context, node string) error {
190: +	switch status := n.GetContainerStatus(ctx); status {
191: +	case clabruntime.Running:
192: +	case clabruntime.Created, clabruntime.Stopped:
193: +		if err := n.Start(ctx); err != nil {
194: +			return fmt.Errorf("node %q network namespace container start error: %w", node, err)
195: +		}
196: +	case clabruntime.Paused:
197: +		if err := n.Runtime.UnpauseContainer(ctx, n.Cfg.LongName); err != nil {
198: +			return fmt.Errorf("node %q network namespace container unpause error: %w", node, err)
199: +		}
200: +	case clabruntime.NotFound:
201: +		return fmt.Errorf(
202: +			"node %q network namespace container %q not found; recreate the node",
203: +			node, n.Cfg.LongName,
204: +		)
205: +	default:
206: +		return fmt.Errorf("node %q network namespace container %q is %s",
207: +			node, n.Cfg.LongName, status)
208: +	}
209: +
210: +	return nil
211: +}

295: +		MgmtIPv4Gateway:       n.Cfg.MgmtIPv4Gateway,

297: +		MacAddress:            n.Cfg.MacAddress,

306: +
307: +// containerConfig returns the config of the SR Linux container attached to the holder's
308: +// network namespace. The runtime rejects network settings for such containers, as they
309: +// belong to the holder.
310: +func (n *srl) containerConfig() *clabtypes.NodeConfig {
311: +	cfg := *n.Cfg
312: +	cfg.NetworkMode = "container:" + n.netnsNode.GetShortName()
313: +	cfg.DNS = nil
314: +	cfg.ExtraHosts = nil
315: +	cfg.MacAddress = ""
316: +	cfg.PortBindings = nil
317: +	cfg.PortSet = nil
318: +
319: +	return &cfg
320: +}
321: +
322: +// linkNetns points the node's netns symlink to the holder, as the namespace path of the
323: +// SR Linux container changes whenever the container restarts.
324: +func (n *srl) linkNetns(ctx context.Context) error {
325: +	nsPath, err := n.netnsNode.GetNSPath(ctx)
326: +	if err != nil {
327: +		return err
328: +	}
329: +
330: +	return clabutils.LinkContainerNS(nsPath, n.Cfg.LongName)
331: +}
332: +
333: +// GetNSPath retrieves the Namespace Path.
334: +func (n *srl) GetNSPath(ctx context.Context) (string, error) {
335: +	if n.netnsNode == nil {
336: +		return n.DefaultNode.GetNSPath(ctx)
337: +	}
338: +
339: +	return n.netnsNode.GetNSPath(ctx)
340: +}
341: +
342: +// DeleteNetnsSymlink deletes the symlink file created for the container netns.
343: +func (n *srl) DeleteNetnsSymlink() error {
344: +	if n.netnsNode == nil {
345: +		return n.DefaultNode.DeleteNetnsSymlink()
346: +	}
347: +
348: +	return errors.Join(n.DefaultNode.DeleteNetnsSymlink(), n.netnsNode.DeleteNetnsSymlink())
349: +}

662: +func (n *srl) Deploy(ctx context.Context, params *clabnodes.DeployParams) error {
663: +	if n.netnsNode == nil {
664: +		return n.DefaultNode.Deploy(ctx, params)
665: +	}
666: +
667: +	// network settings are finalized after Init, so the holder config is rebuilt here.
668: +	*n.netnsNode.Config() = *n.newNetnsConfig()
669: +	if err := n.netnsNode.Deploy(ctx, params); err != nil {
670: +		return fmt.Errorf("deploy network namespace node %q: %w", n.netnsNode.GetShortName(), err)
671: +	}
672: +
673: +	n.Cfg.Env[clabconstants.ClabEnvIntfs] = strconv.Itoa(len(n.GetEndpoints()))
674: +
675: +	cID, err := n.Runtime.CreateContainer(ctx, n.containerConfig())
676: +	if err != nil {
677: +		return err
678: +	}
679: +
680: +	if _, err := n.Runtime.StartContainer(ctx, cID, n); err != nil {
681: +		return err
682: +	}
683: +
684: +	if err := n.linkNetns(ctx); err != nil {
685: +		return err
686: +	}
687: +
688: +	n.SetState(clabnodesstate.Deployed)
689: +
690: +	return nil
691: +}

693: +func (n *srl) Start(ctx context.Context) error {
694: +	if n.netnsNode == nil {
695: +		return n.DefaultNode.Start(ctx)
696: +	}
697: +
698: +	if err := n.netnsNode.EnsureRunning(ctx, n.Cfg.ShortName); err != nil {
699: +		return err
700: +	}
701: +
702: +	if err := n.DefaultNode.Start(ctx); err != nil {
703: +		return err
704: +	}
705: +
706: +	return n.linkNetns(ctx)
707: +}
708: +
709: +// Stop also stops the holder, so that the next start gets a fresh network namespace without
710: +// interfaces left behind by the stopped SR Linux container.
711: +func (n *srl) Stop(ctx context.Context) error {
712: +	if err := n.DefaultNode.Stop(ctx); err != nil || n.netnsNode == nil {
713: +		return err
714: +	}
715: +
716: +	if n.netnsNode.GetContainerStatus(ctx) != clabruntime.Running {
717: +		return nil
718: +	}
719: +
720: +	return n.Runtime.StopContainer(ctx, n.netnsNode.Config().LongName, n.netnsNode.StopSignal)
721: +}
722: +
723: +func (n *srl) Delete(ctx context.Context) error {
724: +	if n.netnsNode == nil {
725: +		return n.DefaultNode.Delete(ctx)
726: +	}
727: +
728: +	return errors.Join(n.DefaultNode.Delete(ctx), n.netnsNode.Delete(ctx))
729: +}

731: +// GetContainers returns the SR Linux container with the network settings of the holder.
732: +// When only the holder exists, it is returned so that it is not orphaned on destroy.
733: +func (n *srl) GetContainers(ctx context.Context) ([]clabruntime.GenericContainer, error) {
734: +	cnts, err := n.DefaultNode.GetContainers(ctx)
735: +	if n.netnsNode == nil {
736: +		return cnts, err
737: +	}
738: +
739: +	if err != nil {
740: +		if errors.Is(err, clabnodes.ErrContainersNotFound) {
741: +			return n.netnsNode.GetContainers(ctx)
742: +		}
743: +
744: +		return nil, err
745: +	}
746: +
747: +	holder, err := n.netnsNode.GetContainers(ctx)
748: +	if err != nil {
749: +		if errors.Is(err, clabnodes.ErrContainersNotFound) {
750: +			return cnts, nil
751: +		}
752: +
753: +		return nil, err
754: +	}
755: +
756: +	cnts[0].NetworkName = holder[0].NetworkName
757: +	cnts[0].NetworkSettings = holder[0].NetworkSettings
758: +	cnts[0].Ports = holder[0].Ports
759: +
760: +	return cnts, nil
761: +}

The on-failure policy only prompts a restart if the container exits with a failure. It doesn't restart the container if the daemon restarts.\n - `always` - Always restart the container if it stops. If it's manually stopped, it's restarted only when Docker daemon restarts or the container itself is manually restarted.\n - `unless-stopped` Similar to always, except that when the container is stopped (manually or otherwise), it isn't restarted even after Docker daemon restarts.\n \n-`no` is the default restart policy value for all kinds, but `linux`. 1: ---
2: description: Behavioral guidelines to reduce common LLM coding mistakes. Use when writing, reviewing, or refactoring code to avoid overcomplication, make surgical changes, surface assumptions, and define verifiable success criteria.
3: alwaysApply: true
4: ---
5: 
6: # Karpathy behavioral guidelines
7: 
8: Behavioral guidelines to reduce common LLM coding mistakes. Merge with project-specific instructions as needed.
9: 
10: **Tradeoff:** These guidelines bias toward caution over speed. For trivial tasks, use judgment.
11: 
12: ## 1. Think Before Coding
13: 
14: **Don't assume. Don't hide confusion. Surface tradeoffs.**
15: 
16: Before implementing:
17: 
18: - State your assumptions explicitly. If uncertain, ask.
19: - If multiple interpretations exist, present them - don't pick silently.
20: - If a simpler approach exists, say so. Push back when warranted.
21: - If something is unclear, stop. Name what's confusing. Ask.
22: 
23: ## 2. Simplicity First
24: 
25: **Minimum code that solves the problem. Nothing speculative.**
26: 
27: - No features beyond what was asked.
28: - No abstractions for single-use code.
29: - No "flexibility" or "configurability" that wasn't requested.
30: - No error handling for impossible scenarios.
31: - If you write 200 lines and it could be 50, rewrite it.
32: 
33: Ask yourself: "Would a senior engineer say this is overcomplicated?" If yes, simplify.
34: 
35: ## 3. Surgical Changes
36: 
37: **Touch only what you must. Clean up only your own mess.**
38: 
39: When editing existing code:
40: 
41: - Don't "improve" adjacent code, comments, or formatting.
42: - Don't refactor things that aren't broken.
43: - Match existing style, even if you'd do it differently.
44: - If you notice unrelated dead code, mention it - don't delete it.
45: 
46: When your changes create orphans:
47: 
48: - Remove imports/variables/functions that YOUR changes made unused.
49: - Don't remove pre-existing dead code unless asked.
50: 
51: The test: Every changed line should trace directly to the user's request.
52: 
53: ## 4. Goal-Driven Execution
54: 
55: **Define success criteria. Loop until verified.**
56: 
57: Transform tasks into verifiable goals:
58: 
59: - "Add validation" → "Write tests for invalid inputs, then make them pass"
60: - "Fix the bug" → "Write a test that reproduces it, then make it pass"
61: - "Refactor X" → "Ensure tests pass before and after"
62: 
63: For multi-step tasks, state a brief plan:
64: 
65: ```
66: 1. [Step] → verify: [check]
67: 2. [Step] → verify: [check]
68: 3. [Step] → verify: [check]
69: ```
70: 
71: Strong success criteria let you loop independently. Weak criteria ("make it work") require constant clarification.
72: 
73: ---
74: 
75: **These guidelines are working if:** fewer unnecessary changes in diffs, fewer rewrites due to overcomplication, and clarifying questions come before implementation rather than after mistakes.

(End of file - total 75 lines)
</content>

1: ---
2: description: Ponytail, lazy senior dev mode. Always pick the simplest solution that works.
3: globs:
4: alwaysApply: true
5: ---
6: 
7: # Ponytail, lazy senior dev mode
8: 
9: You are a lazy senior developer. Lazy means efficient, not careless. The best code is the code never written.
10: 
11: Before writing any code, stop at the first rung that holds:
12: 
13: 1. Does this need to be built at all? (YAGNI)
14: 2. Does it already exist in this codebase? Reuse the helper, util, or pattern that's already here, don't re-write it.
15: 3. Does the standard library already do this? Use it.
16: 4. Does a native platform feature cover it? Use it.
17: 5. Does an already-installed dependency solve it? Use it.
18: 6. Can this be one line? Make it one line.
19: 7. Only then: write the minimum code that works.
20: 
21: The ladder runs after you understand the problem, not instead of it: read the task and the code it touches, trace the real flow end to end, then climb.
22: 
23: Bug fix = root cause, not symptom: a report names a symptom. Grep every caller of the function you touch and fix the shared function once — one guard there is a smaller diff than one per caller, and patching only the path the ticket names leaves a sibling caller still broken.
24: 
25: Rules:
26: 
27: - No abstractions that weren't explicitly requested.
28: - No new dependency if it can be avoided.
29: - No boilerplate nobody asked for.
30: - Deletion over addition. Boring over clever. Fewest files possible.
31: - Shortest working diff wins, but only once you understand the problem. The smallest change in the wrong place isn't lazy, it's a second bug.
32: - Question complex requests: "Do you actually need X, or does Y cover it?"
33: - Pick the edge-case-correct option when two stdlib approaches are the same size, lazy means less code, not the flimsier algorithm.
34: - Mark deliberate simplifications that cut a real corner with a known ceiling (global lock, O(n²) scan, naive heuristic) with a `ponytail:` comment naming the ceiling and upgrade path.
35: 
36: Not lazy about: understanding the problem (read it fully and trace the real flow before picking a rung, a small diff you don't understand is just laziness dressed up as efficiency), input validation at trust boundaries, error handling that prevents data loss, security, accessibility, the calibration real hardware needs (the platform is never the spec ideal, a clock drifts, a sensor reads off), anything explicitly requested. Lazy code without its check is unfinished: non-trivial logic leaves ONE runnable check behind, the smallest thing that fails if the logic breaks (an assert-based demo/self-check or one small test file; no frameworks, no fixtures). Trivial one-liners need no test.

(End of file - total 36 lines)
</content>

1: package nodes
2: 
3: import (
4: 	"context"
5: 	"fmt"
6: 
7: 	clabruntime "github.com/srl-labs/containerlab/runtime"
8: 	clabtypes "github.com/srl-labs/containerlab/types"
9: )
10: 
11: // NetnsHolder is an internal container that owns the network namespace of a node. The node's
12: // containers join it, so the links and the management address outlive their restarts.
13: type NetnsHolder struct {
14: 	DefaultNode
15: }
16: 
17: func (n *NetnsHolder) Init(cfg *clabtypes.NodeConfig, opts ...NodeOption) error {
18: 	n.DefaultNode = *NewDefaultNode(n)
19: 	n.Cfg = cfg
20: 	n.StopSignal = clabtypes.SIGTERM
21: 
22: 	for _, o := range opts {
23: 		o(n)
24: 	}
25: 
26: 	return nil
27: }
28: 
29: // EnsureRunning starts or unpauses the holder, so that the containers of node can join it.
30: func (n *NetnsHolder) EnsureRunning(ctx context.Context, node string) error {
31: 	switch status := n.GetContainerStatus(ctx); status {
32: 	case clabruntime.Running:
33: 	case clabruntime.Created, clabruntime.Stopped:
34: 		if err := n.Start(ctx); err != nil {
35: 			return fmt.Errorf("node %q network namespace container start error: %w", node, err)
36: 		}
37: 	case clabruntime.Paused:
38: 		if err := n.Runtime.UnpauseContainer(ctx, n.Cfg.LongName); err != nil {
39: 			return fmt.Errorf("node %q network namespace container unpause error: %w", node, err)
40: 		}
41: 	case clabruntime.NotFound:
42: 		return fmt.Errorf(
43: 			"node %q network namespace container %q not found; recreate the node",
44: 			node, n.Cfg.LongName,
45: 		)
46: 	default:
47: 		return fmt.Errorf("node %q network namespace container %q is %s",
48: 			node, n.Cfg.LongName, status)
49: 	}
50: 
51: 	return nil
52: }

(End of file - total 52 lines)
</content>

14: const netnsNodeType = "srl-netns"
15: 
16: // usesNetnsNode reports whether the node runs in the network namespace of a holder container.
17: // Nodes with a user-defined network mode keep the network namespace of their own container.
18: func (n *srl) usesNetnsNode() bool {
19: 	return n.Cfg.NetworkMode == "" && !n.Cfg.IsRootNamespaceBased
20: }
21: 
22: func (n *srl) initNetnsNode() error {
23: 	if !n.usesNetnsNode() {
24: 		return nil
25: 	}
26: 
27: 	n.netnsNode = new(clabnodes.NetnsHolder)
28: 
29: 	return n.netnsNode.Init(n.newNetnsConfig(), clabnodes.WithRuntime(n.GetRuntime()))
30: }
31: 
32: func (n *srl) newNetnsConfig() *clabtypes.NodeConfig {
33: 	labels := maps.Clone(n.Cfg.Labels)
34: 
35: 	if labels == nil {
36: 		labels = map[string]string{}
37: 	}
38: 
39: 	shortName := n.Cfg.ShortName + "-netns"
40: 	labels[clabconstants.NodeName] = shortName
41: 
42: 	longName := n.Cfg.LongName + "-netns"
43: 	labels[clabconstants.LongName] = longName
44: 
45: 	labels[clabconstants.NodeType] = netnsNodeType
46: 	labels[clabconstants.InternalNode] = "true"
47: 
48: 	labels[clabconstants.RootNodeName] = n.Cfg.ShortName
49: 	labels[clabconstants.RootNodeLongName] = n.Cfg.LongName
50: 
51: 	return &clabtypes.NodeConfig{
52: 		ShortName:             shortName,
53: 		LongName:              longName,
54: 		Hostname:              n.Cfg.GetHostname(),
55: 		Fqdn:                  n.Cfg.Fqdn,
56: 		LabDir:                n.Cfg.LabDir,
57: 		Index:                 n.Cfg.Index,
58: 		Kind:                  n.Cfg.Kind,
59: 		NodeType:              netnsNodeType,
60: 		Image:                 n.Cfg.Image,

62: 		RestartPolicy:         n.Cfg.RestartPolicy,
63: 		Sysctls:               maps.Clone(n.Cfg.Sysctls),
64: 		User:                  "0:0",
65: 		Entrypoint:            "/bin/sh",
66: 		Cmd:                   `-c "trap 'exit 0' TERM INT; sleep infinity & wait $!"`,

90: // containerConfig returns the config of the SR Linux container attached to the holder's
91: // network namespace. The runtime rejects network settings for such containers, as they
92: // belong to the holder.
93: func (n *srl) containerConfig() *clabtypes.NodeConfig {
94: 	cfg := *n.Cfg
95: 	cfg.NetworkMode = "container:" + n.netnsNode.GetShortName()
96: 	cfg.DNS = nil
97: 	cfg.ExtraHosts = nil
98: 	cfg.MacAddress = ""
99: 	cfg.PortBindings = nil
100: 	cfg.PortSet = nil
101: 
102: 	return &cfg
103: }
104: 
105: // linkNetns points the node's netns symlink to the holder, as the namespace path of the
106: // SR Linux container changes whenever the container restarts.
107: func (n *srl) linkNetns(ctx context.Context) error {
108: 	nsPath, err := n.netnsNode.GetNSPath(ctx)
109: 	if err != nil {
110: 		return err
111: 	}
112: 
113: 	return clabutils.LinkContainerNS(nsPath, n.Cfg.LongName)
114: }
115: 
116: // GetNSPath retrieves the Namespace Path.
117: func (n *srl) GetNSPath(ctx context.Context) (string, error) {
118: 	if n.netnsNode == nil {
119: 		return n.DefaultNode.GetNSPath(ctx)
120: 	}
121: 
122: 	return n.netnsNode.GetNSPath(ctx)
123: }
124: 
125: // DeleteNetnsSymlink deletes the symlink file created for the container netns.
126: func (n *srl) DeleteNetnsSymlink() error {
127: 	if n.netnsNode == nil {
128: 		return n.DefaultNode.DeleteNetnsSymlink()
129: 	}
130: 
131: 	return errors.Join(n.DefaultNode.DeleteNetnsSymlink(), n.netnsNode.DeleteNetnsSymlink())
132: }

116: 		"ixr10":      "7250IXR10.yml",
117: 		"ixr-10":     "7250IXR10.yml",
118: 		"ixr10e":     "7250IXR10e-gen2cp-qsfpdd.yml",

123: 		"ixr-6e-gen2cp-qsfpdd":  "7250IXR6e-gen2cp-qsfpdd.yml",

129: 		"ixr-10e-gen2cp-qsfp28": "7250IXR10e-gen2cp-qsfp28.yml",
130: 		"ixr-10e-gen2cp-sync":   "7250IXR10e-gen2cp-sync.yml",
131: 		"ixr-10e-gen3-qsfpdd":   "7250IXR10e-gen3-qsfpdd.yml",
132: 		"ixr-10e-gen3-osfp":     "7250IXR10e-gen3-osfp.yml",
133: 		"ixr-18e-qsfpdd":        "7250IXR18e-qsfpdd.yml",
134: 		"ixr-18e-gen3-sync":     "7250IXR18e-gen3-sync.yml",

136: 		"sxr1x44s":              "7730SXR-1x-44s.yml",
137: 		"sxr-1x-44s":            "7730SXR-1x-44s.yml",
138: 		"sxr1d32d":              "7730SXR-1d-32d.yml",
139: 		"sxr-1d-32d":            "7730SXR-1d-32d.yml",
140: 		"sxr-1-32d":             "7730SXR-1-32d.yml",
141: 		"ixrx1b":                "7250IXRX1b.yml",
142: 		"ixr-x1b":               "7250IXRX1b.yml",
143: 		"ixrx3b":                "7250IXRX3b.yml",

149: 	srlEnv = map[string]string{"SRLINUX": "1"}
150: 
151: 	//go:embed topology/*
152: 	topologies embed.FS
153: 
154: 	saveCmd          = `/opt/srlinux/bin/sr_cli -d "tools system configuration save"`
155: 	mgmtServerRdyCmd = `/opt/srlinux/bin/sr_cli -d ` +
156: 		`"info from state system app-management application mgmt_server state | grep running"`
157: 	// readyForConfigCmd checks the output of a file on srlinux which will be populated once the
158: 	// mgmt server is ready to accept config.
159: 	readyForConfigCmd = "cat /etc/opt/srlinux/devices/app_ephemeral.mgmt_server.ready_for_config"

161: 	srlCfgTpl, _ = template.New("clab-srl-default-config").Funcs(clabutils.CreateFuncs()).
162: 			Parse(srlConfigCmdsTpl)

170: 	InterfaceRegexp = regexp.MustCompile(
171: 		`ethernet-(?P<linecard>\d+)/(?P<port>\d+)(?:/(?P<channel>\d+))?`,
172: 	)
173: 	// normalizedInterfaceRegexp validates names after AddEndpoint maps interface aliases.
174: 	normalizedInterfaceRegexp = regexp.MustCompile(
175: 		`^(?:e[1-9]\d*-[1-9]\d*(?:-[1-9]\d*)?|` + mgmt0InterfaceName + `)$`,

177: 	InterfaceHelp = "ethernet-L/P, ethernet-L/P/C or eL-P, eL-P-C (where L, P, C >= 1)"

180: // Register registers the node in the NodeRegistry.
181: func Register(r *clabnodes.NodeRegistry) {
182: 	generateNodeAttributes := clabnodes.NewGenerateNodeAttributes(generateable, generateIfFormat)
183: 	platformOpts := &clabnodes.PlatformAttrs{
184: 		ScrapliPlatformName: scrapliPlatformName,
185: 	}
186: 
187: 	nrea := clabnodes.NewNodeRegistryEntryAttributes(
188: 		defaultCredentials,
189: 		generateNodeAttributes,
190: 		platformOpts,
191: 	).WithKindSpecificConfig(kindSpecificConfig)
192: 
193: 	r.Register(kindNames, func() clabnodes.Node {
194: 		return new(srl)
195: 	}, nrea)
196: }

198: // KindSpecificConfig is the nokia_srlinux kind-specific config, set as keys on the node definition.
199: type KindSpecificConfig struct {
200: 	// Components are the line cards of a modular chassis.
201: 	Components []*Component `json:"components,omitempty" yaml:"components,omitempty"`
202: 	// CustomPrompt sets the containerlab CLI prompt. Defaults to true.
203: 	CustomPrompt bool `json:"custom-prompt" yaml:"custom-prompt"`
204: 	// EDADefaultGRPCServer adds the EDA TLS profile to the default mgmt gRPC server instead of
205: 	// adding a dedicated eda-mgmt gRPC server.
206: 	EDADefaultGRPCServer bool `json:"eda-default-grpc-server,omitempty" yaml:"eda-default-grpc-server,omitempty"` //nolint:lll
207: }
208: 
209: // SetDefaults implements clabnodes.KindSpecificConfigDefaulter.
210: func (c *KindSpecificConfig) SetDefaults() {
211: 	c.CustomPrompt = true
212: }
213: 
214: // Component is an SR Linux line card.
215: type Component struct {
216: 	Slot string `json:"slot,omitempty" yaml:"slot,omitempty"`
217: 	Type string `json:"type,omitempty" yaml:"type,omitempty"`
218: }
219: 
220: var kindSpecificConfig clabnodes.KindSpecificConfigSpec[KindSpecificConfig]
221: 
222: type srl struct {
223: 	clabnodes.DefaultNode
224: 	// startup-config passed as a path to a file with CLI instructions will be read into this byte
225: 	// slice
226: 	startupCliCfg []byte
227: 
228: 	// Params provided in Pre-Deploy, that srl uses in Post-Deploy phase
229: 	// to generate certificates
230: 	cert         *clabcert.Cert
231: 	topologyName string
232: 	// SSH public keys extracted from the clab host
233: 	sshPubKeys []ssh.PublicKey
234: 	// software version SR Linux node runs
235: 	swVersion *SrlVersion
236: 	// indicates if the node supports OpenConfig server
237: 	supportsOpenconfig bool
238: 	// holder of the node's network namespace
239: 	netnsNode *clabnodes.NetnsHolder
240: }

242: func (*srl) LinkApplyMode(context.Context) clabnodes.LinkApplyMode {
243: 	return clabnodes.LinkApplyModeLive
244: }

246: func (n *srl) kindSpecificCfg() *KindSpecificConfig { return kindSpecificConfig.Of(n.Cfg) }
247: 
248: func (n *srl) Init(cfg *clabtypes.NodeConfig, opts ...clabnodes.NodeOption) error {
249: 	// Init DefaultNode
250: 	n.DefaultNode = *clabnodes.NewDefaultNode(n)
251: 	// set virtualization requirement
252: 	n.HostRequirements.SSSE3 = true
253: 	n.HostRequirements.MinVCPU = 2
254: 	n.HostRequirements.MinVCPUFailAction = clabtypes.FailBehaviourError
255: 	n.HostRequirements.MinAvailMemoryGb = 2
256: 	n.HostRequirements.MinAvailMemoryGbFailAction = clabtypes.FailBehaviourLog
257: 
258: 	n.Cfg = cfg
259: 
260: 	// force cert creation for srlinux nodes as they by make use of tls certificate in the default
261: 	// config
262: 	n.Cfg.Certificate.Issue = new(true)
263: 
264: 	for _, o := range opts {
265: 		o(n)
266: 	}
267: 
268: 	if n.Cfg.NodeType != "" && !strings.Contains(n.Cfg.NodeType, "-") {
269: 		log.Warn(
270: 			"Deprecation notice",
271: 			"notice",
272: 			"You are using a deprecated SR Linux node type name. "+
273: 				"Consider using a new format with dashes. Example: ixr-d2l, ixr-h5-64d, etc.\n"+
274: 				"Deprecated type format will be removed after January 2026",
275: 			"deprecated type",
276: 			n.Cfg.NodeType,
277: 		)
278: 	}
279: 
280: 	if n.Cfg.NodeType == "" {
281: 		n.Cfg.NodeType = SRLinuxDefaultType
282: 	}
283: 
284: 	if _, found := srlTypes[n.Cfg.NodeType]; !found {
285: 		keys := make([]string, 0, len(srlTypes))
286: 		for key := range srlTypes {
287: 			keys = append(keys, key)
288: 		}
289: 
290: 		return fmt.Errorf("wrong node type. '%s' doesn't exist. should be any of %s",
291: 			n.Cfg.NodeType, strings.Join(keys, ", "))
292: 	}
293: 
294: 	// fail on an unusable components block here rather than midway through the deploy
295: 	if _, err := resolveSRLTopology(n.Cfg); err != nil {
296: 		return err
297: 	}
298: 
299: 	if len(n.kindSpecificCfg().Components) > 1 {
300: 		log.Warn("Multiple line cards are rendered into the SR Linux topology file, but "+
301: 			"deploying a node with more than one line card is not supported yet",
302: 			"node", n.Cfg.ShortName, "line cards", len(n.kindSpecificCfg().Components))
303: 	}
304: 
305: 	if n.Cfg.Cmd == "" {
306: 		// set default Cmd if it was not provided by a user
307: 		// the additional touch is needed to support non docker runtimes
308: 		n.Cfg.Cmd = "sudo -E bash -c 'touch /.dockerenv && /opt/srlinux/bin/sr_linux'"
309: 	}
310: 
311: 	n.Cfg.Env = clabutils.MergeStringMaps(srlEnv, n.Cfg.Env)
312: 
313: 	// if user was not initialized to a value, use root
314: 	if n.Cfg.User == "" {
315: 		n.Cfg.User = "0:0"
316: 	}
317: 
318: 	// restart the node when it is rebooted from within.
319: 	// unless-stopped is used, as some images exit with code 0 on reboot;
320: 	// on-failure is enough once all supported images exit with a non-zero code.
321: 	if n.Cfg.RestartPolicy == "" {
322: 		n.Cfg.RestartPolicy = "unless-stopped"
323: 	}
324: 
325: 	maps.Copy(n.Cfg.Sysctls, srlSysctl)
326: 
327: 	if n.Cfg.License != "" {
328: 		// we mount a fixed path node.Labdir/license.key as the license referenced in topo file will
329: 		// be copied to that path
330: 		n.Cfg.Binds = append(n.Cfg.Binds, fmt.Sprint(
331: 			filepath.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, "license.key"), ":/opt/srlinux/etc/license.key:ro"))
332: 	}
333: 
334: 	// mount config directory
335: 	cfgPath := filepath.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, "config")
336: 	n.Cfg.Binds = append(n.Cfg.Binds, fmt.Sprint(cfgPath, ":/etc/opt/srlinux/:rw"))
337: 
338: 	// mount srlinux topology
339: 	srcTopoPath := filepath.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, "topology.yml")
340: 	dstTopoPath := "/tmp/topology.yml"
341: 	// if a user provided a topology file, it means that they want to use a custom srl topology file
342: 	// in that case we do not need to mount the one for the provided type
343: 	if !clabutils.DestinationBindMountExists(n.Cfg.Binds, dstTopoPath) {
344: 		n.Cfg.Binds = append(n.Cfg.Binds, fmt.Sprint(srcTopoPath, ":", dstTopoPath, ":ro"))
345: 	}
346: 
347: 	// mounting /run/netnns as tmpfs ensures the network-instances
348: 	// namespaces don't persist through stop/start/restarts.
349: 	if n.Cfg.Tmpfs == nil {
350: 		n.Cfg.Tmpfs = map[string]string{}
351: 	}
352: 
353: 	n.Cfg.Tmpfs["/run/netns"] = "rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec"
354: 
355: 	n.InterfaceRegexp = InterfaceRegexp
356: 	n.InterfaceHelp = InterfaceHelp
357: 
358: 	return n.initNetnsNode()
359: }
360: 
361: func (n *srl) PreDeploy(ctx context.Context, params *clabnodes.PreDeployParams) error {
362: 	clabutils.CreateDirectory(n.Cfg.LabDir, clabconstants.PermissionsOpen)
363: 
364: 	// store provided pubkeys
365: 	n.sshPubKeys = params.SSHPubKeys
366: 
367: 	// store the certificate-related parameters
368: 	// for cert generation to happen in Post-Deploy phase with mgmt IPs as SANs
369: 	n.cert = params.Cert
370: 	n.topologyName = params.TopologyName
371: 
372: 	// platform specific pre-deploy actions
373: 	// modular chassis boot in the mode required by the line card generation they are populated
374: 	// with, unless the user pinned the mode explicitly.
375: 	if n.Config().Env["SRL_CHASSIS_MODE"] == "" {
376: 		topology, err := resolveSRLTopology(n.Cfg)
377: 		if err != nil {
378: 			return err
379: 		}
380: 
381: 		if topology.ChassisMode != "" {
382: 			n.Config().Env["SRL_CHASSIS_MODE"] = topology.ChassisMode
383: 		}
384: 	}
385: 
386: 	return n.createSRLFiles()
387: }
388: 
389: func (n *srl) Deploy(ctx context.Context, params *clabnodes.DeployParams) error {
390: 	if n.netnsNode == nil {
391: 		return n.DefaultNode.Deploy(ctx, params)
392: 	}
393: 
394: 	// network settings are finalized after Init, so the holder config is rebuilt here.
395: 	*n.netnsNode.Config() = *n.newNetnsConfig()
396: 	if err := n.netnsNode.Deploy(ctx, params); err != nil {
397: 		return fmt.Errorf("deploy network namespace node %q: %w", n.netnsNode.GetShortName(), err)
398: 	}
399: 
400: 	n.Cfg.Env[clabconstants.ClabEnvIntfs] = strconv.Itoa(len(n.GetEndpoints()))
401: 
402: 	cID, err := n.Runtime.CreateContainer(ctx, n.containerConfig())
403: 	if err != nil {
404: 		return err
405: 	}
406: 
407: 	if _, err := n.Runtime.StartContainer(ctx, cID, n); err != nil {
408: 		return err
409: 	}
410: 
411: 	if err := n.linkNetns(ctx); err != nil {
412: 		return err
413: 	}
414: 
415: 	n.SetState(clabnodesstate.Deployed)
416: 
417: 	return nil
418: }
419: 
420: func (n *srl) Start(ctx context.Context) error {
421: 	if n.netnsNode == nil {
422: 		return n.DefaultNode.Start(ctx)
423: 	}
424: 
425: 	if err := n.netnsNode.EnsureRunning(ctx, n.Cfg.ShortName); err != nil {
426: 		return err
427: 	}
428: 
429: 	if err := n.DefaultNode.Start(ctx); err != nil {
430: 		return err
431: 	}
432: 
433: 	return n.linkNetns(ctx)
434: }
435: 
436: // Stop also stops the holder, so that the next start gets a fresh network namespace without
437: // interfaces left behind by the stopped SR Linux container.
438: func (n *srl) Stop(ctx context.Context) error {
439: 	if err := n.DefaultNode.Stop(ctx); err != nil || n.netnsNode == nil {
440: 		return err
441: 	}
442: 
443: 	if n.netnsNode.GetContainerStatus(ctx) != clabruntime.Running {
444: 		return nil
445: 	}
446: 
447: 	return n.Runtime.StopContainer(ctx, n.netnsNode.Config().LongName, n.netnsNode.StopSignal)
448: }
449: 
450: func (n *srl) Delete(ctx context.Context) error {
451: 	if n.netnsNode == nil {
452: 		return n.DefaultNode.Delete(ctx)
453: 	}
454: 
455: 	return errors.Join(n.DefaultNode.Delete(ctx), n.netnsNode.Delete(ctx))
456: }
457: 
458: // GetContainers returns the SR Linux container with the network settings of the holder.
459: // When only the holder exists, it is returned so that it is not orphaned on destroy.
460: func (n *srl) GetContainers(ctx context.Context) ([]clabruntime.GenericContainer, error) {
461: 	cnts, err := n.DefaultNode.GetContainers(ctx)
462: 	if n.netnsNode == nil {
463: 		return cnts, err
464: 	}
465: 
466: 	if err != nil {
467: 		if errors.Is(err, clabnodes.ErrContainersNotFound) {
468: 			return n.netnsNode.GetContainers(ctx)
469: 		}
470: 
471: 		return nil, err
472: 	}
473: 
474: 	holder, err := n.netnsNode.GetContainers(ctx)
475: 	if err != nil {
476: 		if errors.Is(err, clabnodes.ErrContainersNotFound) {
477: 			return cnts, nil
478: 		}
479: 
480: 		return nil, err
481: 	}
482: 
483: 	cnts[0].NetworkName = holder[0].NetworkName
484: 	cnts[0].NetworkSettings = holder[0].NetworkSettings
485: 	cnts[0].Ports = holder[0].Ports
486: 
487: 	return cnts, nil
488: }
489: 
490: func (n *srl) PostDeploy(ctx context.Context, params *clabnodes.PostDeployParams) error {
491: 	log.Info("Running postdeploy actions",
492: 		"kind", n.Cfg.Kind,
493: 		"node", n.Cfg.ShortName)
494: 
495: 	// generate the certificate
496: 	certificate, err := n.LoadOrGenerateCertificate(n.cert, n.topologyName)
497: 	if err != nil {
498: 		return err
499: 	}
500: 
501: 	// set the certificate data
502: 	n.Config().TLSCert = string(certificate.Cert)
503: 	n.Config().TLSKey = string(certificate.Key)
504: 
505: 	// Populate /etc/hosts for service discovery on mgmt interface
506: 	if err := n.populateHosts(ctx, params.Nodes); err != nil {
507: 		log.Warnf("Unable to populate hosts for node %q: %v", n.Cfg.ShortName, err)
508: 	}
509: 
510: 	// start waiting for initial commit and mgmt server ready
511: 	if err := n.Ready(ctx); err != nil {
512: 		return err
513: 	}
514: 
515: 	n.swVersion, err = n.RunningVersion(ctx)
516: 	if err != nil {
517: 		return err
518: 	}
519: 
520: 	n.supportsOpenconfig, err = n.OpenConfigFeatureEnabled(ctx)
521: 	if err != nil {
522: 		return err
523: 	}
524: 
525: 	// return if config file is found in the lab directory.
526: 	// This can be either if the startup-config has been mounted by that path
527: 	// or the config has been previously generated and saved
528: 	if clabutils.FileExists(filepath.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, "config", "config.json")) {
529: 		return nil
530: 	}
531: 
532: 	if err := n.addDefaultConfig(ctx); err != nil {
533: 		return err
534: 	}
535: 
536: 	if err := n.addOverlayCLIConfig(ctx); err != nil {
537: 		return err
538: 	}
539: 
540: 	// once default and overlay config is added, we can commit the config
541: 	if err := n.commitConfig(ctx); err != nil {
542: 		return err
543: 	}
544: 
545: 	return n.generateCheckpoint(ctx)
546: }
547: 
548: func (n *srl) SaveConfig(ctx context.Context) (*clabnodes.SaveConfigResult, error) {
549: 	cmd, _ := clabexec.NewExecCmdFromString(saveCmd)
550: 
551: 	execResult, err := n.RunExec(ctx, cmd)
552: 	if err != nil {
553: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%s: failed to execute cmd: %v", n.Cfg.ShortName, err)
554: 	}
555: 
556: 	if execResult.GetStdErrString() != "" {
557: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%s errors: %s", n.Cfg.ShortName, execResult.GetStdErrString())
558: 	}
559: 
560: 	cfgPath := filepath.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, "config", "config.json")
561: 
562: 	log.Infof(
563: 		"saved SR Linux configuration from %s node. Output:\n%s",
564: 		n.Cfg.ShortName,
565: 		execResult.GetStdOutString(),
566: 	)
567: 
568: 	return &clabnodes.SaveConfigResult{
569: 		ConfigPath: cfgPath,
570: 	}, nil
571: }
572: 
573: // Ready returns when the node boot sequence reached the stage when it is ready to accept config
574: // commands
575: // returns an error if not ready by the expiry of the timer readyTimeout.
576: func (n *srl) Ready(ctx context.Context) error {
577: 	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, readyTimeout)
578: 	defer cancel()
579: 
580: 	var err error
581: 
582: 	log.Debugf("Waiting for SR Linux node %q to boot...", n.Cfg.ShortName)
583: 
584: 	for {
585: 		select {
586: 		case <-ctx.Done():
587: 			return fmt.Errorf(
588: 				"timed out waiting for SR Linux node %s to boot: %v",
589: 				n.Cfg.ShortName,
590: 				err,
591: 			)
592: 		default:
593: 			// two commands are checked, first if the mgmt_server is running
594: 			cmd, _ := clabexec.NewExecCmdFromString(mgmtServerRdyCmd)
595: 
596: 			execResult, err := n.RunExec(ctx, cmd)
597: 			if err != nil || (execResult != nil && execResult.GetReturnCode() != 0) {
598: 				logMsg := "mgmt_server status check failed"
599: 
600: 				if err != nil {
601: 					logMsg += fmt.Sprintf(" error: %v", err)
602: 				}
603: 
604: 				if execResult != nil && execResult.GetReturnCode() != 0 {
605: 					logMsg += fmt.Sprintf(", output: \n%s", execResult)
606: 				}
607: 
608: 				log.Debug(logMsg)
609: 				time.Sleep(retryTimer)
610: 
611: 				continue
612: 			}
613: 
614: 			if execResult.GetStdErrString() != "" {
615: 				log.Debugf(
616: 					"error during checking SR Linux boot status: %s",
617: 					execResult.GetStdErrString(),
618: 				)
619: 				time.Sleep(retryTimer)
620: 
621: 				continue
622: 			}
623: 
624: 			if !strings.Contains(execResult.GetStdOutString(), "running") {
625: 				time.Sleep(retryTimer)
626: 
627: 				continue
628: 			}
629: 
630: 			// once mgmt server is running, we need to check if it is ready to accept configuration
631: 			// commands
632: 			// this is done with checking readyForConfigCmd
633: 			cmd, _ = clabexec.NewExecCmdFromString(readyForConfigCmd)
634: 
635: 			execResult, err = n.RunExec(ctx, cmd)
636: 			if err != nil {
637: 				log.Debugf("error during readyForConfigCmd execution: %s", err)
638: 				time.Sleep(retryTimer)
639: 
640: 				continue
641: 			}
642: 
643: 			if execResult.GetStdErrString() != "" {
644: 				log.Debugf("readyForConfigCmd stderr: %s", execResult.GetStdErrString())
645: 				time.Sleep(retryTimer)
646: 
647: 				continue
648: 			}
649: 
650: 			if !strings.Contains(execResult.GetStdOutString(), "loaded initial configuration") {
651: 				log.Debugf(
652: 					"Management server readiness files doesn't contain the marker string %s",
653: 					execResult.GetStdOutString(),
654: 				)
655: 				time.Sleep(retryTimer)
656: 
657: 				continue
658: 			}
659: 
660: 			log.Debugf("Node %s is ready to accept configs", n.Cfg.ShortName)
661: 
662: 			return nil
663: 		}
664: 	}
665: }

667: // checkKernelVersion emits a warning if the present kernel version is lower than the required one.
668: func (*srl) checkKernelVersion() error {
669: 	// retrieve running kernel version
670: 	kv, err := clabutils.GetKernelVersion()
671: 	if err != nil {
672: 		return err
673: 	}
674: 
675: 	// do the comparison
676: 	if !kv.GreaterOrEqual(requiredKernelVersion) {
677: 		log.Infof(
678: 			"Nokia SR Linux v23.3.1+ requires a kernel version greater than %s. Detected kernel version: %s",
679: 			requiredKernelVersion,
680: 			kv,
681: 		)
682: 	}
683: 
684: 	return nil
685: }

687: func (n *srl) CheckDeploymentConditions(ctx context.Context) error {
688: 	// perform the srl specific kernel version check
689: 	err := n.checkKernelVersion()
690: 	if err != nil {
691: 		return err
692: 	}
693: 
694: 	return n.DefaultNode.CheckDeploymentConditions(ctx)

697: func (n *srl) createSRLFiles() error {
698: 	log.Debugf("Creating directory structure for SRL container: %s", n.Cfg.ShortName)
699: 
700: 	var src string
701: 
702: 	if n.Cfg.License != "" {
703: 		// copy license file to node specific directory in lab
704: 		src = n.Cfg.License
705: 
706: 		licPath := filepath.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, "license.key")
707: 		if err := clabutils.CopyFile(context.Background(), src, licPath,
708: 			clabconstants.PermissionsFileDefault); err != nil {
709: 			return fmt.Errorf("CopyFile src %s -> dst %s failed %v", src, licPath, err)
710: 		}
711: 
712: 		log.Debugf("CopyFile src %s -> dst %s succeeded", src, licPath)
713: 	}
714: 
715: 	// generate SRL topology file, including base MAC
716: 	err := generateSRLTopologyFile(n.Cfg)
717: 	if err != nil {
718: 		return err
719: 	}
720: 
721: 	clabutils.CreateDirectory(path.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, "config"),
722: 		clabconstants.PermissionsOpen)
723: 
724: 	// create repository files (for yum/apt) that
725: 	// are mounted to srl container during the init phase
726: 	err = n.createRepoFiles()
727: 	if err != nil {
728: 		return err
729: 	}
730: 
731: 	// generate a startup config file
732: 	// if the node has a `startup-config:` statement, the file specified in that section
733: 	// will be used as a template in GenerateConfig()
734: 	var cfgTemplate string
735: 
736: 	cfgPath := filepath.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, "config", "config.json")
737: 	if n.Cfg.StartupConfig != "" {
738: 		log.Debug("Reading startup-config", "file", n.Cfg.StartupConfig)
739: 
740: 		c, err := os.ReadFile(n.Cfg.StartupConfig)
741: 		if err != nil {
742: 			return err
743: 		}
744: 
745: 		cBuf, err := clabutils.SubstituteEnvsAndTemplate(bytes.NewReader(c), n.Cfg)
746: 		if err != nil {
747: 			return err
748: 		}
749: 
750: 		// Determine if startup-config is a JSON file
751: 		// Get slice of data with optional leading whitespace removed.
752: 		// See RFC 7159, Section 2 for the definition of JSON whitespace.
753: 		x := bytes.TrimLeft(cBuf.Bytes(), " \t\r\n")
754: 
755: 		isJSON := len(x) > 0 && x[0] == '{'
756: 		if !isJSON {
757: 			log.Debugf(
758: 				"startup-config passed to %s is in the CLI format. Will apply it in post-deploy stage",
759: 				n.Cfg.ShortName,
760: 			)
761: 
762: 			n.startupCliCfg = cBuf.Bytes()
763: 
764: 			// no need to generate and mount startup-config passed in a CLI format
765: 			// as we will apply it over the top of a default config in the post deploy stage
766: 			return nil
767: 		}
768: 
769: 		cfgTemplate = cBuf.String()
770: 	}
771: 
772: 	if cfgTemplate == "" {
773: 		log.Debugf(
774: 			"configuration template for node %s is empty, skipping startup config file generation",
775: 			n.Cfg.ShortName,
776: 		)
777: 
778: 		return nil
779: 	}
780: 
781: 	err = n.GenerateConfig(cfgPath, cfgTemplate)
782: 	if err != nil {
783: 		log.Errorf("node=%s, failed to generate config: %v", n.Cfg.ShortName, err)
784: 	}
785: 
786: 	return err
787: }
788: 
789: // srlTemplateData top level data struct.
790: type srlTemplateData struct {
791: 	TLSKey     string
792: 	TLSCert    string
793: 	TLSAnchor  string
794: 	TLSConfig  string
795: 	Banner     string
796: 	IFaces     map[string]tplIFace
797: 	SSHPubKeys string
798: 	MgmtMTU    int
799: 	MgmtIPMTU  int
800: 	DNSServers []string
801: 	// EnableGNMIUnixSockServices enables GNMI unix socket services
802: 	// for the node. This is needed for "23.10 <= ver < 24.3" versions
803: 	EnableGNMIUnixSockServices bool
804: 	// EnableCustomPrompt enables custom prompt with added newline
805: 	// before the prompt.
806: 	EnableCustomPrompt bool
807: 	CustomPrompt       string
808: 	// SNMPConfig is a string containing SNMP configuration
809: 	SNMPConfig string
810: 	// GRPCConfig is a string containing GRPC configuration
811: 	GRPCConfig string
812: 	// ACLConfig is a string containing ACL configuration
813: 	ACLConfig string
814: 	// NetconfConfig is a string containing Netconf server configuration
815: 	NetconfConfig string
816: 	// EDAConfig is a string containing EDA configuration
817: 	EDAConfig string
818: 	// OCServerConfig is a string containing OpenConfig server configuration
819: 	OCServerConfig string
820: 	// NDKServerConfig is a string containing NDK server configuration
821: 	NDKServerConfig string
822: 	// DNSServersConfig is a string containing DNS servers configuration
823: 	DNSServersConfig string
824: }
825: 
826: // tplIFace template interface struct.
827: type tplIFace struct {
828: 	BaseName    string // base interface excl. breakout
829: 	FullName    string // full interface name incl. breakout
830: 	HasBreakout bool
831: 	Mtu         int
832: 	IPv4        string
833: 	IPv6        string
834: }

836: // addDefaultConfig adds srl default configuration such as tls certs, gnmi/json-rpc, login-banner.
837: func (n *srl) addDefaultConfig(ctx context.Context) error {
838: 	b, err := n.banner()
839: 	if err != nil {
840: 		return err
841: 	}
842: 
843: 	var dnsServers []string
844: 	if n.Config().DNS != nil {
845: 		dnsServers = n.Config().DNS.Servers
846: 	}
847: 
848: 	// tplData holds data used in templating of the default config snippet
849: 	tplData := srlTemplateData{
850: 		TLSKey:           n.Cfg.TLSKey,
851: 		TLSCert:          n.Cfg.TLSCert,
852: 		TLSAnchor:        n.Cfg.TLSAnchor,
853: 		Banner:           b,
854: 		IFaces:           map[string]tplIFace{},
855: 		MgmtMTU:          0,
856: 		MgmtIPMTU:        0,
857: 		DNSServers:       dnsServers,
858: 		SNMPConfig:       snmpv2Config,
859: 		GRPCConfig:       grpcConfig,
860: 		OCServerConfig:   "",
861: 		NDKServerConfig:  "",
862: 		DNSServersConfig: "",
863: 	}
864: 
865: 	if err := n.setVersionSpecificParams(&tplData); err != nil {
866: 		return err
867: 	}
868: 
869: 	n.setCustomPrompt(&tplData)
870: 
871: 	// set MgmtMTU to the MTU value of the runtime management network
872: 	// so that the two MTUs match.
873: 	tplData.MgmtIPMTU = n.Runtime.Mgmt().MTU
874: 
875: 	if err := n.populateInterfaceConfig(&tplData); err != nil {
876: 		return err
877: 	}
878: 
879: 	buf := new(bytes.Buffer)
880: 
881: 	err = srlCfgTpl.Execute(buf, tplData)
882: 	if err != nil {
883: 		return err
884: 	}
885: 
886: 	log.Debugf("Node %q additional config:\n%s", n.Cfg.ShortName, buf.String())
887: 
888: 	// Copy overlay config to container
889: 	tmpFilePath, err := clabutils.WriteToTempFile(buf.String())
890: 	if err != nil {
891: 		return err
892: 	}
893: 	defer os.Remove(tmpFilePath)
894: 
895: 	err = n.Runtime.CopyToContainer(ctx, n.Cfg.LongName, defaultCfgPath, tmpFilePath)
896: 	if err != nil {
897: 		return fmt.Errorf("error copying configuration to container: %w", err)
898: 	}
899: 
900: 	// su to admin user to apply the default config
901: 	// to make sure that the 'environment save' command will create
902: 	// files with correct permissions
903: 	cmd := clabexec.NewExecCmdFromSlice([]string{
904: 		"bash", "-c",
905: 		fmt.Sprintf("su -s /bin/bash admin -c '/opt/srlinux/bin/sr_cli -ed < %s'", defaultCfgPath),
906: 	})
907: 
908: 	execResult, err := n.RunExec(ctx, cmd)
909: 	if err != nil {
910: 		return err
911: 	}
912: 
913: 	log.Debugf(
914: 		"node %s. stdout: %s, stderr: %s",
915: 		n.Cfg.ShortName,
916: 		execResult.GetStdOutString(),
917: 		execResult.GetStdErrString(),
918: 	)
919: 
920: 	return nil
921: }

923: // populateInterfaceConfig adds endpoint settings to the default configuration,
924: // returning an error for interface names that cannot be mapped to SR Linux interfaces.
925: func (n *srl) populateInterfaceConfig(tplData *srlTemplateData) error {
926: 	const ethernetSplitParts = 3
927: 
928: 	const ethernetMTUOverhead = 14
929: 
930: 	for _, e := range n.Endpoints {
931: 		ifName := e.GetIfaceName()
932: 
933: 		// Runtime-discovered endpoints bypass topology interface-name validation.
934: 		if !normalizedInterfaceRegexp.MatchString(ifName) {
935: 			return fmt.Errorf(
936: 				"invalid SR Linux interface %q: expected %s or %s",
937: 				ifName, mgmt0InterfaceName, InterfaceHelp,
938: 			)
939: 		}
940: 
941: 		// Restored runtime endpoints may have no topology link or configured MTU.
942: 		mtu := clabconstants.DefaultLinkMTU
943: 		if link := e.GetLink(); link != nil {
944: 			mtu = link.GetMTU()
945: 		}
946: 
947: 		if ifName == mgmt0InterfaceName {
948: 			if mtu != clabconstants.DefaultLinkMTU {
949: 				tplData.MgmtMTU = mtu
950: 				tplData.MgmtIPMTU = mtu - ethernetMTUOverhead
951: 			}
952: 
953: 			continue
954: 		}
955: 
956: 		ifNameParts := strings.SplitN(strings.TrimPrefix(ifName, "e"), "-", ethernetSplitParts)
957: 
958: 		iface := tplIFace{}
959: 
960: 		iface.BaseName = fmt.Sprintf("ethernet-%s/%s", ifNameParts[0], ifNameParts[1])
961: 		if len(ifNameParts) == ethernetSplitParts {
962: 			iface.FullName = fmt.Sprintf("%s/%s", iface.BaseName, ifNameParts[2])
963: 			iface.HasBreakout = true
964: 		} else {
965: 			iface.FullName = iface.BaseName
966: 		}
967: 
968: 		if mtu != clabconstants.DefaultLinkMTU {
969: 			iface.Mtu = mtu
970: 		}
971: 
972: 		if a := e.GetIPv4Addr(); a.IsValid() {
973: 			iface.IPv4 = a.String()
974: 		}
975: 
976: 		if a := e.GetIPv6Addr(); a.IsValid() {
977: 			iface.IPv6 = a.String()
978: 		}
979: 
980: 		tplData.IFaces[ifName] = iface
981: 	}
982: 
983: 	return nil
984: }

986: // addOverlayCLIConfig adds CLI formatted config that is read out of a file provided via
987: // startup-config directive.
988: func (n *srl) addOverlayCLIConfig(ctx context.Context) error {
989: 	if len(n.startupCliCfg) == 0 {
990: 		log.Debugf(
991: 			"node %q: startup-config empty, committing existing candidate",
992: 			n.Config().ShortName,
993: 		)
994: 
995: 		return nil
996: 	}
997: 
998: 	cfgStr := string(n.startupCliCfg)
999: 
1000: 	log.Debugf(
1001: 		"Node %q additional config from startup-config file %s:\n%s",
1002: 		n.Cfg.ShortName,
1003: 		n.Cfg.StartupConfig,
1004: 		cfgStr,
1005: 	)
1006: 
1007: 	// Copy overlay config to container
1008: 	tmpFilePath, err := clabutils.WriteToTempFile(cfgStr)
1009: 	if err != nil {
1010: 		return err
1011: 	}
1012: 	defer os.Remove(tmpFilePath)
1013: 
1014: 	err = n.Runtime.CopyToContainer(ctx, n.Cfg.LongName, overlayCfgPath, tmpFilePath)
1015: 	if err != nil {
1016: 		return fmt.Errorf("error copying configuration to container: %w", err)
1017: 	}
1018: 
1019: 	// Load overlay config
1020: 	cmd := clabexec.NewExecCmdFromSlice([]string{
1021: 		"bash", "-c",
1022: 		fmt.Sprintf("su -s /bin/bash admin -c '/opt/srlinux/bin/sr_cli -ed < %s'", overlayCfgPath),
1023: 	})
1024: 
1025: 	execResult, err := n.RunExec(ctx, cmd)
1026: 	if err != nil {
1027: 		return err
1028: 	}
1029: 
1030: 	if execResult.GetStdErrString() != "" {
1031: 		return fmt.Errorf("%w:%s", clabnodes.ErrCommandExecError, execResult.GetStdErrString())
1032: 	}
1033: 
1034: 	log.Debugf(
1035: 		"node %s. stdout: %s, stderr: %s",
1036: 		n.Cfg.ShortName,
1037: 		execResult.GetStdOutString(),
1038: 		execResult.GetStdErrString(),
1039: 	)
1040: 
1041: 	return nil
1042: }

1100: // populateHosts adds container hostnames for other nodes of a lab to SR Linux /etc/hosts file
1101: // to mitigate the fact that srlinux uses non default netns for management and thus
1102: // can't leverage docker DNS service.
1103: func (n *srl) populateHosts(ctx context.Context, nodes map[string]clabnodes.Node) error {
1104: 	hosts, err := n.Runtime.GetHostsPath(ctx, n.Cfg.LongName)
1105: 	if err != nil {
1106: 		log.Warnf("Unable to locate /etc/hosts file for srl node %v: %v", n.Cfg.ShortName, err)
1107: 		return err
1108: 	}
1109: 
1110: 	var entriesv4, entriesv6 bytes.Buffer
1111: 
1112: 	const (
1113: 		v4Prefix = "###### CLAB-v4-START ######"
1114: 		v4Suffix = "###### CLAB-v4-END ######"
1115: 		v6Prefix = "###### CLAB-v6-START ######"
1116: 		v6Suffix = "###### CLAB-v6-END ######"
1117: 	)
1118: 	fmt.Fprintf(&entriesv4, "\n%s\n", v4Prefix)
1119: 	fmt.Fprintf(&entriesv6, "\n%s\n", v6Prefix)
1120: 
1121: 	for node, params := range nodes {
1122: 		if v4 := params.Config().MgmtIPv4Address; v4 != "" {
1123: 			fmt.Fprintf(&entriesv4, "%s\t%s\n", v4, node)
1124: 		}
1125: 
1126: 		if v6 := params.Config().MgmtIPv6Address; v6 != "" {
1127: 			fmt.Fprintf(&entriesv6, "%s\t%s\n", v6, node)
1128: 		}
1129: 	}
1130: 
1131: 	fmt.Fprintf(&entriesv4, "%s\n", v4Suffix)
1132: 	fmt.Fprintf(&entriesv6, "%s\n", v6Suffix)
1133: 
1134: 	// world-writable for container /etc/hosts
1135: 	const hostsFilePerm = 0o666
1136: 
1137: 	file, err := os.OpenFile(hosts, os.O_APPEND|os.O_WRONLY, hostsFilePerm) // skipcq: GSC-G302
1138: 	if err != nil {
1139: 		log.Warnf("Unable to open /etc/hosts file for srl node %v: %v", n.Cfg.ShortName, err)
1140: 		return err
1141: 	}
1142: 
1143: 	_, err = file.Write(entriesv4.Bytes())
1144: 	if err != nil {
1145: 		return err
1146: 	}
1147: 
1148: 	_, err = file.Write(entriesv6.Bytes())
1149: 	if err != nil {
1150: 		return err
1151: 	}
1152: 
1153: 	return file.Close()
1154: }
1155: 
1156: func (n *srl) GetMappedInterfaceName(ifName string) (string, error) {
1157: 	captureGroups, err := clabutils.GetRegexpCaptureGroups(n.InterfaceRegexp, ifName)
1158: 	if err != nil {
1159: 		return "", err
1160: 	}
1161: 
1162: 	indexGroups := []string{"linecard", "port", "channel"}
1163: 	parsedIndices := make(map[string]int)
1164: 	foundIndices := make(map[string]bool)
1165: 
1166: 	for _, indexKey := range indexGroups {
1167: 		if index, found := captureGroups[indexKey]; found && index != "" {
1168: 			foundIndices[indexKey] = true
1169: 
1170: 			parsedIndices[indexKey], err = strconv.Atoi(index)
1171: 			if err != nil {
1172: 				return "", fmt.Errorf(
1173: 					"%q parsed %s index %q could not be cast to an integer",
1174: 					ifName,
1175: 					indexKey,
1176: 					index,
1177: 				)
1178: 			}
1179: 
1180: 			if parsedIndices[indexKey] < 1 {
1181: 				return "", fmt.Errorf(
1182: 					"%q parsed %q index %q does not match requirement >= 1",
1183: 					ifName,
1184: 					indexKey,
1185: 					index,
1186: 				)
1187: 			}
1188: 		} else {
1189: 			foundIndices[indexKey] = false
1190: 		}
1191: 	}
1192: 
1193: 	if foundIndices["linecard"] && foundIndices["port"] {
1194: 		if foundIndices["channel"] {
1195: 			return fmt.Sprintf("e%d-%d-%d", parsedIndices["linecard"],
1196: 				parsedIndices["port"], parsedIndices["channel"]), nil
1197: 		} else {
1198: 			return fmt.Sprintf("e%d-%d", parsedIndices["linecard"], parsedIndices["port"]), nil
1199: 		}
1200: 	} else {
1201: 		return "", fmt.Errorf("%q missing linecard or port index", ifName)
1202: 	}
1203: }
1204: 
1205: // CheckInterfaceName checks if a name of the interface referenced in the topology file correct.
1206: func (n *srl) CheckInterfaceName() error {
1207: 	nm := strings.ToLower(n.Cfg.NetworkMode)
1208: 
1209: 	err := n.CheckInterfaceOverlap()
1210: 	if err != nil {
1211: 		return err
1212: 	}
1213: 
1214: 	for _, e := range n.Endpoints {
1215: 		if !normalizedInterfaceRegexp.MatchString(e.GetIfaceName()) {
1216: 			return fmt.Errorf(
1217: 				"nokia sr linux interface name %q doesn't match the required pattern: %s",
1218: 				e.GetIfaceName(),
1219: 				n.InterfaceHelp,
1220: 			)
1221: 		}
1222: 
1223: 		if e.GetIfaceName() == mgmt0InterfaceName && nm != "none" {
1224: 			return fmt.Errorf(
1225: 				"mgmt0 interface name is not allowed for %s node when network mode is not set to none",
1226: 				n.Cfg.ShortName,
1227: 			)
1228: 		}
1229: 	}
1230: 
1231: 	return nil
1232: }
1233: 
1234: // createRepoFiles creates apt/ym repository files
1235: // to enable srl nodes to install ndk apps.
1236: func (n *srl) createRepoFiles() error {
1237: 	yumRepo := `[srlinux]
1238: name=SR Linux NDK apps
1239: baseurl=https://srlinux.fury.site/yum/
1240: enabled=1
1241: gpgcheck=0`
1242: 
1243: 	aptRepo := `deb [trusted=yes] https://srlinux.fury.site/apt/ /`
1244: 
1245: 	yumPath := n.Cfg.LabDir + "/yum.repo"
1246: 
1247: 	err := clabutils.CreateFile(yumPath, yumRepo)
1248: 	if err != nil {
1249: 		return err
1250: 	}
1251: 
1252: 	aptPath := n.Cfg.LabDir + "/apt.list"
1253:

1263: 		aptPath+":/etc/apt/sources.list.d/srlinux.list:ro")

n.Runtime.StopContainer(ctx, n.netnsNode.Config().LongName, n.netnsNode.StopSignal)\n448: }\n449: \n450: func (n *srl) Delete(ctx context.Context) error {\n451: \tif n.netnsNode == nil {\n452: container with the network settings of the holder.\n459: // When only the holder exists, it is returned so that it is not orphaned on destroy.\n460: func (n *srl) GetContainers(ctx context.Context) {\n467: \t\tif errors.Is(err, clabnodes.ErrContainersNotFound) {\n468: \t\t\treturn n.netnsNode.GetContainers(ctx)\n469: \t\t}\n470: \n471: \t\treturn nil, err\n472: \t}\n473: \n474: \tholder, err := n.netnsNode.GetContainers(ctx)\n475: \tif err != nil {\n476: \t\tif errors.Is(err, clabnodes.ErrContainersNotFound) {\n477: \t\t\treturn cnts, nil\n478: \t\t}\n479: \n480: \t\treturn nil, err\n481: \t}\n482: \n483: \tcnts[0].NetworkName = holder[0].NetworkName\n484: \tcnts[0].NetworkSettings = holder[0].NetworkSettings\n485: \tcnts[0].Ports = holder[0].Ports\n486: \n487: \treturn cnts, nil\n488: }\n489: \n490: func (n *srl) PostDeploy(ctx context.Context, params *clabnodes.PostDeployParams) error {\n491: \tlog.Info(\"Running postdeploy actions\",\n492: \t\t\"kind\", n.Cfg.Kind,\n493: \t\t\"node\", n.Cfg.ShortName)\n494: \n495: \t// generate the certificate\n496: \tcertificate, err := n.LoadOrGenerateCertificate(n.cert, n.topologyName)\n497: \tif err != nil {\n498: \t\treturn err\n499: \t}\n500: \n501: \t// set the certificate data\n502: \tn.Config().TLSCert = string(certificate.Cert)\n503: \tn.Config().TLSKey = string(certificate.Key)\n504: \n505: \t// Populate /etc/hosts for service discovery on mgmt interface\n506: \tif err := n.populateHosts(ctx, params.Nodes); err != nil {\n507: \t\tlog.Warnf(\"Unable to populate hosts for node %q: %v\", n.Cfg.ShortName, err)\n508: \t}\n509: \n510: \t// start waiting for initial commit and mgmt server ready\n511: \tif err := n.Ready(ctx); err != nil {\n512: \t\treturn err\n513: \t}\n514: \n515: \tn.swVersion, err = n.RunningVersion(ctx)\n516: \tif err != nil {\n517: \t\treturn err\n518: \t}\n519: \n520: \tn.supportsOpenconfig, err = n.OpenConfigFeatureEnabled(ctx)\n521: \tif err != nil {\n522: \t\treturn err\n523: \t}\n524: \n525: \t// return if config file is found in the lab directory.\n526: \t// This can be either if the startup-config has been mounted by that path\n527: \t// or the config has been previously generated and saved\n528: \tif clabutils.FileExists(filepath.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, \"config\", \"config.json\")) {\n529: \t\treturn nil\n530: \t}\n531: \n532: \tif err := n.addDefaultConfig(ctx); err != nil {\n533: \t\treturn err\n534: \t}\n535: \n536: \tif err := n.addOverlayCLIConfig(ctx); err != nil {\n537: \t\treturn err\n538: \t}\n539: \n540: \t// once default and overlay config is added, we can commit the config\n541: \tif err := n.commitConfig(ctx); err != nil {\n542: \t\treturn err\n543: \t}\n544: \n545: \treturn n.generateCheckpoint(ctx)\n546: }\n547: \n548: func (n *srl) SaveConfig(ctx context.Context) (*clabnodes.SaveConfigResult, error) {\n549: \tcmd, _ := clabexec.NewExecCmdFromString(saveCmd)\n550: \n551: \texecResult, err := n.RunExec(ctx, cmd)\n552: \tif err != nil {\n553: \t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"%s: failed to execute cmd: %v\", n.Cfg.ShortName, err)\n554: \t}\n555: \n556: \tif execResult.GetStdErrString() != \"\" {\n557: \t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"%s errors: %s\", n.Cfg.ShortName, execResult.GetStdErrString())\n558: \t}\n559: \n560: \tcfgPath := filepath.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, \"config\", \"config.json\")\n561: \n562: \tlog.Infof(\n563: \t\t\"saved SR Linux configuration from %s node. Output:\\n%s\",\n564: \t\tn.Cfg.ShortName,\n565: \t\texecResult.GetStdOutString(),\n566: \t)\n567: \n568: \treturn &clabnodes.SaveConfigResult{\n569: \t\tConfigPath: cfgPath,\n570: \t}, nil\n571: }\n572: \n573: // Ready returns when the node boot sequence reached the stage when it is ready to accept config\n574: // commands\n575: // returns an error if not ready by the expiry of the timer readyTimeout.\n576: func (n *srl) Ready(ctx context.Context) error {\n577: \tctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, readyTimeout)\n578: \tdefer cancel()\n579: \n580: \tvar err error\n581: \n582: \tlog.Debugf(\"Waiting for SR Linux node %q to boot...\", n.Cfg.ShortName)\n583: \n584: \tfor {\n585: \t\tselect {\n586: \t\tcase <-ctx.Done():\n587: \t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\n588: \t\t\t\t\"timed out waiting for SR Linux node %s to boot: %v\",\n589: \t\t\t\tn.Cfg.ShortName,\n590: \t\t\t\terr,\n591: \t\t\t)\n592: \t\tdefault:\n593: \t\t\t// two commands are checked, first if the mgmt_server is running\n594: \t\t\tcmd, _ := clabexec.NewExecCmdFromString(mgmtServerRdyCmd)\n595: \n596: \t\t\texecResult, err := n.RunExec(ctx, cmd)\n597: \t\t\tif err != nil || (execResult != nil && execResult.GetReturnCode() != 0) {\n598: \t\t\t\tlogMsg := \"mgmt_server status check failed\"\n599: \n600: \t\t\t\tif err != nil {\n601: \t\t\t\t\tlogMsg += fmt.Sprintf(\" error: %v\", err)\n602: \t\t\t\t}\n603: \n604: \t\t\t\tif execResult != nil && execResult.GetReturnCode() != 0 {\n605: \t\t\t\t\tlogMsg += fmt.Sprintf(\", output: \\n%s\", execResult)\n606: \t\t\t\t}\n607: \n608: \t\t\t\tlog.Debug(logMsg)\n609: \t\t\t\ttime.Sleep(retryTimer)\n610: \n611: \t\t\t\tcontinue\n612: \t\t\t}\n613: \n614: \t\t\tif execResult.GetStdErrString() != \"\" {\n615: \t\t\t\tlog.Debugf(\n616: \t\t\t\t\t\"error during checking SR Linux boot status: %s\",\n617: \t\t\t\t\texecResult.GetStdErrString(),\n618: \t\t\t\t)\n619: \t\t\t\ttime.Sleep(retryTimer)\n620: \n621: \t\t\t\tcontinue\n622: \t\t\t}\n623: \n624: \t\t\tif !strings.Contains(execResult.GetStdOutString(), \"running\") {\n625: \t\t\t\ttime.Sleep(retryTimer)\n626: \n627: \t\t\t\tcontinue\n628: \t\t\t}\n629: \n630: \t\t\t// once mgmt server is running, we need to check if it is ready to accept configuration\n631: \t\t\t// commands\n632: \t\t\t// this is done with checking readyForConfigCmd\n633: \t\t\tcmd, _ = clabexec.NewExecCmdFromString(readyForConfigCmd)\n634: \n635: \t\t\texecResult, err = n.RunExec(ctx, cmd)\n636: \t\t\tif err != nil {\n637: \t\t\t\tlog.Debugf(\"error during readyForConfigCmd execution: %s\", err)\n638: \t\t\t\ttime.Sleep(retryTimer)\n639: \n640: \t\t\t\tcontinue\n641: \t\t\t}\n642: \n643: \t\t\tif execResult.GetStdErrString() != \"\" {\n644: \t\t\t\tlog.Debugf(\"readyForConfigCmd stderr: %s\", execResult.GetStdErrString())\n645: \t\t\t\ttime.Sleep(retryTimer)\n646: \n647: \t\t\t\tcontinue\n648: \t\t\t}\n649: \n650: \t\t\tif !strings.Contains(execResult.GetStdOutString(), \"loaded initial configuration\") {\n651: \t\t\t\tlog.Debugf(\n652: \t\t\t\t\t\"Management server readiness files doesn't contain the marker string %s\",\n653: \t\t\t\t\texecResult.GetStdOutString(),\n654: \t\t\t\t)\n655: \t\t\t\ttime.Sleep(retryTimer)\n656: \n657: \t\t\t\tcontinue\n658: \t\t\t}\n659: \n660: \t\t\tlog.Debugf(\"Node %s is ready to accept configs\", n.Cfg.ShortName)\n661: \n662: \t\t\treturn nil\n663: \t\t}\n664: \t}\n665: }\n666: \n667: // checkKernelVersion emits a warning if the present kernel version is lower than the required one.\n668: func (*srl) checkKernelVersion() error {\n669: \t// retrieve running kernel version\n670: \tkv, err := clabutils.GetKernelVersion()\n671: \tif err != nil {\n672: \t\treturn \tconst ethernetMTUOverhead = 14\n929: \n930: \tfor _, e := range n.Endpoints {\n931: \t\tifName := e.GetIfaceName()\n932: \n933: \t\t// Runtime-discovered endpoints bypass topology interface-name \t\ttplData.IFaces[ifName] = iface\n981: \t}\n982: \n983: \treturn nil\n984: }\n985: \n986: // addOverlayCLIConfig adds CLI formatted config that is read out of a file provided via\n987: //
