OpenConfig server\n\tsupportsOpenconfig bool\n\t// holder of the node's network namespace\n\tnetnsNode *clabnodes.NetnsHolder\n}\n\nfunc (*srl) LinkApplyMode(context.Context) clabnodes.LinkApplyMode {\n\treturn clabnodes.LinkApplyModeLive\n}\n\nfunc (n *srl) kindSpecificCfg() *KindSpecificConfig { return kindSpecificConfig.Of(n.Cfg) }\n\nfunc (n *srl) Init(cfg *clabtypes.NodeConfig, opts ...clabnodes.NodeOption) error {\n\t// Init DefaultNode\n\tn.DefaultNode = *clabnodes.NewDefaultNode(n)\n\t// set virtualization requirement\n\tn.HostRequirements.SSSE3 = true\n\tn.HostRequirements.MinVCPU = 2\n\tn.HostRequirements.MinVCPUFailAction = clabtypes.FailBehaviourError\n\tn.HostRequirements.MinAvailMemoryGb = 2\n\tn.HostRequirements.MinAvailMemoryGbFailAction = clabtypes.FailBehaviourLog\n\n\tn.Cfg = cfg\n\n\t// force cert creation for srlinux nodes as they by make use of tls certificate in the default\n\t// config\n\tn.Cfg.Certificate.Issue = new(true)\n\n\tfor _, o := range opts {\n\t\to(n)\n\t}\n\n\tif n.Cfg.NodeType != \"\" && !strings.Contains(n.Cfg.NodeType, \"-\") {\n\t\tlog.Warn(\n\t\t\t\"Deprecation notice\",\n\t\t\t\"notice\",\n\t\t\t\"You are using a deprecated SR Linux node type name. \"+\n\t\t\t\t\"Consider using a new format with dashes. Example: ixr-d2l, ixr-h5-64d, etc.\\n\"+\n\t\t\t\t\"Deprecated type format will be removed after January 2026\",\n\t\t\t\"deprecated type\",\n\t\t\tn.Cfg.NodeType,\n\t\t)\n\t}\n\n\tif n.Cfg.NodeType == \"\" {\n\t\tn.Cfg.NodeType = SRLinuxDefaultType\n\t}\n\n\tif _, found := srlTypes[n.Cfg.NodeType]; !found {\n\t\tkeys := make([]string, 0, len(srlTypes))\n\t\tfor key := range srlTypes {\n\t\t\tkeys = append(keys, key)\n\t\t}\n\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"wrong node type. '%s' doesn't exist. should be any of %s\",\n\t\t\tn.Cfg.NodeType, strings.Join(keys, \", \"))\n\t}\n\n\t// fail on an unusable components block here rather than midway through the deploy\n\tif _, err := resolveSRLTopology(n.Cfg); err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\tif len(n.kindSpecificCfg().Components) > 1 {\n\t\tlog.Warn(\"Multiple line cards are rendered into the SR Linux topology file, but \"+\n\t\t\t\"deploying a node with more than one line card is not supported yet\",\n\t\t\t\"node\", n.Cfg.ShortName, \"line cards\", len(n.kindSpecificCfg().Components))\n\t}\n\n\tif n.Cfg.Cmd == \"\" {\n\t\t// set default Cmd if it was not provided by a user\n\t\t// the additional touch is needed to support non docker runtimes\n\t\tn.Cfg.Cmd = \"sudo -E bash -c 'touch /.dockerenv && /opt/srlinux/bin/sr_linux'\"\n\t}\n\n\tn.Cfg.Env = clabutils.MergeStringMaps(srlEnv, n.Cfg.Env)\n\n\t// if user was not initialized to a value, use root\n\tif n.Cfg.User == \"\" {\n\t\tn.Cfg.User = \"0:0\"\n\t}\n\n\t// restart the node when it is rebooted from within.\n\t// unless-stopped is used, as some images exit with code 0 on reboot;\n\t// on-failure is enough once all supported images exit with a non-zero code.\n\tif n.Cfg.RestartPolicy == \"\" {\n\t\tn.Cfg.RestartPolicy = \"unless-stopped\"\n\t}\n\n\tmaps.Copy(n.Cfg.Sysctls, srlSysctl)\n\n\tif n.Cfg.License != \"\" {\n\t\t// we mount a fixed path node.Labdir/license.key as the license referenced in topo file will\n\t\t// be copied to that path\n\t\tn.Cfg.Binds = append(n.Cfg.Binds, fmt.Sprint(\n\t\t\tfilepath.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, \"license.key\"), \":/opt/srlinux/etc/license.key:ro\"))\n\t}\n\n\t// mount config directory\n\tcfgPath := filepath.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, \"config\")\n\tn.Cfg.Binds = append(n.Cfg.Binds, fmt.Sprint(cfgPath, \":/etc/opt/srlinux/:rw\"))\n\n\t// mount srlinux topology\n\tsrcTopoPath := filepath.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, \"topology.yml\")\n\tdstTopoPath := \"/tmp/topology.yml\"\n\t// if a user provided a topology file, it means that they want to use a custom srl topology file\n\t// in that case we do not need to mount the one for the provided type\n\tif !clabutils.DestinationBindMountExists(n.Cfg.Binds, dstTopoPath) {\n\t\tn.Cfg.Binds = append(n.Cfg.Binds, fmt.Sprint(srcTopoPath, \":\", dstTopoPath, \":ro\"))\n\t}\n\n\t// mounting /run/netnns as tmpfs ensures the network-instances\n\t// namespaces don't persist through stop/start/restarts.\n\tif n.Cfg.Tmpfs == nil {\n\t\tn.Cfg.Tmpfs = map[string]string{}\n\t}\n\n\tn.Cfg.Tmpfs[\"/run/netns\"] = \"rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec\"\n\n\tn.InterfaceRegexp = InterfaceRegexp\n\tn.InterfaceHelp = InterfaceHelp\n\n\treturn n.initNetnsNode()\n}\n\nfunc (n *srl) PreDeploy(ctx context.Context, params *clabnodes.PreDeployParams) error {\n\tclabutils.CreateDirectory(n.Cfg.LabDir, clabconstants.PermissionsOpen)\n\n\t// store provided pubkeys\n\tn.sshPubKeys = params.SSHPubKeys\n\n\t// store the certificate-related parameters\n\t// for cert generation to happen in Post-Deploy phase with mgmt IPs as SANs\n\tn.cert = params.Cert\n\tn.topologyName = params.TopologyName\n\n\t// platform specific pre-deploy actions\n\t// modular chassis boot in the mode required by the line card generation they are populated\n\t// with, unless the user pinned the mode explicitly.\n\tif n.Config().Env[\"SRL_CHASSIS_MODE\"] == \"\" {\n\t\ttopology, err := resolveSRLTopology(n.Cfg)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn err\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tif topology.ChassisMode != \"\" {\n\t\t\tn.Config().Env[\"SRL_CHASSIS_MODE\"] = topology.ChassisMode\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\treturn n.createSRLFiles()\n}\n\nfunc (n *srl) Deploy(ctx context.Context, params *clabnodes.DeployParams) error {\n\tif n.netnsNode == nil {\n\t\treturn n.DefaultNode.Deploy(ctx, params)\n\t}\n\n\t// network settings are finalized after Init, so the holder config is rebuilt here.\n\t*n.netnsNode.Config() = *n.newNetnsConfig()\n\tif err := n.netnsNode.Deploy(ctx, params); err != nil {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"deploy network namespace node %q: %w\", n.netnsNode.GetShortName(), err)\n\t}\n\n\tn.Cfg.Env[clabconstants.ClabEnvIntfs] = strconv.Itoa(len(n.GetEndpoints()))\n\n\tcID, err := n.Runtime.CreateContainer(ctx, n.containerConfig())\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\tif _, err := n.Runtime.StartContainer(ctx, cID, n); err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\tif err := n.linkNetns(ctx); err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\tn.SetState(clabnodesstate.Deployed)\n\n\treturn nil\n}\n\nfunc (n *srl) Start(ctx context.Context) error {\n\tif n.netnsNode == nil {\n\t\treturn n.DefaultNode.Start(ctx)\n\t}\n\n\tif err := n.netnsNode.EnsureRunning(ctx, n.Cfg.ShortName); err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\tif err := n.DefaultNode.Start(ctx); err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\treturn n.linkNetns(ctx)\n}\n\n// Stop also stops the holder, so that the next start gets a fresh network namespace without\n// interfaces left behind by the stopped SR Linux container.\nfunc (n *srl) Stop(ctx context.Context) error {\n\tif err := n.DefaultNode.Stop(ctx); err != nil || n.netnsNode == nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\tif n.netnsNode.GetContainerStatus(ctx) != clabruntime.Running {\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\n\treturn n.Runtime.StopContainer(ctx, n.netnsNode.Config().LongName, n.netnsNode.StopSignal)\n}\n\nfunc (n *srl) Delete(ctx context.Context) error {\n\tif n.netnsNode == nil {\n\t\treturn n.DefaultNode.Delete(ctx)\n\t}\n\n\treturn errors.Join(n.DefaultNode.Delete(ctx), n.netnsNode.Delete(ctx))\n}\n\n// GetContainers returns the SR Linux container with the network settings of the holder.\n// When only the holder exists, it is returned so that it is not orphaned on destroy.\nfunc (n *srl) GetContainers(ctx context.Context) ([]clabruntime.GenericContainer, error) {\n\tcnts, err := n.DefaultNode.GetContainers(ctx)\n\tif n.netnsNode == nil {\n\t\treturn cnts, err\n\t}\n\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tif errors.Is(err, clabnodes.ErrContainersNotFound) {\n\t\t\treturn n.netnsNode.GetContainers(ctx)\n\t\t}\n\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\n\tholder, err := n.netnsNode.GetContainers(ctx)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tif errors.Is(err, clabnodes.ErrContainersNotFound) {\n\t\t\treturn cnts, nil\n\t\t}\n\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\n\tcnts[0].NetworkName = holder[0].NetworkName\n\tcnts[0].NetworkSettings = holder[0].NetworkSettings\n\tcnts[0].Ports = holder[0].Ports\n\n\treturn cnts, nil\n}\n\nfunc (n *srl) PostDeploy(ctx context.Context, params *clabnodes.PostDeployParams) error {\n\tlog.Info(\"Running postdeploy actions\",\n\t\t\"kind\", n.Cfg.Kind,\n\t\t\"node\", n.Cfg.ShortName)\n\n\t// generate the certificate\n\tcertificate, err := n.LoadOrGenerateCertificate(n.cert, n.topologyName)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\t// set the certificate data\n\tn.Config().TLSCert = string(certificate.Cert)\n\tn.Config().TLSKey = string(certificate.Key)\n\n\t// Populate /etc/hosts for service discovery on mgmt interface\n\tif err := n.populateHosts(ctx, params.Nodes); err != nil {\n\t\tlog.Warnf(\"Unable to populate hosts for node %q: %v\", n.Cfg.ShortName, err)\n\t}\n\n\t// start waiting for initial commit and mgmt server ready\n\tif err := n.Ready(ctx); err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\tn.swVersion, err = n.RunningVersion(ctx)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\tn.supportsOpenconfig, err = n.OpenConfigFeatureEnabled(ctx)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\t// return if config file is found in the lab directory.\n\t// This can be either if the startup-config has been mounted by that path\n\t// or the config has been previously generated and saved\n\tif clabutils.FileExists(filepath.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, \"config\", \"config.json\")) {\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\n\tif err := n.addDefaultConfig(ctx); err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\tif err := n.addOverlayCLIConfig(ctx); err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\t// once default and overlay config is added, we can commit the config\n\tif err := n.commitConfig(ctx); err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\treturn n.generateCheckpoint(ctx)\n}\n\nfunc (n *srl) SaveConfig(ctx context.Context) (*clabnodes.SaveConfigResult, error) {\n\tcmd, _ := clabexec.NewExecCmdFromString(saveCmd)\n\n\texecResult, err := n.RunExec(ctx, cmd)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"%s: failed to execute cmd: %v\", n.Cfg.ShortName, err)\n\t}\n\n\tif execResult.GetStdErrString() != \"\" {\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"%s errors: %s\", n.Cfg.ShortName, execResult.GetStdErrString())\n\t}\n\n\tcfgPath := filepath.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, \"config\", \"config.json\")\n\n\tlog.Infof(\n\t\t\"saved SR Linux configuration from %s node. Output:\\n%s\",\n\t\tn.Cfg.ShortName,\n\t\texecResult.GetStdOutString(),\n\t)\n\n\treturn &clabnodes.SaveConfigResult{\n\t\tConfigPath: cfgPath,\n\t}, nil\n}\n\n// Ready returns when the node boot sequence reached the stage when it is ready to accept config\n// commands\n// returns an error if not ready by the expiry of the timer readyTimeout.\nfunc (n *srl) Ready(ctx context.Context) error {\n\tctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, readyTimeout)\n\tdefer cancel()\n\n\tvar err error\n\n\tlog.Debugf(\"Waiting for SR Linux node %q to boot...\", n.Cfg.ShortName)\n\n\tfor {\n\t\tselect {\n\t\tcase <-ctx.Done():\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\n\t\t\t\t\"timed out waiting for SR Linux node %s to boot: %v\",\n\t\t\t\tn.Cfg.ShortName,\n\t\t\t\terr,\n\t\t\t)\n\t\tdefault:\n\t\t\t// two commands are checked, first if the mgmt_server is running\n\t\t\tcmd, _ := clabexec.NewExecCmdFromString(mgmtServerRdyCmd)\n\n\t\t\texecResult, err := n.RunExec(ctx, cmd)\n\t\t\tif err != nil || (execResult != nil && execResult.GetReturnCode() != 0) {\n\t\t\t\tlogMsg := \"mgmt_server status check failed\"\n\n\t\t\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\t\t\tlogMsg += fmt.Sprintf(\" error: %v\", err)\n\t\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\t\tif execResult != nil && execResult.GetReturnCode() != 0 {\n\t\t\t\t\tlogMsg += fmt.Sprintf(\", output: \\n%s\", execResult)\n\t\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\t\tlog.Debug(logMsg)\n\t\t\t\ttime.Sleep(retryTimer)\n\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\tif execResult.GetStdErrString() != \"\" {\n\t\t\t\tlog.Debugf(\n\t\t\t\t\t\"error during checking SR Linux boot status: %s\",\n\t\t\t\t\texecResult.GetStdErrString(),\n\t\t\t\t)\n\t\t\t\ttime.Sleep(retryTimer)\n\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\tif !strings.Contains(execResult.GetStdOutString(), \"running\") {\n\t\t\t\ttime.Sleep(retryTimer)\n\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\t// once mgmt server is running, we need to check if it is ready to accept configuration\n\t\t\t// commands\n\t\t\t// this is done with checking readyForConfigCmd\n\t\t\tcmd, _ = clabexec.NewExecCmdFromString(readyForConfigCmd)\n\n\t\t\texecResult, err = n.RunExec(ctx, cmd)\n\t\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\t\tlog.Debugf(\"error during readyForConfigCmd execution: %s\", err)\n\t\t\t\ttime.Sleep(retryTimer)\n\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\tif execResult.GetStdErrString() != \"\" {\n\t\t\t\tlog.Debugf(\"readyForConfigCmd stderr: %s\", execResult.GetStdErrString())\n\t\t\t\ttime.Sleep(retryTimer)\n\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\tif !strings.Contains(execResult.GetStdOutString(), \"loaded initial configuration\") {\n\t\t\t\tlog.Debugf(\n\t\t\t\t\t\"Management server readiness files doesn't contain the marker string %s\",\n\t\t\t\t\texecResult.GetStdOutString(),\n\t\t\t\t)\n\t\t\t\ttime.Sleep(retryTimer)\n\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\tlog.Debugf(\"Node %s is ready to accept configs\", n.Cfg.ShortName)\n\n\t\t\treturn nil\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// checkKernelVersion emits a warning if the present kernel version is lower than the required one.\nfunc (*srl) checkKernelVersion() error {\n\t// retrieve running kernel version\n\tkv, err := clabutils.GetKernelVersion()\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\t// do the comparison\n\tif !kv.GreaterOrEqual(requiredKernelVersion) {\n\t\tlog.Infof(\n\t\t\t\"Nokia SR Linux v23.3.1+ requires a kernel version greater than %s. Detected kernel version: %s\",\n\t\t\trequiredKernelVersion,\n\t\t\tkv,\n\t\t)\n\t}\n\n\treturn nil\n}\n\nfunc (n *srl) CheckDeploymentConditions(ctx context.Context) error {\n\t// perform the srl specific kernel version check\n\terr := n.checkKernelVersion()\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\treturn n.DefaultNode.CheckDeploymentConditions(ctx)\n}\n\nfunc (n *srl) createSRLFiles() error {\n\tlog.Debugf(\"Creating directory structure for SRL container: %s\", n.Cfg.ShortName)\n\n\tvar src string\n\n\tif n.Cfg.License != \"\" {\n\t\t// copy license file to node specific directory in lab\n\t\tsrc = n.Cfg.License\n\n\t\tlicPath := filepath.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, \"license.key\")\n\t\tif err := clabutils.CopyFile(context.Background(), src, licPath,\n\t\t\tclabconstants.PermissionsFileDefault); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"CopyFile src %s -> dst %s failed %v\", src, licPath, err)\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tlog.Debugf(\"CopyFile src %s -> dst %s succeeded\", src, licPath)\n\t}\n\n\t// generate SRL topology file, including base MAC\n\terr := generateSRLTopologyFile(n.Cfg)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\tclabutils.CreateDirectory(path.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, \"config\"),\n\t\tclabconstants.PermissionsOpen)\n\n\t// create repository files (for yum/apt) that\n\t// are mounted to srl container during the init phase\n\terr = n.createRepoFiles()\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\t// generate a startup config file\n\t// if the node has a `startup-config:` statement, the file specified in that section\n\t// will be used as a template in GenerateConfig()\n\tvar cfgTemplate string\n\n\tcfgPath := filepath.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, \"config\", \"config.json\")\n\tif n.Cfg.StartupConfig != \"\" {\n\t\tlog.Debug(\"Reading startup-config\", \"file\", n.Cfg.StartupConfig)\n\n\t\tc, err := os.ReadFile(n.Cfg.StartupConfig)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn err\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tcBuf, err := clabutils.SubstituteEnvsAndTemplate(bytes.NewReader(c), n.Cfg)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn err\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// Determine if startup-config is a JSON file\n\t\t// Get slice of data with optional leading whitespace removed.\n\t\t// See RFC 7159, Section 2 for the definition of JSON whitespace.\n\t\tx := bytes.TrimLeft(cBuf.Bytes(), \" \\t\\r\\n\")\n\n\t\tisJSON := len(x) > 0 && x[0] == '{'\n\t\tif !isJSON {\n\t\t\tlog.Debugf(\n\t\t\t\t\"startup-config passed to %s is in the CLI format. Will apply it in post-deploy stage\",\n\t\t\t\tn.Cfg.ShortName,\n\t\t\t)\n\n\t\t\tn.startupCliCfg = cBuf.Bytes()\n\n\t\t\t// no need to generate and mount startup-config passed in a CLI format\n\t\t\t// as we will apply it over the top of a default config in the post deploy stage\n\t\t\treturn nil\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tcfgTemplate = cBuf.String()\n\t}\n\n\tif cfgTemplate == \"\" {\n\t\tlog.Debugf(\n\t\t\t\"configuration template for node %s is empty, skipping startup config file generation\",\n\t\t\tn.Cfg.ShortName,\n\t\t)\n\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\n\terr = n.GenerateConfig(cfgPath, cfgTemplate)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tlog.Errorf(\"node=%s, failed to generate config: %v\", n.Cfg.ShortName, err)\n\t}\n\n\treturn err\n}\n\n// srlTemplateData top level data struct.\ntype srlTemplateData struct {\n\tTLSKey     string\n\tTLSCert    string\n\tTLSAnchor  string\n\tTLSConfig  string\n\tBanner     string\n\tIFaces     map[string]tplIFace\n\tSSHPubKeys string\n\tMgmtMTU    int\n\tMgmtIPMTU  int\n\tDNSServers []string\n\t// EnableGNMIUnixSockServices enables GNMI unix socket services\n\t// for the node. This is needed for \"23.10 <= ver < 24.3\" versions\n\tEnableGNMIUnixSockServices bool\n\t// EnableCustomPrompt enables custom prompt with added newline\n\t// before the prompt.\n\tEnableCustomPrompt bool\n\tCustomPrompt       string\n\t// SNMPConfig is a string containing SNMP configuration\n\tSNMPConfig string\n\t// GRPCConfig is a string containing GRPC configuration\n\tGRPCConfig string\n\t// ACLConfig is a string containing ACL configuration\n\tACLConfig string\n\t// NetconfConfig is a string containing Netconf server configuration\n\tNetconfConfig string\n\t// EDAConfig is a string containing EDA configuration\n\tEDAConfig string\n\t// OCServerConfig is a string containing OpenConfig server configuration\n\tOCServerConfig string\n\t// NDKServerConfig is a string containing NDK server configuration\n\tNDKServerConfig string\n\t// DNSServersConfig is a string containing DNS servers configuration\n\tDNSServersConfig string\n}\n\n// tplIFace template interface struct.\ntype tplIFace struct {\n\tBaseName    string // base interface excl. breakout\n\tFullName    string // full interface name incl. breakout\n\tHasBreakout bool\n\tMtu         int\n\tIPv4        string\n\tIPv6        string\n}\n\n// addDefaultConfig adds srl default configuration such as tls certs, gnmi/json-rpc, login-banner.\nfunc (n *srl) addDefaultConfig(ctx context.Context) error {\n\tb, err := n.banner()\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\tvar dnsServers []string\n\tif n.Config().DNS != nil {\n\t\tdnsServers = n.Config().DNS.Servers\n\t}\n\n\t// tplData holds data used in templating of the default config snippet\n\ttplData := srlTemplateData{\n\t\tTLSKey:           n.Cfg.TLSKey,\n\t\tTLSCert:          n.Cfg.TLSCert,\n\t\tTLSAnchor:        n.Cfg.TLSAnchor,\n\t\tBanner:           b,\n\t\tIFaces:           map[string]tplIFace{},\n\t\tMgmtMTU:          0,\n\t\tMgmtIPMTU:        0,\n\t\tDNSServers:       dnsServers,\n\t\tSNMPConfig:       snmpv2Config,\n\t\tGRPCConfig:       grpcConfig,\n\t\tOCServerConfig:   \"\",\n\t\tNDKServerConfig:  \"\",\n\t\tDNSServersConfig: \"\",\n\t}\n\n\tif err := n.setVersionSpecificParams(&tplData); err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\tn.setCustomPrompt(&tplData)\n\n\t// set MgmtMTU to the MTU value of the runtime management network\n\t// so that the two MTUs match.\n\ttplData.MgmtIPMTU = n.Runtime.Mgmt().MTU\n\n\tif err := n.populateInterfaceConfig(&tplData); err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\tbuf := new(bytes.Buffer)\n\n\terr = srlCfgTpl.Execute(buf, tplData)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\tlog.Debugf(\"Node %q additional config:\\n%s\", n.Cfg.ShortName, buf.String())\n\n\t// Copy overlay config to container\n\ttmpFilePath, err := clabutils.WriteToTempFile(buf.String())\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\tdefer os.Remove(tmpFilePath)\n\n\terr = n.Runtime.CopyToContainer(ctx, n.Cfg.LongName, defaultCfgPath, 6: 	"sort"
7: 	"strings"
8: 
9: 	clabconstants "github.com/srl-labs/containerlab/constants"
10: 	clablabruntime "github.com/srl-labs/containerlab/labruntime"
11: 	clabruntime "github.com/srl-labs/containerlab/runtime"
12: )
13: 
14: type runtimeNodeGroup struct {
15: 	name               string
16: 	containers         []clabruntime.GenericContainer
17: 	distributed        bool
18: 	external           bool
19: 	rootNamespaceBased bool
20: }
21: 
22: func (c *CLab) runtimeNodeGroups(
23: 	ctx context.Context,
24: ) (map[string]*runtimeNodeGroup, error) {
25: 	containers, err := c.ListContainers(ctx, WithListLabName(c.Config.Name))
26: 	if err != nil {
27: 		return nil, err
28: 	}
29: 
30: 	result := make(map[string]*runtimeNodeGroup)
31: 	var duplicates []string
32: 
33: 	for _, ctr := range containers {
34: 		if ctr.Labels[clabconstants.ToolType] != "" {
35: 			continue
36: 		}
37: 
38: 		nodeName := ctr.Labels[clabconstants.NodeName]
39: 		if nodeName == "" {
40: 			continue
41: 		}
42: 
43: 		groupName := ctr.Labels[clabconstants.RootNodeName]
44: 		distributed := groupName != ""
45: 		if groupName == "" {
46: 			groupName = nodeName
47: 		}
48: 
49: 		group, exists := result[groupName]
50: 		if !exists {
51: 			group = &runtimeNodeGroup{
52: 				name:        groupName,
53: 				distributed: distributed,
54: 			}
55: 			result[groupName] = group
56: 		}
57: 		group.containers = append(group.containers, ctr)
58: 		group.distributed = group.distributed || distributed
59: 
60: 		if !group.distributed && len(group.containers) > 1 {
61: 			duplicates = append(duplicates, nodeName)
62: 			continue
63: 		}
64: 	}
65: 
66: 	// Pre-existing resources have no containerlab labels, but still participate in apply.
67: 	for nodeName, node := range c.Nodes {
68: 		cfg := node.Config()
69: 		if cfg == nil {
70: 			continue
71: 		}
72: 		if _, exists := result[nodeName]; exists {
73: 			continue
74: 		}
75: 		if cfg.IsRootNamespaceBased {
76: 			result[nodeName] = &runtimeNodeGroup{
77: 				name:               nodeName,
78: 				rootNamespaceBased: true,
79: 			}
80: 			continue
81: 		}
82: 		if !cfg.SkipUniquenessCheck || node.GetContainerStatus(ctx) == clabruntime.NotFound {
83: 			continue
84: 		}
85: 		result[nodeName] = &runtimeNodeGroup{name: nodeName, external: true}
86: 	}
87: 
88: 	if len(duplicates) > 0 {
89: 		sort.Strings(duplicates)
90: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf(
91: 			"apply supports only single-container nodes, found multiple containers for nodes: %s",
92: 			strings.Join(duplicates, ", "),
93: 		)
94: 	}
95: 
96: 	for _, group := range result {
97: 		sort.Slice(group.containers, func(i, j int) bool {
98: 			return runtimeContainerLess(group.containers[i], group.containers[j])
99: 		})
100: 	}
101: 
102: 	return result, nil
103: }
104: 
105: // NeedsInitialDeploy reports whether the lab has no runtime state yet, i.e. whether
106: // Deploy would perform a fresh deployment instead of reconciling a running lab.
107: func (c *CLab) NeedsInitialDeploy(ctx context.Context) (bool, error) {
108: 	if c.LabRuntime != nil {
109: 		checker, ok := c.LabRuntime.(clablabruntime.LabExistenceChecker)
110: 		if !ok {
111: 			return false, fmt.Errorf(
112: 				"lab runtime %q cannot determine whether the lab already exists",
113: 				c.globalRuntimeName,
114: 			)
115: 		}
116: 		exists, err := checker.LabExists(ctx, clablabruntime.InspectRequest{
117: 			Name:     c.Config.Name,
118: 			Identity: c.labRuntimeIdentity,
119: 		})
120: 
121: 		return !exists, err
122: 	}
123: 
124: 	currentNodes, err := c.runtimeNodeGroups(ctx)
125: 	if err != nil {
126: 		return false, err
127: 	}
128: 
129: 	return c.needsInitialDeploy(currentNodes)
130: }
131: 
132: func (c *CLab) needsInitialDeploy(currentNodes map[string]*runtimeNodeGroup) (bool, error) {
133: 	if len(currentNodes) == 0 {
134: 		return true, nil
135: 	}
136: 	for _, node := range currentNodes {
137: 		if !node.external && !node.rootNamespaceBased {
138: 			return false, nil
139: 		}
140: 	}
141: 
142: 	state, err := c.LoadState()
143: 	return state == nil, err
144: }
145: 
146: func (c *CLab) setMgmtBridgeFromRuntime(
147: 	currentNodes map[string]*runtimeNodeGroup,
148: ) error {
149: 	if c.Config.Mgmt.Bridge != "" {
150: 		return nil
151: 	}
152: 
153: 	var bridge string
154: 	for _, runtimeNode := range currentNodes {
155: 		for _, ctr := range runtimeNode.containers {
156: 			// only containers attached to the default management network, or
157: 			// without a runtime network, carry the default network's bridge
158: 			// label. Unknown networks, e.g. ones dropped from the mgmt list,
159: 			// must not contribute their bridge.
160: 			switch ctr.NetworkName {
161: 			case "", c.Config.Mgmt.Network:
162: 			default:
163: 				continue
164: 			}
165: 			ctrBridge := ctr.Labels[clabconstants.NodeMgmtNetBr]
166: 			if ctrBridge == "" {
167: 				continue
168: 			}
169: 			if bridge == "" {
170: 				bridge = ctrBridge
171: 				continue
172: 			}
173: 			if bridge != ctrBridge {
174: 				return fmt.Errorf(
175: 					"runtime lab has conflicting management bridge labels: %q and %q",
176: 					bridge,
177: 					ctrBridge,
178: 				)
179: 			}
180: 		}
181: 	}
182: 
183: 	if bridge != "" {
184: 		c.Config.Mgmt.Bridge = bridge
185: 	}
186: 
187: 	return nil
188: }
189: 
190: func (c *CLab) updateRuntimeInfoForExistingNodes(ctx context.Context) error {
191: 	for _, nodeName := range sortedNodeNames(c.Nodes) {
192: 		node := c.Nodes[nodeName]
193: 		if node.GetContainerStatus(ctx) == clabruntime.NotFound {
194: 			continue
195: 		}
196: 		if err := node.UpdateConfigWithRuntimeInfo(ctx); err != nil {
197: 			return fmt.Errorf("failed to update runtime info for node %q: %w", nodeName, err)
198: 		}
199: 	}
200: 
201: 	return nil
202: }
203: 
204: func sortedRuntimeNodeGroupNames(nodes map[string]*runtimeNodeGroup) []string {
205: 	names := make([]string, 0, len(nodes))
206: 	for name := range nodes {
207: 		names = append(names, name)
208: 	}
209: 	sort.Strings(names)
210: 	return names
211: }
212: 
213: func runtimeContainerNodeName(ctr clabruntime.GenericContainer) string {
214: 	if name := ctr.Labels[clabconstants.NodeName]; name != "" {
215: 		return name
216: 	}
217: 	if len(ctr.Names) > 0 {
218: 		return ctr.Names[0]
219: 	}
220: 	return ctr.ID
221: }
222: 
223: func runtimeContainerLess(a, b clabruntime.GenericContainer) bool {
224: 	// internal holders own the network namespace of the other containers in the group,
225: 	// so they sort first to be deleted last.
226: 	aInternal := a.Labels[clabconstants.InternalNode] == "true"
227: 	bInternal := b.Labels[clabconstants.InternalNode] == "true"
228: 	if aInternal != bInternal {
229: 		return aInternal
230: 	}
231: 
232: 	aName := runtimeContainerNodeName(a)
233: 	bName := runtimeContainerNodeName(b)
234: 
235: 	aOrder := runtimeComponentSortOrder(aName)
236: 	bOrder := runtimeComponentSortOrder(bName)
237: 	if aOrder != bOrder {
238: 		return aOrder < bOrder
239: 	}
240: 
241: 	return aName < bName
242: }
243: 
244: func runtimeComponentSortOrder(name string) int {
245: 	idx := strings.LastIndex(name, "-")
246: 	if idx < 0 || idx == len(name)-1 {
247: 		return 0
248: 	}
249: 
250: 	slot := strings.ToUpper(name[idx+1:])
251: 	if len(slot) == 1 && slot[0] >= 'A' && slot[0] <= 'Z' {
252: 		return 100 - int(slot[0])
253: 	}
254: 
255: 	var n int
256: 	for _, r := range slot {
257: 		if r < '0' || r > '9' {
258: 			return 0
259: 		}
260: 		n = n*10 + int(r-'0')
261: 	}
262: 
263: 	return n
264: }

Deploy would perform a fresh deployment instead of reconciling a running lab.\nfunc (c *CLab) NeedsInitialDeploy(ctx context.Context) (bool, error) {\n\tif c.LabRuntime != nil {\n\t\tchecker, ok := c.LabRuntime.(clablabruntime.LabExistenceChecker)\n\t\tif !ok {\n\t\t\treturn false, fmt.Errorf(\n\t\t\t\t\"lab runtime %q cannot determine whether the lab already exists\",\n\t\t\t\tc.globalRuntimeName,\n\t\t\t)\n\t\t}\n\t\texists, err := checker.LabExists(ctx, clablabruntime.InspectRequest{\n\t\t\tName:     c.Config.Name,\n\t\t\tIdentity: c.labRuntimeIdentity,\n\t\t})\n\n\t\treturn !exists, err\n\t}\n\n\tcurrentNodes, err := c.runtimeNodeGroups(ctx)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn false, err\n\t}\n\n\treturn c.needsInitialDeploy(currentNodes)\n}\n\nfunc (c *CLab) needsInitialDeploy(currentNodes map[string]*runtimeNodeGroup) (bool, error) {\n\tif len(currentNodes) == 0 {\n\t\treturn true, nil\n\t}\n\tfor *CLab) setMgmtBridgeFromRuntime(\n\tcurrentNodes map[string]*runtimeNodeGroup,\n) error {\n\tif c.Config.Mgmt.Bridge != \"\" {\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\n\tvar bridge string\n\tfor _, runtimeNode := range currentNodes {\n\t\tfor _, ctr := range runtimeNode.containers {\n\t\t\t// only containers attached to the default management network, or\n\t\t\t// without a runtime network, carry the default Unknown networks, e.g. ones dropped from the mgmt list,\n\t\t\t// must not contribute their bridge.\n\t\t\tswitch ctr.NetworkName {\n\t\t\tcase \"\", c.Config.Mgmt.Network:\n\t\t\tdefault:\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tctrBridge := ctr.Labels[clabconstants.NodeMgmtNetBr]\n\t\t\tif ctrBridge == \"\" {\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif bridge == \"\" {\n\t\t\t\tbridge = ctrBridge\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif bridge != ctrBridge {\n\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\n\t\t\t\t\t\"runtime lab has conflicting management bridge labels: %q and %q\",\n\t\t\t\t\tbridge,\n\t\t\t\t\tctrBridge,\n\t\t\t\t)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tif bridge != \"\" {\n\t\tc.Config.Mgmt.Bridge = bridge\n\t}\n\n\treturn nil\n}\n\nfunc (c *CLab) updateRuntimeInfoForExistingNodes(ctx context.Context) error {\n\tfor _, nodeName := range sortedNodeNames(c.Nodes) {\n\t\tnode := c.Nodes[nodeName]\n\t\tif node.GetContainerStatus(ctx) == clabruntime.NotFound {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tif err := node.UpdateConfigWithRuntimeInfo(ctx); 89: 	dn.InterfaceMappedPrefix = "eth"
90: 	dn.InterfaceOffset = 0
91: 	dn.FirstDataIfIndex = 0
92: 
93: 	return dn
94: }

187: func (d *DefaultNode) Deploy(ctx context.Context, _ *DeployParams) error {
188: 	// Set the "CLAB_INTFS" variable to the number of interfaces (endpoints) a node has.
189: 	// This env var does not count in the eth0 interface that is automatically created by the
190: 	// container runtime. This env var is used by some containers (e.g. vrnetlab systems) to
191: 	// postpone the startup until all interfaces
192: 	// have been added to the container namespace.
193: 	d.Config().Env[clabconstants.ClabEnvIntfs] = strconv.Itoa(len(d.GetEndpoints()))
194: 
195: 	// create the container
196: 	cID, err := d.Runtime.CreateContainer(ctx, d.Cfg)
197: 	if err != nil {
198: 		return err
199: 	}
200: 
201: 	// start the container
202: 	_, err = d.Runtime.StartContainer(ctx, cID, d)
203: 	if err != nil {
204: 		return err
205: 	}
206: 
207: 	// Update the nodes state
208: 	d.SetState(clabnodesstate.Deployed)
209: 
210: 	return nil
211: }

213: // GetNSPath retrieves the nodes nspath.
214: func (d *DefaultNode) GetNSPath(ctx context.Context) (string, error) {
215: 	var err error
216: 	nsp := ""
217: 
218: 	if d.Cfg.IsRootNamespaceBased {
219: 		netns, err := ns.GetCurrentNS()
220: 		if err != nil {
221: 			return "", err
222: 		}
223: 		nsp = netns.Path()
224: 	}
225: 	if nsp == "" {
226: 		nsp, err = d.Runtime.GetNSPath(ctx, d.OverwriteNode.GetContainerName())
227: 		if err != nil {
228: 			log.Errorf("Unable to determine NetNS Path for node %s: %v", d.Cfg.ShortName, err)
229: 			return "", err
230: 		}
231: 	}
232: 
233: 	return nsp, err
234: }

241: // LinkApplyMode returns the conservative default for node kinds that do not
242: // explicitly opt into live hotplug or restart handling.
243: func (d *DefaultNode) LinkApplyMode(ctx context.Context) LinkApplyMode {
244: 	if d.Cfg != nil && (d.Cfg.IsRootNamespaceBased || d.Cfg.SkipUniquenessCheck) {
245: 		return LinkApplyModeLive
246: 	}
247: 	return d.ImageLinkApplyMode(ctx, LinkApplyModeRecreate)
248: }

250: // ImageLinkApplyMode allows node kinds to keep their normal fallback behavior
251: // while opting into live link apply when their image declares support for it.
252: func (d *DefaultNode) ImageLinkApplyMode(
253: 	ctx context.Context,
254: 	fallback LinkApplyMode,
255: ) LinkApplyMode {
256: 	if d.imageHasBoxenVendorLabel(ctx) {
257: 		return LinkApplyModeLive
258: 	}
259: 
260: 	return fallback
261: }
262: 
263: func (d *DefaultNode) imageHasBoxenVendorLabel(ctx context.Context) bool {
264: 	if d == nil || d.Cfg == nil || d.Cfg.Image == "" {
265: 		return false
266: 	}
267: 	if d.Runtime == nil {
268: 		log.Debug("Skipping image label check for apply link hotplug support",
269: 			"image", d.Cfg.Image,
270: 			"reason", "node runtime is not initialized",
271: 		)
272: 		return false
273: 	}
274: 
275: 	inspect, err := d.Runtime.InspectImage(ctx, d.Cfg.Image)
276: 	if err != nil {
277: 		log.Debug("Failed to inspect image for apply link hotplug support",
278: 			"image", d.Cfg.Image,
279: 			"error", err,
280: 		)
281: 		return false
282: 	}
283: 	if inspect == nil || inspect.Config.Labels == nil {
284: 		return false
285: 	}
286: 
287: 	return inspect.Config.Labels[boxenImageVendorLabel] == boxenImageVendorValue
288: }

290: func (d *DefaultNode) ComputeDiff(oldCfg, newCfg *clabtypes.NodeConfig) *clabtypes.TopologyDiff {
291: 	diff := &clabtypes.TopologyDiff{}
292: 
293: 	if oldCfg == nil || newCfg == nil {
294: 		return diff
295: 	}
296: 
297: 	if oldCfg.NodeType != newCfg.NodeType {
298: 		diff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, "Type")
299: 	}
300: 	if oldCfg.Kind != newCfg.Kind {
301: 		diff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, "Kind")
302: 	}
303: 	if oldCfg.Image != newCfg.Image {
304: 		diff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, "Image")
305: 	}
306: 	if oldCfg.GetHostname() != newCfg.GetHostname() {
307: 		diff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, "Hostname")
308: 	}
309: 	if oldCfg.Entrypoint != newCfg.Entrypoint {
310: 		diff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, "Entrypoint")
311: 	}
312: 	if oldCfg.Cmd != newCfg.Cmd {
313: 		diff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, "Cmd")
314: 	}
315: 	if !clabutils.SlicesEqualOrBothEmpty(oldCfg.Exec, newCfg.Exec) {
316: 		diff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, "Exec")
317: 	}
318: 	if !clabutils.MapsEqualOrBothEmpty(oldCfg.Env, newCfg.Env) {
319: 		diff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, "Env")
320: 	}
321: 	if !clabutils.SlicesEqualOrBothEmpty(oldCfg.Binds, newCfg.Binds) {
322: 		diff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, "Binds")
323: 	}
324: 	if !clabutils.SlicesEqualOrBothEmpty(oldCfg.Devices, newCfg.Devices) {
325: 		diff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, "Devices")
326: 	}
327: 	if !clabutils.SlicesEqualOrBothEmpty(oldCfg.CapAdd, newCfg.CapAdd) {
328: 		diff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, "CapAdd")
329: 	}
330: 	if oldCfg.Privileged != newCfg.Privileged {
331: 		diff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, "Privileged")
332: 	}
333: 	if oldCfg.CgroupnsMode != newCfg.CgroupnsMode {
334: 		diff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, "CgroupnsMode")
335: 	}
336: 	if oldCfg.CgroupParent != newCfg.CgroupParent {
337: 		diff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, "CgroupParent")
338: 	}
339: 	if oldCfg.PidMode != newCfg.PidMode {
340: 		diff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, "PidMode")
341: 	}
342: 	if !clabutils.MapsEqualOrBothEmpty(oldCfg.Tmpfs, newCfg.Tmpfs) {
343: 		diff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, "Tmpfs")
344: 	}
345: 	if !clabutils.SlicesEqualOrBothEmpty(oldCfg.SecurityOpts, newCfg.SecurityOpts) {
346: 		diff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, "SecurityOpts")
347: 	}
348: 	if oldCfg.ShmSize != newCfg.ShmSize {
349: 		diff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, "ShmSize")
350: 	}
351: 	if !clabutils.PortSetsEqual(oldCfg.PortSet, newCfg.PortSet) {
352: 		diff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, "Ports")
353: 	}
354: 	if oldCfg.User != newCfg.User {
355: 		diff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, "User")
356: 	}
357: 	if oldCfg.NetworkMode != newCfg.NetworkMode {
358: 		diff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, "NetworkMode")
359: 	}
360: 	if oldCfg.MgmtNet != newCfg.MgmtNet {
361: 		diff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, "MgmtNet")
362: 	}
363: 	if oldCfg.Runtime != newCfg.Runtime {
364: 		diff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, "Runtime")
365: 	}
366: 	if oldCfg.CPU != newCfg.CPU {
367: 		diff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, "CPU")
368: 	}
369: 	if oldCfg.CPUSet != newCfg.CPUSet {
370: 		diff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, "CPUSet")
371: 	}
372: 	if oldCfg.Memory != newCfg.Memory {
373: 		diff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, "Memory")
374: 	}
375: 	if oldCfg.License != newCfg.License {
376: 		diff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, "License")
377: 	}
378: 	_, oldInvalid := oldCfg.KindSpecificConfig.(InvalidKindSpecificConfig)
379: 	_, newInvalid := newCfg.KindSpecificConfig.(InvalidKindSpecificConfig)
380: 
381: 	if oldInvalid || newInvalid ||
382: 		!reflect.DeepEqual(oldCfg.KindSpecificConfig, newCfg.KindSpecificConfig) {
383: 		diff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, "KindSpecificConfig")
384: 	}
385: 
386: 	return diff
387: }
388: 
389: func (d *DefaultNode) ComputeReconcilePlan(diff *clabtypes.TopologyDiff) *ReconcileResult {
390: 	result := &ReconcileResult{Action: clabtypes.TopologyDiffActionNone}
391: 
392: 	if diff == nil || !diff.HasDiff() {
393: 		return result
394: 	}
395: 
396: 	action := diff.DefaultAction()
397: 	result.Action = action
398: 
399: 	switch action {
400: 	case clabtypes.TopologyDiffActionRestart:
401: 		result.Restarted = []string{d.Cfg.LongName}
402: 	case clabtypes.TopologyDiffActionRecreate:
403: 		result.Recreated = []string{d.Cfg.LongName}
404: 	}
405: 
406: 	return result
407: }
408: 
409: func (d *DefaultNode) GetReconcilePlan(
410: 	_ context.Context,
411: 	diff *clabtypes.TopologyDiff,
412: ) (*ReconcileResult, error) {
413: 	return d.ComputeReconcilePlan(diff), nil
414: }
415: 
416: // Reconcile applies the diff and executes the appropriate action (restart/recreate).
417: func (d *DefaultNode) Reconcile(
418: 	ctx context.Context,
419: 	diff *clabtypes.TopologyDiff,
420: ) (*ReconcileResult, error) {
421: 	result := d.ComputeReconcilePlan(diff)
422: 
423: 	if result.Action == clabtypes.TopologyDiffActionNone {
424: 		return result, nil
425: 	}
426: 
427: 	log.Info(
428: 		"Applying node changes",
429: 		"node",
430: 		d.Cfg.ShortName,
431: 		"action",
432: 		result.Action,
433: 		"fields",
434: 		diff.Fields,
435: 	)
436: 
437: 	switch result.Action {
438: 	case clabtypes.TopologyDiffActionRestart:
439: 		if err := d.Stop(ctx); err != nil {
440: 			return result, fmt.Errorf("stop failed: %w", err)
441: 		}
442: 		if err := d.Start(ctx); err != nil {
443: 			return result, fmt.Errorf("start failed: %w", err)
444: 		}
445: 
446: 	case clabtypes.TopologyDiffActionRecreate:
447: 		if err := d.Delete(ctx); err != nil {
448: 			return result, fmt.Errorf("delete failed: %w", err)
449: 		}
450: 	}
451: 
452: 	return result, nil
453: }

472: func (d *DefaultNode) Delete(ctx context.Context) error {
473: 	for _, e := range d.Endpoints {
474: 		err := e.GetLink().Remove(ctx)
475: 		if err != nil {
476: 			return err
477: 		}
478: 	}
479: 
480: 	if d.OverwriteNode.GetContainerStatus(ctx) == clabruntime.NotFound {
481: 		return nil
482: 	}
483: 
484: 	return d.Runtime.DeleteContainer(ctx, d.OverwriteNode.GetContainerName())
485: }

493: func (d *DefaultNode) GetContainers(ctx context.Context) ([]clabruntime.GenericContainer, error) {
494: 	cnts, err := d.Runtime.ListContainers(ctx, []*clabtypes.GenericFilter{
495: 		{
496: 			FilterType: "name",
497: 			Match:      d.OverwriteNode.GetContainerName(),
498: 		},
499: 	})
500: 	if err != nil {
501: 		return nil, err
502: 	}
503: 	// check that we retrieved some container information
504: 	// otherwise throw ErrContainersNotFound error
505: 	if len(cnts) == 0 {
506: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf(
507: 			"Node: %s. %w",
508: 			d.OverwriteNode.GetContainerName(),
509: 			ErrContainersNotFound,
510: 		)
511: 	}
512: 
513: 	return cnts, err
514: }

516: func (d *DefaultNode) RunExecFromConfig(ctx context.Context, ec *clabexec.ExecCollection) error {
517: 	for _, e := range d.Config().Exec {
518: 		exec, err := clabexec.NewExecCmdFromString(e)
519: 		if err != nil {
520: 			log.Warnf("Failed to parse the command string: %s, %v", e, err)
521: 		}
522: 
523: 		res, err := d.OverwriteNode.RunExec(ctx, exec)
524: 		if err != nil {
525: 			// kinds which do not support exec functionality are skipped
526: 			continue
527: 		}
528: 
529: 		ec.Add(d.GetShortName(), res)
530: 	}
531: 	return nil
532: }

534: func (d *DefaultNode) UpdateConfigWithRuntimeInfo(ctx context.Context) error {
535: 	cnts, err := d.OverwriteNode.GetContainers(ctx)
536: 	if err != nil {
537: 		return err
538: 	}
539: 
540: 	if len(cnts) == 0 {
541: 		return fmt.Errorf("no container runtime information retrieved")
542: 	}
543: 
544: 	// network settings of a first container only
545: 	netSettings := cnts[0].NetworkSettings
546: 
547: 	d.Cfg.MgmtIPv4Address = netSettings.IPv4addr
548: 	d.Cfg.MgmtIPv4PrefixLength = netSettings.IPv4pLen
549: 	d.Cfg.MgmtIPv6Address = netSettings.IPv6addr
550: 	d.Cfg.MgmtIPv6PrefixLength = netSettings.IPv6pLen
551: 	d.Cfg.MgmtIPv4Gateway = netSettings.IPv4Gw
552: 	d.Cfg.MgmtIPv6Gateway = netSettings.IPv6Gw
553: 
554: 	d.Cfg.ContainerID = cnts[0].ID
555: 
556: 	d.Cfg.ResultingPortBindings = cnts[0].Ports
557: 
558: 	return nil
559: }

567: func (d *DefaultNode) CheckInterfaceOverlap() error {
568: 	var seenEps []clablinks.Endpoint
569: 
570: 	for _, ep := range d.Endpoints {
571: 		ifName := ep.GetIfaceName()
572: 		for _, seenEp := range seenEps {
573: 			if ifName == seenEp.GetIfaceName() {
574: 				return fmt.Errorf("%q and %q have overlapping interface names", ep, seenEp)
575: 			}
576: 		}
577: 		seenEps = append(seenEps, ep)
578: 	}
579: 
580: 	return nil
581: }

583: // CheckInterfaceName checks if a name of the interface referenced in the topology file is in the
584: // expected range of name values.
585: // A no-op for the default node, specific nodes should implement this method.
586: func (d *DefaultNode) CheckInterfaceName() error {
587: 	return d.CheckInterfaceOverlap()
588: }

590: // CalculateInterfaceIndex parses the supplied interface name with the InterfaceRegexp.
591: // Using the the port offset, it calculates the mapped interface index based on the InterfaceOffset
592: // and the first data interface index.
593: func (d *DefaultNode) CalculateInterfaceIndex(ifName string) (int, error) {
594: 	captureGroups, err := clabutils.GetRegexpCaptureGroups(d.InterfaceRegexp, ifName)
595: 	if err != nil {
596: 		return 0, err
597: 	}
598: 
599: 	if parsedIndex, found := captureGroups["port"]; found {
600: 		parsedIndexInt, err := strconv.Atoi(parsedIndex)
601: 		if err != nil {
602: 			return 0, fmt.Errorf(
603: 				"%q parsed index %q could not be cast to an integer",
604: 				ifName,
605: 				parsedIndex,
606: 			)
607: 		}
608: 		calculatedIndex := parsedIndexInt - d.InterfaceOffset + d.FirstDataIfIndex
609: 		return calculatedIndex, nil
610: 	} else {
611: 		return 0, fmt.Errorf(
612: 			"%q does not have extracted interface index with regexp %q, 'port' capture group missing?",
613: 			ifName,
614: 			d.InterfaceRegexp,
615: 		)
616: 	}
617: }
618: 
619: // GetMappedInterfaceName returns with a mapped interface name based on the mapped interface prefix
620: // and calculated mapped interface index.
621: func (d *DefaultNode) GetMappedInterfaceName(ifName string) (string, error) {
622: 	ifIndex, err := d.OverwriteNode.CalculateInterfaceIndex(ifName)
623: 	if err != nil {
624: 		return "", err
625: 	}
626: 	if ifIndex < d.FirstDataIfIndex {
627: 		return "", fmt.Errorf(
628: 			"extracted interface index for %q is out of bounds: %d ! >= %d",
629: 			ifName,
630: 			ifIndex,
631: 			d.FirstDataIfIndex,
632: 		)
633: 	}
634: 	mappedIfName := fmt.Sprintf("%s%d", d.InterfaceMappedPrefix, ifIndex)
635: 
636: 	return mappedIfName, nil
637: }
638: 
639: // VerifyStartupConfig verifies that startup config files exists on disks.
640: func (d *DefaultNode) VerifyStartupConfig(topoDir string) error {
641: 	cfg := d.Config().StartupConfig
642: 	if cfg == "" {
643: 		return nil
644: 	}
645: 
646: 	rcfg := clabutils.ResolvePath(cfg, topoDir)
647: 	if !clabutils.FileExists(rcfg) {
648: 		return fmt.Errorf("node %q startup-config file not found by the path %s",
649: 			d.OverwriteNode.GetContainerName(), rcfg)
650: 	}
651: 
652: 	return nil
653: }
654: 
655: // GenerateConfig generates configuration for the nodes
656: // out of the template `t` based on the node configuration and saves the result to dst.
657: // If the config file is already present in the node dir we do not regenerate the config unless
658: // EnforceStartupConfig is explicitly set to true and startup-config points to a file this will
659: // persist the changes that users make to a running config when booted from some startup config.
660: func (d *DefaultNode) GenerateConfig(dst, t string) error {
661: 	// Check for incompatible options
662: 	if d.Cfg.EnforceStartupConfig && d.Cfg.SuppressStartupConfig {
663: 		return ErrIncompatibleOptions
664: 	}
665: 	if d.Cfg.EnforceStartupConfig && d.Cfg.StartupConfig == "" {
666: 		return ErrNoStartupConfig
667: 	}
668: 
669: 	if d.Cfg.SuppressStartupConfig {
670: 		log.Info("Startup config generation suppressed", "node", d.Cfg.ShortName)
671: 		return nil
672: 	}
673: 
674: 	if !d.Cfg.EnforceStartupConfig && clabutils.FileExists(dst) {
675: 		log.Debug("Existing config found", "node", d.Cfg.ShortName, "path", dst)
676: 		return nil
677: 	} else {
678: 		log.Debug("Generating config", "node", d.Cfg.ShortName, "file", d.Cfg.StartupConfig)
679: 
680: 		cfgBuf, err := clabutils.SubstituteEnvsAndTemplate(strings.NewReader(t), d.Cfg)
681: 		if err != nil {
682: 			return err
683: 		}
684: 		log.Debug("Generated config", "node", d.Cfg.ShortName, "content", cfgBuf.String())
685: 
686: 		f, err := os.Create(dst)
687: 		if err != nil {
688: 			return err
689: 		}
690: 		defer f.Close()
691: 
692: 		_, err = f.Write(cfgBuf.Bytes())
693: 		if err != nil {
694: 			return err
695: 		}
696: 	}
697: 
698: 	return nil
699: }

701: // NodeOverwrites is an interface that every node implements.
702: // It is used to enable DefaultNode to get access to the particular node structs
703: // and is provided as an argument of the NewDefaultNode function.
704: // The methods defined for this interfaces are the methods that particular node has a custom
705: // implementation of.
706: type NodeOverwrites interface {
707: 	VerifyStartupConfig(topoDir string) error
708: 	CheckInterfaceName() error
709: 	CalculateInterfaceIndex(ifName string) (int, error)
710: 	GetMappedInterfaceName(ifName string) (string, error)
711: 	VerifyHostRequirements() error
712: 	PullImage(ctx context.Context) error
713: 	GetImages(ctx context.Context) map[string]string
714: 	GetContainers(ctx context.Context) ([]clabruntime.GenericContainer, error)
715: 	GetContainerName() string
716: 	GetContainerStatus(ctx context.Context) clabruntime.ContainerStatus
717: 	VerifyContainerName() error
718: 	VerifyLicenseFileExists(context.Context) error
719: 	PreStop(context.Context) error
720: 	RunExec(context.Context, *clabexec.ExecCmd) (*clabexec.ExecResult, error)
721: 	GetNSPath(ctx context.Context) (string, error)
722: }
723: 
724: // LoadStartupConfigFileVr templates a startup-config using the file specified for VM-based nodes in
725: // the topo
726: // and puts the resulting config file by the LabDir/configDirName/startupCfgFName path.
727: func LoadStartupConfigFileVr(node Node, configDirName, startupCfgFName string) error {
728: 	nodeCfg := node.Config()
729: 	// create config directory that will be bind mounted to vrnetlab container at / path
730: 	clabutils.CreateDirectory(path.Join(nodeCfg.LabDir, configDirName),
731: 		clabconstants.PermissionsOpen)
732: 
733: 	if nodeCfg.StartupConfig != "" {
734: 		// dstCfg is a path to a file on the clab host that will have rendered configuration
735: 		dstCfg := filepath.Join(nodeCfg.LabDir, configDirName, startupCfgFName)
736: 
737: 		c, err := os.ReadFile(nodeCfg.StartupConfig)
738: 		if err != nil {
739: 			return err
740: 		}
741: 
742: 		cfgTemplate := string(c)
743: 
744: 		err = node.GenerateConfig(dstCfg, cfgTemplate)
745: 		if err != nil {
746: 			log.Errorf("node=%s, failed to generate config: %v", nodeCfg.ShortName, err)
747: 		}
748: 	}
749: 	return nil
750: }

754: // use long (prefixed) name.

756: 	return d.Cfg.LongName

759: func (d *DefaultNode) VerifyContainerName() error {
760: 	containerName := d.OverwriteNode.GetContainerName()
761: 	if !containerNamePatternRe.MatchString(containerName) {
762: 		return fmt.Errorf("Node name contains invalid characters: %s", containerName)
763: 	}
764: 
765: 	if len(containerName) > maxNameLength {
766: 		log.Warn(
767: 			"Node name will not resolve via DNS",
768: 			"name",
769: 			containerName,
770: 			"reason",
771: 			fmt.Sprintf("name exceeds %d characters", maxNameLength),
772: 		)
773: 	}
774: 
775: 	if strings.ContainsAny(containerName, dnsIncompatibleChars) {
776: 		log.Warn(
777: 			"Node name will not resolve via DNS",
778: 			"name",
779: 			containerName,
780: 			"reason",
781: 			"name contains invalid characters such as '.' and/or '_'",
782: 		)
783: 	}
784: 
785: 	return nil
786: }

788: // RunExec executes a single command for a node.
789: func (d *DefaultNode) RunExec(
790: 	ctx context.Context,
791: 	execCmd *clabexec.ExecCmd,
792: ) (*clabexec.ExecResult, error) {
793: 	execResult, err := d.GetRuntime().Exec(ctx, d.OverwriteNode.GetContainerName(), execCmd)
794: 	if err != nil {
795: 		log.Errorf("%s: failed to execute cmd: %q with error %v",
796: 			d.OverwriteNode.GetContainerName(), execCmd.GetCmdString(), err)
797: 		return nil, err
798: 	}
799: 	return execResult, nil
800: }

802: // RunExecNotWait executes a command for a node, and doesn't block waiting for the output.

804: func (d *DefaultNode) RunExecNotWait(ctx context.Context, execCmd *clabexec.ExecCmd) error {
805: 	err := d.GetRuntime().ExecNotWait(ctx, d.OverwriteNode.GetContainerName(), execCmd)
806: 	if err != nil {

808: 			d.OverwriteNode.GetContainerName(), execCmd.GetCmdString(), err)
809: 		return err
810: 	}
811: 	return nil
812: }

814: // VerifyLicenseFileExists checks if a license file with a provided path exists.
815: func (d *DefaultNode) VerifyLicenseFileExists(_ context.Context) error {
816: 	if d.Config().License == "" {
817: 		switch d.LicensePolicy {
818: 		// if a license is required by the kind but not provided
819: 		case clabtypes.LicensePolicyRequired:
820: 			return fmt.Errorf(
821: 				"node %s of kind %s requires a license. Provide one via 'license' knob in the topology file",
822: 				d.Config().ShortName,
823: 				d.Cfg.Kind,
824: 			)
825: 		case clabtypes.LicensePolicyWarn:
826: 			// just warn when no license is provided
827: 			log.Warnf(
828: 				"node %s of kind %s requires a license. Make sure to provide it in some way (e.g. license knob or baked into image)",
829: 				d.Config().ShortName,
830: 				d.Cfg.Kind,
831: 			)
832: 			return nil
833: 		case clabtypes.LicensePolicyNone:
834: 			// license is not required
835: 			return nil
836: 		default:
837: 			return fmt.Errorf("unknown license policy value %s for node %s kind %s",
838: 				d.LicensePolicy, d.Config().ShortName, d.Cfg.Kind)
839: 		}
840: 	}
841: 	// if license is provided check path exists
842: 	rlic := clabutils.ResolvePath(d.Config().License, d.Cfg.LabDir)
843: 	if !clabutils.FileExists(rlic) {
844: 		return fmt.Errorf(
845: 			"license file for node %q is not found by the path %s",
846: 			d.Config().ShortName,
847: 			rlic,
848: 		)
849: 	}
850: 
851: 	return nil
852: }

854: // LoadOrGenerateCertificate loads a certificate using a certificate storage provider
855: // provided in certInfra or generates a new one if it does not exist.
856: func (d *DefaultNode) LoadOrGenerateCertificate(
857: 	certInfra *clabcert.Cert,
858: 	topoName string,
859: ) (nodeCert *clabcert.Certificate, err error) {
860: 	// early return if certificate generation is not required
861: 	if d.Cfg.Certificate == nil || !*d.Cfg.Certificate.Issue {
862: 		return nil, nil
863: 	}
864: 
865: 	nodeConfig := d.Cfg
866: 
867: 	// try loading existing certificates from disk and generate new ones if they do not exist
868: 	nodeCert, err = certInfra.LoadNodeCert(nodeConfig.ShortName)
869: 	if err != nil {
870: 		log.Debugf("creating node certificate for %s", nodeConfig.ShortName)
871: 
872: 		hosts := []string{
873: 			nodeConfig.ShortName,
874: 			nodeConfig.LongName,
875: 			nodeConfig.ShortName + "." + topoName + ".io",
876: 		}
877: 		// add the SANs provided via config
878: 		hosts = append(hosts, nodeConfig.Certificate.SANs...)
879: 
880: 		// add mgmt IPs as SANs to CSR
881: 		for _, ip := range []string{d.Cfg.MgmtIPv4Address, d.Cfg.MgmtIPv6Address} {
882: 			if ip != "" {
883: 				hosts = append(hosts, ip)
884: 			}
885: 		}
886: 
887: 		certInput := &clabcert.NodeCSRInput{
888: 			CommonName:   nodeConfig.ShortName + "." + topoName + ".io",
889: 			Hosts:        hosts,
890: 			Organization: "containerlab",
891: 			Country:      "US",
892: 			KeySize:      d.Cfg.Certificate.KeySize,
893: 			Expiry:       d.Cfg.Certificate.ValidityDuration,
894: 		}
895: 		// Generate the cert for the node
896: 		nodeCert, err = certInfra.GenerateAndSignNodeCert(certInput)
897: 		if err != nil {
898: 			return nil, err
899: 		}
900: 
901: 		// persist the cert via certStorage
902: 		err = certInfra.StoreNodeCert(nodeConfig.ShortName, nodeCert)
903: 		if err != nil {
904: 			return nil, err
905: 		}
906: 	}
907: 
908: 	return nodeCert, nil
909: }

911: func (d *DefaultNode) GetHostsEntries(ctx context.Context) (clabtypes.HostEntries, error) {
912: 	containers, err := d.OverwriteNode.GetContainers(ctx)
913: 	if err != nil {
914: 		return nil, err
915: 	}
916: 
917: 	result := clabtypes.HostEntries{}
918: 
919: 	for idx := range containers {
920: 		if len(containers[idx].Names) == 0 {
921: 			continue
922: 		}
923: 		if containers[idx].NetworkSettings.IPv4addr != "" {
924: 			result = append(result, clabtypes.NewHostEntry(
925: 				containers[idx].NetworkSettings.IPv4addr,
926: 				containers[idx].Names[0],
927: 				clabtypes.IpVersionV4,
928: 			).SetDescription(fmt.Sprintf("Kind: %s", d.Cfg.Kind)).SetContainerID(containers[idx].ID))
929: 		}
930: 		if containers[idx].NetworkSettings.IPv6addr != "" {
931: 			result = append(result, clabtypes.NewHostEntry(
932: 				containers[idx].NetworkSettings.IPv6addr,
933: 				containers[idx].Names[0],
934: 				clabtypes.IpVersionV6,
935: 			).SetDescription(fmt.Sprintf("Kind: %s", d.Cfg.Kind)).SetContainerID(containers[idx].ID))
936: 		}
937: 	}
938: 	return result, nil
939: }

941: func (d *DefaultNode) AddLinkToContainer(
942: 	ctx context.Context,
943: 	link netlink.Link,
944: 	f func(ns.NetNS) error,
945: ) error {
946: 	if !d.Cfg.IsRootNamespaceBased {
947: 		st := d.OverwriteNode.GetContainerStatus(ctx)
948: 		if !clabruntime.ContainerHasJoinableNetns(st) {
949: 			if st == clabruntime.Stopped {
950: 				containerName := d.OverwriteNode.GetContainerName()
951: 				d.GetRuntime().LogNonRunningContainerOutput(ctx, containerName)
952: 			}
953: 			return fmt.Errorf(
954: 				"node %q: cannot attach link, container network namespace is not available (status=%s)",
955: 				d.Cfg.ShortName,
956: 				st,
957: 			)
958: 		}
959: 	}
960: 	// retrieve nodes nspath
961: 	nsp, err := d.OverwriteNode.GetNSPath(ctx)
962: 	if err != nil {
963: 		return err
964: 	}
965: 	// retrieve the namespace handle
966: 	netns, err := ns.GetNS(nsp)
967: 	if err != nil {
968: 		return err
969: 	}
970: 	// move veth endpoint to namespace
971: 	if err := netlink.LinkSetNsFd(link, int(netns.Fd())); err != nil {
972: 		return err
973: 	}
974: 	// execute the given function
975: 	err = netns.Do(f)
976: 	if err != nil {
977: 		return err
978: 	}
979: 	return nil
980: }
981: 
982: // ExecFunction executes the given function in the nodes network namespace.
983: func (d *DefaultNode) ExecFunction(ctx context.Context, f func(ns.NetNS) error) error {
984: 	if !d.Cfg.IsRootNamespaceBased {
985: 		st := d.OverwriteNode.GetContainerStatus(ctx)
986: 		if !clabruntime.ContainerHasJoinableNetns(st) {
987: 			if st == clabruntime.Stopped {
988: 				containerName := d.OverwriteNode.GetContainerName()
989: 				d.GetRuntime().LogNonRunningContainerOutput(ctx, containerName)
990: 			}
991: 			return fmt.Errorf(
992: 				"node %q: cannot exec a command, container network namespace is not available (status=%s)",
993: 				d.Cfg.ShortName,
994: 				st,
995: 			)
996: 		}
997: 	}
998: 	// retrieve nodes nspath
999: 	nspath, err := d.OverwriteNode.GetNSPath(ctx)
1000: 	if err != nil {
1001: 		return err
1002: 	}
1003: 
1004: 	if d.Cfg.IsRootNamespaceBased {
1005: 		nshandle, err := ns.GetCurrentNS()
1006: 		if err != nil {
1007: 			return err
1008: 		}
1009: 		nspath = nshandle.Path()
1010: 	}
1011: 
1012: 	if nspath == "" {
1013: 		return fmt.Errorf("nspath is not set for node %q", d.GetShortName())
1014: 	}
1015: 
1016: 	// retrieve the namespace handle
1017: 	netns, err := ns.GetNS(nspath)
1018: 	if err != nil {
1019: 		return err
1020: 	}
1021: 	// execute the given function
1022: 	return netns.Do(f)
1023: }

1025: // AddEndpoint maps the endpoint name to before adding it to the node endpoints if it matches the
1026: // interface alias regexp. Returns an error if the mapping goes wrong.
1027: func (d *DefaultNode) AddEndpoint(e clablinks.Endpoint) error {
1028: 	endpointName := e.GetIfaceName()
1029: 	if d.InterfaceRegexp != nil && d.InterfaceRegexp.MatchString(endpointName) {
1030: 		mappedName, err := d.OverwriteNode.GetMappedInterfaceName(endpointName)
1031: 		if err != nil {
1032: 			return fmt.Errorf(
1033: 				"%q interface name %q could not be mapped: %w",
1034: 				d.Cfg.ShortName,
1035: 				e.GetIfaceName(),
1036: 				err,
1037: 			)
1038: 		}
1039: 		log.Debugf(
1040: 			"Interface Mapping: Mapping interface %q (ifAlias) to %q (ifName)",
1041: 			endpointName,
1042: 			mappedName,
1043: 		)
1044: 		e.SetIfaceName(mappedName)
1045: 		e.SetIfaceAlias(endpointName)
1046: 	}
1047: 
1048: 	if e.GetNode() == nil {
1049: 		e.SetNode(d)
1050: 	}
1051: 
1052: 	d.Endpoints = append(d.Endpoints, e)
1053: 	return nil
1054: }
1055: 
1056: func (d *DefaultNode) AdoptEndpoint(e clablinks.Endpoint) error {
1057: 	if e == nil {
1058: 		return fmt.Errorf("node %q cannot adopt a nil endpoint", d.Cfg.ShortName)
1059: 	}
1060: 
1061: 	owner := e.GetNode()
1062: 	if owner == nil {
1063: 		return fmt.Errorf(
1064: 			"node %q cannot adopt endpoint %q without an owner",
1065: 			d.Cfg.ShortName,
1066: 			e.GetIfaceName(),
1067: 		)
1068: 	}
1069: 
1070: 	if owner.GetShortName() != d.Cfg.ShortName {
1071: 		return fmt.Errorf(
1072: 			"node %q cannot adopt endpoint %q owned by %q",
1073: 			d.Cfg.ShortName,
1074: 			e.GetIfaceName(),
1075: 			owner.GetShortName(),
1076: 		)
1077: 	}
1078: 
1079: 	for _, owned := range d.Endpoints {
1080: 		if owned == e {
1081: 			return nil
1082: 		}
1083: 		if owned.GetIfaceName() == e.GetIfaceName() {
1084: 			return fmt.Errorf(
1085: 				"node %q already tracks interface %q",
1086: 				d.Cfg.ShortName,
1087: 				e.GetIfaceName(),
1088: 			)
1089: 		}
1090: 	}
1091: 
1092: 	d.Endpoints = append(d.Endpoints, e)
1093: 
1094: 	return nil
1095: }
1096: 
1097: func (d *DefaultNode) ReleaseEndpoint(e clablinks.Endpoint) error {
1098: 	for i, ep := range d.Endpoints {
1099: 		if ep != e {
1100: 			continue
1101: 		}
1102: 
1103: 		d.Endpoints = append(d.Endpoints[:i], d.Endpoints[i+1:]...)
1104: 		return nil
1105: 	}
1106: 
1107: 	return fmt.Errorf("node %q does not own endpoint %q", d.Cfg.ShortName, e.GetIfaceName())
1108: }

1168: // ParkEndpoints moves all tracked endpoints into the node-owned parking namespace.
1169: func (d *DefaultNode) ParkEndpoints(ctx context.Context) error {
1170: 	parkPath, err := clabutils.CreateOrGetNamedNetNS(d.parkingNetNSName())
1171: 	if err != nil {
1172: 		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create parking netns for node %q: %w", d.Cfg.ShortName, err)
1173: 	}
1174: 	// Reuse the parking node retained by a failed restore so it keeps the parked endpoints.
1175: 	parkingNode := d.parkingNode
1176: 	reused := parkingNode != nil
1177: 	if !reused {
1178: 		parkingNode = clablinks.NewParkingNode(d.Cfg.LongName, parkPath)
1179: 	}
1180: 
1181: 	if err := parkingNode.CaptureFrom(ctx, d); err != nil {
1182: 		if !reused {
1183: 			_ = d.cleanupParkingNetNS()
1184: 		}
1185: 		return err
1186: 	}
1187: 
1188: 	if err := parkingNode.RepointSymlink(); err != nil {
1189: 		repointErr := fmt.Errorf("failed to repoint symlink for node %q: %w", d.Cfg.ShortName, err)
1190: 		if _, restoreErr := parkingNode.RestoreTo(ctx, d); restoreErr != nil {
1191: 			// Keep the parking netns and its endpoints so a later restore can recover them.
1192: 			d.parkingNode = parkingNode
1193: 			return errors.Join(repointErr, restoreErr)
1194: 		}
1195: 		d.parkingNode = nil
1196: 		if cleanupErr := d.cleanupParkingNetNS(); cleanupErr != nil {
1197: 			return errors.Join(repointErr, cleanupErr)
1198: 		}
1199: 		return repointErr
1200: 	}
1201: 	d.parkingNode = parkingNode
1202: 
1203: 	return nil
1204: }
1205: 
1206: // RestoreEndpoints tries to get the parking node to unpark its interfaces.
1207: func (d *DefaultNode) RestoreEndpoints(ctx context.Context) error {
1208: 	parkPath, err := d.parkingNetNSPath()
1209: 	if err != nil {
1210: 		// No parking netns means the node had no parked interfaces - e.g. it was
1211: 		// stopped outside of containerlab (so its interfaces were never parked) or
1212: 		// it has no dataplane links. Nothing to restore.
1213: 		d.parkingNode = nil
1214: 		log.Debugf("node %q has no parking netns, nothing to restore", d.Cfg.ShortName)
1215: 		return nil
1216: 	}
1217: 	parkingNode := d.parkingNode
1218: 	if parkingNode == nil {
1219: 		parkingNode = clablinks.NewParkingNode(d.Cfg.LongName, parkPath)
1220: 	}
1221: 
1222: 	restored, err := parkingNode.RestoreTo(ctx, d)
1223: 	if err != nil {
1224: 		return err
1225: 	}
1226: 
1227: 	for _, ep := range restored {
1228: 		log.Info("Restored link", "node", d.Cfg.ShortName, "interface", ep.GetIfaceName())
1229: 	}
1230: 
1231: 	if err := d.cleanupParkingNetNS(); err != nil {
1232: 		return fmt.Errorf("failed to cleanup parking netns for node %q: %w", d.Cfg.ShortName, err)
1233: 	}
1234: 	d.parkingNode = nil
1235: 
1236: 	return nil
1237: }
1238: 
1239: func (d *DefaultNode) Stop(ctx context.Context) error {
1240: 	cfg := d.Config()
1241: 
1242: 	if d.ShouldSkipLifecycle() {
1243: 		log.Debugf("node %q skips lifecycle stop", cfg.ShortName)
1244: 		return nil
1245: 	}
1246: 
1247: 	status := d.OverwriteNode.GetContainerStatus(ctx)
1248: 	switch status {
1249: 	case clabruntime.Stopped:
1250: 		log.Debugf("node %q already stopped, skipping", cfg.ShortName)
1251: 		return nil
1252: 	case clabruntime.NotFound:
1253: 		return fmt.Errorf("node %q container %q not found", cfg.ShortName, cfg.LongName)
1254: 	}
1255: 
1256: 	if err := d.OverwriteNode.PreStop(ctx); err != nil {
1257: 		return fmt.Errorf("node %q pre-stop hook failed: %w", cfg.ShortName, err)
1258: 	}
1259: 
1260: 	if err := d.ParkEndpoints(ctx); err != nil {
1261: 		return err
1262: 	}
1263: 
1264: 	if err := d.Runtime.StopContainer(ctx, cfg.LongName, d.StopSignal); err != nil {
1265: 		// Docker/podman may return an error while the container is already stopped.
1266: 		// if ctr is already stopped, this is OK
1267: 		if d.OverwriteNode.GetContainerStatus(ctx) == clabruntime.Stopped {
1268: 			log.Warnf(
1269: 				"node %q stop returned error but container is stopped: %v",
1270: 				cfg.ShortName,
1271: 				err,
1272: 			)
1273: 			return nil
1274: 		}
1275: 
1276: 		if restoreErr := d.RestoreEndpoints(ctx); restoreErr != nil {
1277: 			return errors.Join(
1278: 				fmt.Errorf("node %q failed stopping container: %w", cfg.ShortName, err),
1279: 				fmt.Errorf("failed to restore endpoints: %w", restoreErr),
1280: 			)
1281: 		}
1282: 
1283: 		return fmt.Errorf("node %q failed stopping container: %w", cfg.ShortName, err)
1284: 	}
1285: 
1286: 	return nil
1287: }
1288: 
1289: // Start restarts a stopped container and restores its parked dataplane interfaces.
1290: func (d *DefaultNode) Start(ctx context.Context) error {
1291: 	cfg := d.Config()
1292: 
1293: 	if d.ShouldSkipLifecycle() {
1294: 		log.Debugf("node %q skips lifecycle start", cfg.ShortName)
1295: 		return nil
1296: 	}
1297: 
1298: 	status := d.OverwriteNode.GetContainerStatus(ctx)
1299: 
1300: 	switch status {
1301: 	case clabruntime.Running:
1302: 		log.Debugf("node %q already running, skipping", cfg.ShortName)
1303: 		return nil
1304: 	case clabruntime.NotFound:
1305: 		return fmt.Errorf("node %q container %q not found", cfg.ShortName, cfg.LongName)
1306: 	}
1307: 
1308: 	if _, err := d.Runtime.StartContainer(ctx, cfg.LongName, d); err != nil {
1309: 		return fmt.Errorf("node %q failed starting container: %w", cfg.ShortName, err)
1310: 	}
1311: 
1312: 	if err := d.RestoreEndpoints(ctx); err != nil {
1313: 		_ = d.Runtime.StopContainer(ctx, cfg.LongName, d.StopSignal)
1314: 		return err
1315: 	}
1316: 
1317: 	// Re-run topology exec commands on lifecycle start to restore node-local interface config
1318: 	// (for example IP addresses added during deploy exec phase).
1319: 	execCollection := clabexec.NewExecCollection()
1320: 	if err := d.RunExecFromConfig(ctx, execCollection); err != nil {
1321: 		log.Errorf(
1322: 			"failed to run exec commands for node %q on lifecycle start: %v",
1323: 			cfg.ShortName,
1324: 			err,
1325: 		)
1326: 	}
1327: 	execCollection.Log()
1328: 
1329: 	return nil
1330: }
