support\",\n\t\t\t\"image\", d.Cfg.Image,\n\t\t\t\"error\", err,\n\t\t)\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\tif inspect == nil || inspect.Config.Labels == nil {\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\n\treturn inspect.Config.Labels[boxenImageVendorLabel] == boxenImageVendorValue\n}\n\nfunc (d *DefaultNode) ComputeDiff(oldCfg, newCfg *clabtypes.NodeConfig) *clabtypes.TopologyDiff {\n\tdiff := &clabtypes.TopologyDiff{}\n\n\tif oldCfg == nil || newCfg == nil {\n\t\treturn diff\n\t}\n\n\tif oldCfg.NodeType != newCfg.NodeType {\n\t\tdiff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, \"Type\")\n\t}\n\tif oldCfg.Kind != newCfg.Kind {\n\t\tdiff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, \"Kind\")\n\t}\n\tif oldCfg.Image != newCfg.Image {\n\t\tdiff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, \"Image\")\n\t}\n\tif oldCfg.GetHostname() != newCfg.GetHostname() {\n\t\tdiff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, \"Hostname\")\n\t}\n\tif oldCfg.Entrypoint != newCfg.Entrypoint {\n\t\tdiff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, \"Entrypoint\")\n\t}\n\tif oldCfg.Cmd != newCfg.Cmd {\n\t\tdiff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, \"Cmd\")\n\t}\n\tif !clabutils.SlicesEqualOrBothEmpty(oldCfg.Exec, newCfg.Exec) {\n\t\tdiff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, \"Exec\")\n\t}\n\tif !clabutils.MapsEqualOrBothEmpty(oldCfg.Env, newCfg.Env) {\n\t\tdiff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, \"Env\")\n\t}\n\tif !clabutils.SlicesEqualOrBothEmpty(oldCfg.Binds, newCfg.Binds) {\n\t\tdiff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, \"Binds\")\n\t}\n\tif !clabutils.SlicesEqualOrBothEmpty(oldCfg.Devices, newCfg.Devices) {\n\t\tdiff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, \"Devices\")\n\t}\n\tif !clabutils.SlicesEqualOrBothEmpty(oldCfg.CapAdd, newCfg.CapAdd) {\n\t\tdiff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, \"CapAdd\")\n\t}\n\tif oldCfg.Privileged != newCfg.Privileged {\n\t\tdiff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, \"Privileged\")\n\t}\n\tif oldCfg.CgroupnsMode != newCfg.CgroupnsMode {\n\t\tdiff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, \"CgroupnsMode\")\n\t}\n\tif oldCfg.CgroupParent != newCfg.CgroupParent {\n\t\tdiff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, \"CgroupParent\")\n\t}\n\tif oldCfg.PidMode != newCfg.PidMode {\n\t\tdiff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, \"PidMode\")\n\t}\n\tif !clabutils.MapsEqualOrBothEmpty(oldCfg.Tmpfs, newCfg.Tmpfs) {\n\t\tdiff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, \"Tmpfs\")\n\t}\n\tif !clabutils.SlicesEqualOrBothEmpty(oldCfg.SecurityOpts, newCfg.SecurityOpts) {\n\t\tdiff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, \"SecurityOpts\")\n\t}\n\tif oldCfg.ShmSize != newCfg.ShmSize {\n\t\tdiff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, \"ShmSize\")\n\t}\n\tif !clabutils.PortSetsEqual(oldCfg.PortSet, newCfg.PortSet) {\n\t\tdiff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, \"Ports\")\n\t}\n\tif oldCfg.User != newCfg.User {\n\t\tdiff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, \"User\")\n\t}\n\tif oldCfg.NetworkMode != newCfg.NetworkMode {\n\t\tdiff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, \"NetworkMode\")\n\t}\n\tif oldCfg.MgmtNet != newCfg.MgmtNet {\n\t\tdiff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, \"MgmtNet\")\n\t}\n\tif oldCfg.Runtime != newCfg.Runtime {\n\t\tdiff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, \"Runtime\")\n\t}\n\tif oldCfg.CPU != newCfg.CPU {\n\t\tdiff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, \"CPU\")\n\t}\n\tif oldCfg.CPUSet != newCfg.CPUSet {\n\t\tdiff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, \"CPUSet\")\n\t}\n\tif oldCfg.Memory != newCfg.Memory {\n\t\tdiff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, \"Memory\")\n\t}\n\tif oldCfg.License != newCfg.License {\n\t\tdiff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, \"License\")\n\t}\n\t_, oldInvalid := oldCfg.KindSpecificConfig.(InvalidKindSpecificConfig)\n\t_, newInvalid := newCfg.KindSpecificConfig.(InvalidKindSpecificConfig)\n\n\tif oldInvalid || newInvalid ||\n\t\t!reflect.DeepEqual(oldCfg.KindSpecificConfig, newCfg.KindSpecificConfig) {\n\t\tdiff.Fields = append(diff.Fields, \"KindSpecificConfig\")\n\t}\n\n\treturn diff\n}\n\nfunc (d *DefaultNode) ComputeReconcilePlan(diff *clabtypes.TopologyDiff) *ReconcileResult {\n\tresult := &ReconcileResult{Action: clabtypes.TopologyDiffActionNone}\n\n\tif diff == nil || !diff.HasDiff() {\n\t\treturn result\n\t}\n\n\taction := diff.DefaultAction()\n\tresult.Action = action\n\n\tswitch action {\n\tcase clabtypes.TopologyDiffActionRestart:\n\t\tresult.Restarted = []string{d.Cfg.LongName}\n\tcase clabtypes.TopologyDiffActionRecreate:\n\t\tresult.Recreated = []string{d.Cfg.LongName}\n\t}\n\n\treturn result\n}\n\nfunc (d *DefaultNode) GetReconcilePlan(\n\t_ context.Context,\n\tdiff *clabtypes.TopologyDiff,\n) (*ReconcileResult, error) {\n\treturn d.ComputeReconcilePlan(diff), nil\n}\n\n// Reconcile applies the diff and executes the appropriate action (restart/recreate).\nfunc (d *DefaultNode) Reconcile(\n\tctx context.Context,\n\tdiff *clabtypes.TopologyDiff,\n) (*ReconcileResult, error) {\n\tresult := d.ComputeReconcilePlan(diff)\n\n\tif result.Action == clabtypes.TopologyDiffActionNone {\n\t\treturn result, nil\n\t}\n\n\tlog.Info(\n\t\t\"Applying node changes\",\n\t\t\"node\",\n\t\td.Cfg.ShortName,\n\t\t\"action\",\n\t\tresult.Action,\n\t\t\"fields\",\n\t\tdiff.Fields,\n\t)\n\n\tswitch result.Action {\n\tcase clabtypes.TopologyDiffActionRestart:\n\t\tif err := d.Stop(ctx); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn result, fmt.Errorf(\"stop failed: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif err := d.Start(ctx); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn result, fmt.Errorf(\"start failed: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\n\tcase clabtypes.TopologyDiffActionRecreate:\n\t\tif err := d.Delete(ctx); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn result, fmt.Errorf(\"delete failed: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\treturn result, nil\n}\n\nfunc (d *DefaultNode) parkingNetNSName() string {\n\treturn clabutils.ParkingNetnsName(d.Cfg.LongName)\n}\n\nfunc (d *DefaultNode) parkingNetNSPath() (string, error) {\n\treturn clabutils.GetNamedNetNS(d.parkingNetNSName())\n}\n\n// cleanupParkingNetNS removes the node-owned parking namespace if it exists.\nfunc (d *DefaultNode) cleanupParkingNetNS() error {\n\tif _, err := d.parkingNetNSPath(); err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\n\treturn netns.DeleteNamed(d.parkingNetNSName())\n}\n\nfunc (d *DefaultNode) Delete(ctx context.Context) error {\n\tfor _, e := range d.Endpoints {\n\t\terr := e.GetLink().Remove(ctx)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn err\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tif d.OverwriteNode.GetContainerStatus(ctx) == clabruntime.NotFound {\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\n\treturn d.Runtime.DeleteContainer(ctx, d.OverwriteNode.GetContainerName())\n}\n\nfunc (d *DefaultNode) GetImages(_ context.Context) map[string]string {\n\treturn map[string]string{\n\t\tImageKey: d.Cfg.Image,\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (d *DefaultNode) GetContainers(ctx context.Context) ([]clabruntime.GenericContainer, error) {\n\tcnts, err := d.Runtime.ListContainers(ctx, []*clabtypes.GenericFilter{\n\t\t{\n\t\t\tFilterType: \"name\",\n\t\t\tMatch:      d.OverwriteNode.GetContainerName(),\n\t\t},\n\t})\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\t// check that we retrieved some container information\n\t// otherwise throw ErrContainersNotFound error\n\tif len(cnts) == 0 {\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\n\t\t\t\"Node: %s. %w\",\n\t\t\td.OverwriteNode.GetContainerName(),\n\t\t\tErrContainersNotFound,\n\t\t)\n\t}\n\n\treturn cnts, err\n}\n\nfunc (d *DefaultNode) RunExecFromConfig(ctx context.Context, ec *clabexec.ExecCollection) error {\n\tfor _, e := range d.Config().Exec {\n\t\texec, err := clabexec.NewExecCmdFromString(e)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\tlog.Warnf(\"Failed to parse the command string: %s, %v\", e, err)\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tres, err := d.OverwriteNode.RunExec(ctx, exec)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\t// kinds which do not support exec functionality are skipped\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tec.Add(d.GetShortName(), res)\n\t}\n\treturn nil\n}\n\nfunc (d *DefaultNode) UpdateConfigWithRuntimeInfo(ctx context.Context) error {\n\tcnts, err := d.OverwriteNode.GetContainers(ctx)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\tif len(cnts) == 0 {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"no container runtime information retrieved\")\n\t}\n\n\t// network settings of a first container only\n\tnetSettings := cnts[0].NetworkSettings\n\n\td.Cfg.MgmtIPv4Address = netSettings.IPv4addr\n\td.Cfg.MgmtIPv4PrefixLength = netSettings.IPv4pLen\n\td.Cfg.MgmtIPv6Address = netSettings.IPv6addr\n\td.Cfg.MgmtIPv6PrefixLength = netSettings.IPv6pLen\n\td.Cfg.MgmtIPv4Gateway = netSettings.IPv4Gw\n\td.Cfg.MgmtIPv6Gateway = netSettings.IPv6Gw\n\n\td.Cfg.ContainerID = cnts[0].ID\n\n\td.Cfg.ResultingPortBindings = cnts[0].Ports\n\n\treturn nil\n}\n\n// DeleteNetnsSymlink deletes the symlink file created for the container netns.\nfunc (d *DefaultNode) DeleteNetnsSymlink() error {\n\tlog.Debugf(\"Deleting %s network namespace\", d.OverwriteNode.GetContainerName())\n\treturn clabutils.DeleteNetnsSymlink(d.OverwriteNode.GetContainerName())\n}\n\nfunc (d *DefaultNode) CheckInterfaceOverlap() error {\n\tvar seenEps []clablinks.Endpoint\n\n\tfor _, ep := range d.Endpoints {\n\t\tifName := ep.GetIfaceName()\n\t\tfor _, seenEp := range seenEps {\n\t\t\tif ifName == seenEp.GetIfaceName() {\n\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"%q and %q have overlapping interface names\", ep, seenEp)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tseenEps = append(seenEps, ep)\n\t}\n\n\treturn nil\n}\n\n// CheckInterfaceName checks if a name of the interface referenced in the topology file is in the\n// expected range of name values.\n// A no-op for the default node, specific nodes should implement this method.\nfunc (d *DefaultNode) CheckInterfaceName() error {\n\treturn d.CheckInterfaceOverlap()\n}\n\n// CalculateInterfaceIndex parses the supplied interface name with the InterfaceRegexp.\n// Using the the port offset, it calculates the mapped interface index based on the InterfaceOffset\n// and the first data interface index.\nfunc (d *DefaultNode) CalculateInterfaceIndex(ifName string) (int, error) {\n\tcaptureGroups, err := clabutils.GetRegexpCaptureGroups(d.InterfaceRegexp, ifName)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn 0, err\n\t}\n\n\tif parsedIndex, found := captureGroups[\"port\"]; found {\n\t\tparsedIndexInt, err := strconv.Atoi(parsedIndex)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn 0, fmt.Errorf(\n\t\t\t\t\"%q parsed index %q could not be cast to an integer\",\n\t\t\t\tifName,\n\t\t\t\tparsedIndex,\n\t\t\t)\n\t\t}\n\t\tcalculatedIndex := parsedIndexInt - d.InterfaceOffset + d.FirstDataIfIndex\n\t\treturn calculatedIndex, nil\n\t} else {\n\t\treturn 0, fmt.Errorf(\n\t\t\t\"%q does not have extracted interface index with regexp %q, 'port' capture group missing?\",\n\t\t\tifName,\n\t\t\td.InterfaceRegexp,\n\t\t)\n\t}\n}\n\n// GetMappedInterfaceName returns with a mapped interface name based on the mapped interface prefix\n// and calculated mapped interface index.\nfunc (d *DefaultNode) GetMappedInterfaceName(ifName string) (string, error) {\n\tifIndex, err := d.OverwriteNode.CalculateInterfaceIndex(ifName)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn \"\", err\n\t}\n\tif ifIndex < d.FirstDataIfIndex {\n\t\treturn \"\", fmt.Errorf(\n\t\t\t\"extracted interface index for %q is out of bounds: %d ! >= %d\",\n\t\t\tifName,\n\t\t\tifIndex,\n\t\t\td.FirstDataIfIndex,\n\t\t)\n\t}\n\tmappedIfName := fmt.Sprintf(\"%s%d\", d.InterfaceMappedPrefix, ifIndex)\n\n\treturn mappedIfName, nil\n}\n\n// VerifyStartupConfig verifies that startup config files exists on disks.\nfunc (d *DefaultNode) VerifyStartupConfig(topoDir string) error {\n\tcfg := d.Config().StartupConfig\n\tif cfg == \"\" {\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\n\trcfg := clabutils.ResolvePath(cfg, topoDir)\n\tif !clabutils.FileExists(rcfg) {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"node %q startup-config file not found by the path %s\",\n\t\t\td.OverwriteNode.GetContainerName(), rcfg)\n\t}\n\n\treturn nil\n}\n\n// GenerateConfig generates configuration for the nodes\n// out of the template `t` based on the node configuration and saves the result to dst.\n// If the config file is already present in the node dir we do not regenerate the config unless\n// EnforceStartupConfig is explicitly set to true and startup-config points to a file this will\n// persist the changes that users make to a running config when booted from some startup config.\nfunc (d *DefaultNode) GenerateConfig(dst, t string) error {\n\t// Check for incompatible options\n\tif d.Cfg.EnforceStartupConfig && d.Cfg.SuppressStartupConfig {\n\t\treturn ErrIncompatibleOptions\n\t}\n\tif d.Cfg.EnforceStartupConfig && d.Cfg.StartupConfig == \"\" {\n\t\treturn ErrNoStartupConfig\n\t}\n\n\tif d.Cfg.SuppressStartupConfig {\n\t\tlog.Info(\"Startup config generation suppressed\", \"node\", d.Cfg.ShortName)\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\n\tif !d.Cfg.EnforceStartupConfig && clabutils.FileExists(dst) {\n\t\tlog.Debug(\"Existing config found\", \"node\", d.Cfg.ShortName, \"path\", dst)\n\t\treturn nil\n\t} else {\n\t\tlog.Debug(\"Generating config\", \"node\", d.Cfg.ShortName, \"file\", d.Cfg.StartupConfig)\n\n\t\tcfgBuf, err := clabutils.SubstituteEnvsAndTemplate(strings.NewReader(t), d.Cfg)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn err\n\t\t}\n\t\tlog.Debug(\"Generated config\", \"node\", d.Cfg.ShortName, \"content\", cfgBuf.String())\n\n\t\tf, err := os.Create(dst)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn err\n\t\t}\n\t\tdefer f.Close()\n\n\t\t_, err = f.Write(cfgBuf.Bytes())\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn err\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\treturn nil\n}\n\n// NodeOverwrites is an interface that every node implements.\n// It is used to enable DefaultNode to get access to the particular node structs\n// and is provided as an argument of the NewDefaultNode function.\n// The methods defined for this interfaces are the methods that particular node has a custom\n// implementation of.\ntype NodeOverwrites interface {\n\tVerifyStartupConfig(topoDir string) error\n\tCheckInterfaceName() error\n\tCalculateInterfaceIndex(ifName string) (int, error)\n\tGetMappedInterfaceName(ifName string) (string, error)\n\tVerifyHostRequirements() error\n\tPullImage(ctx context.Context) error\n\tGetImages(ctx context.Context) map[string]string\n\tGetContainers(ctx context.Context) ([]clabruntime.GenericContainer, error)\n\tGetContainerName() string\n\tGetContainerStatus(ctx context.Context) clabruntime.ContainerStatus\n\tVerifyContainerName() error\n\tVerifyLicenseFileExists(context.Context) error\n\tPreStop(context.Context) error\n\tRunExec(context.Context, *clabexec.ExecCmd) (*clabexec.ExecResult, error)\n\tGetNSPath(ctx context.Context) (string, error)\n}\n\n// LoadStartupConfigFileVr templates a startup-config using the file specified for VM-based nodes in\n// the topo\n// and puts the resulting config file by the LabDir/configDirName/startupCfgFName path.\nfunc LoadStartupConfigFileVr(node Node, configDirName, startupCfgFName string) error {\n\tnodeCfg := node.Config()\n\t// create config directory that will be bind mounted to vrnetlab container at / path\n\tclabutils.CreateDirectory(path.Join(nodeCfg.LabDir, configDirName),\n\t\tclabconstants.PermissionsOpen)\n\n\tif nodeCfg.StartupConfig != \"\" {\n\t\t// dstCfg is a path to a file on the clab host that will have rendered configuration\n\t\tdstCfg := filepath.Join(nodeCfg.LabDir, configDirName, startupCfgFName)\n\n\t\tc, err := os.ReadFile(nodeCfg.StartupConfig)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn err\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tcfgTemplate := string(c)\n\n\t\terr = node.GenerateConfig(dstCfg, cfgTemplate)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\tlog.Errorf(\"node=%s, failed to generate config: %v\", nodeCfg.ShortName, err)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn nil\n}\n\n// GetContainerName returns the name used by the runtime to identify the container\n// e.g. ext-container nodes use the name as defined in the topo file, while most other containers\n// use long (prefixed) name.\nfunc (d *DefaultNode) GetContainerName() string {\n\treturn d.Cfg.LongName\n}\n\nfunc (d *DefaultNode) VerifyContainerName() error {\n\tcontainerName := d.OverwriteNode.GetContainerName()\n\tif !containerNamePatternRe.MatchString(containerName) {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"Node name contains invalid characters: %s\", containerName)\n\t}\n\n\tif len(containerName) > maxNameLength {\n\t\tlog.Warn(\n\t\t\t\"Node name will not resolve via DNS\",\n\t\t\t\"name\",\n\t\t\tcontainerName,\n\t\t\t\"reason\",\n\t\t\tfmt.Sprintf(\"name exceeds %d characters\", maxNameLength),\n\t\t)\n\t}\n\n\tif strings.ContainsAny(containerName, dnsIncompatibleChars) {\n\t\tlog.Warn(\n\t\t\t\"Node name will not resolve via DNS\",\n\t\t\t\"name\",\n\t\t\tcontainerName,\n\t\t\t\"reason\",\n\t\t\t\"name contains invalid characters such as '.' and/or '_'\",\n\t\t)\n\t}\n\n\treturn nil\n}\n\n// RunExec executes a single command for a node.\nfunc (d *DefaultNode) RunExec(\n\tctx context.Context,\n\texecCmd *clabexec.ExecCmd,\n) (*clabexec.ExecResult, error) {\n\texecResult, err := d.GetRuntime().Exec(ctx, d.OverwriteNode.GetContainerName(), execCmd)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tlog.Errorf(\"%s: failed to execute cmd: %q with error %v\",\n\t\t\td.OverwriteNode.GetContainerName(), execCmd.GetCmdString(), err)\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\treturn execResult, nil\n}\n\n// RunExecNotWait executes a command for a node, and doesn't block waiting for the output.\n// Should be overridden if the nodes implementation differs.\nfunc (d *DefaultNode) RunExecNotWait(ctx context.Context, execCmd *clabexec.ExecCmd) error {\n\terr := d.GetRuntime().ExecNotWait(ctx, d.OverwriteNode.GetContainerName(), execCmd)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tlog.Errorf(\"%s: failed to execute cmd: %q with error %v\",\n\t\t\td.OverwriteNode.GetContainerName(), execCmd.GetCmdString(), err)\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\treturn nil\n}\n\n// VerifyLicenseFileExists checks if a license file with a provided path exists.\nfunc (d *DefaultNode) VerifyLicenseFileExists(_ context.Context) error {\n\tif d.Config().License == \"\" {\n\t\tswitch d.LicensePolicy {\n\t\t// if a license is required by the kind but not provided\n\t\tcase clabtypes.LicensePolicyRequired:\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\n\t\t\t\t\"node %s of kind %s requires a license. Provide one via 'license' knob in the topology file\",\n\t\t\t\td.Config().ShortName,\n\t\t\t\td.Cfg.Kind,\n\t\t\t)\n\t\tcase clabtypes.LicensePolicyWarn:\n\t\t\t// just warn when no license is provided\n\t\t\tlog.Warnf(\n\t\t\t\t\"node %s of kind %s requires a license. Make sure to provide it in some way (e.g. license knob or baked into image)\",\n\t\t\t\td.Config().ShortName,\n\t\t\t\td.Cfg.Kind,\n\t\t\t)\n\t\t\treturn nil\n\t\tcase clabtypes.LicensePolicyNone:\n\t\t\t// license is not required\n\t\t\treturn nil\n\t\tdefault:\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"unknown license policy value %s for node %s kind %s\",\n\t\t\t\td.LicensePolicy, d.Config().ShortName, d.Cfg.Kind)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\t// if license is provided check path exists\n\trlic := clabutils.ResolvePath(d.Config().License, d.Cfg.LabDir)\n\tif !clabutils.FileExists(rlic) {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\n\t\t\t\"license file for node %q is not found by the path %s\",\n\t\t\td.Config().ShortName,\n\t\t\trlic,\n\t\t)\n\t}\n\n\treturn nil\n}\n\n// LoadOrGenerateCertificate loads a certificate using a certificate storage provider\n// provided in certInfra or generates a new one if it does not exist.\nfunc (d *DefaultNode) LoadOrGenerateCertificate(\n\tcertInfra *clabcert.Cert,\n\ttopoName string,\n) (nodeCert *clabcert.Certificate, err error) {\n\t// early return if certificate generation is not required\n\tif d.Cfg.Certificate == nil || !*d.Cfg.Certificate.Issue {\n\t\treturn nil, nil\n\t}\n\n\tnodeConfig := d.Cfg\n\n\t// try loading existing certificates from disk and generate new ones if they do not exist\n\tnodeCert, err = certInfra.LoadNodeCert(nodeConfig.ShortName)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tlog.Debugf(\"creating node certificate for %s\", nodeConfig.ShortName)\n\n\t\thosts := []string{\n\t\t\tnodeConfig.ShortName,\n\t\t\tnodeConfig.LongName,\n\t\t\tnodeConfig.ShortName + \".\" + topoName + \".io\",\n\t\t}\n\t\t// add the SANs provided via config\n\t\thosts = append(hosts, nodeConfig.Certificate.SANs...)\n\n\t\t// add mgmt IPs as SANs to CSR\n\t\tfor _, ip := range []string{d.Cfg.MgmtIPv4Address, d.Cfg.MgmtIPv6Address} {\n\t\t\tif ip != \"\" {\n\t\t\t\thosts = append(hosts, ip)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tcertInput := &clabcert.NodeCSRInput{\n\t\t\tCommonName:   nodeConfig.ShortName + \".\" + topoName + \".io\",\n\t\t\tHosts:        hosts,\n\t\t\tOrganization: \"containerlab\",\n\t\t\tCountry:      \"US\",\n\t\t\tKeySize:      d.Cfg.Certificate.KeySize,\n\t\t\tExpiry:       d.Cfg.Certificate.ValidityDuration,\n\t\t}\n\t\t// Generate the cert for the node\n\t\tnodeCert, err = certInfra.GenerateAndSignNodeCert(certInput)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn nil, err\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// persist the cert via certStorage\n\t\terr = certInfra.StoreNodeCert(nodeConfig.ShortName, nodeCert)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn nil, err\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\treturn nodeCert, nil\n}\n\nfunc (d *DefaultNode) GetHostsEntries(ctx context.Context) (clabtypes.HostEntries, error) {\n\tcontainers, err := d.OverwriteNode.GetContainers(ctx)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\n\tresult := clabtypes.HostEntries{}\n\n\tfor idx := range containers {\n\t\tif len(containers[idx].Names) == 0 {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tif containers[idx].NetworkSettings.IPv4addr != \"\" {\n\t\t\tresult = append(result, Reasoning
The `distributed` handling: in `runtimeNodeGroups`, for sros components, the components themselves have RootNodeName set, and the netns holder too. The "distributed" flag is used by apply logic to treat the group as a distributed node (SR-SIM). Now for srl with a netns holder, the group is marked distributed=true. What does apply do with distributed groups? Let me look at core/apply.go and topology_reconcile.go to see how distributed groups are handled (e.g., whether they get grouped under a node and whether srl nodes with a holder would be treated as sros-like distributed nodes requiring component nodes).

Let me read core/apply.go.

260: func (c *CLab) checkApplyTopologyDefinition(ctx context.Context) error {
261: 	params := *clablinks.NewVerifyLinkParams()
262: 	if len(c.Endpoints) > 0 {
263: 		runtime := c.globalRuntime()
264: 		if runtime == nil {
265: 			return fmt.Errorf("container runtime is not initialized")
266: 		}
267: 		config := runtime.Config()
268: 		if config.VerifyLinkParams != nil {
269: 			params = *config.VerifyLinkParams
270: 		}
271: 	}
272: 	params.AllowExistingEndpoint = true
273: 	if err := c.verifyLinks(ctx, &params); err != nil {
274: 		return err
275: 	}
276:

278: 		return err
279: 	}
280:

282: 		if err := c.Nodes[nodeName].CheckDeploymentConditions(ctx); err != nil {
283: 			return err
284: 		}
285: 	}
286: 
287: 	if err := c.verifyDuplicateAddresses(); err != nil {
288: 		return err
289: 	}
290: 
291: 	return c.verifyTailscaleProxy()
292: }

294: func (c *CLab) prepareApply(
295: 	ctx context.Context,
296: 	addedNodes []string,
297: 	skipLabDirFileACLs bool,
298: 	currentNodes map[string]*runtimeNodeGroup,

311: 			return err
312: 		}
313: 	}

315: 	return nil
316: }

318: func (*CLab) removeApplyLinkEndpoints(ctx context.Context, links []clablinks.Link) error {
319: 	for _, link := range links {
320: 		for _, ep := range clablinks.RuntimeEndpoints(link) {
321: 			if err := clablinks.RemoveOwnedInterface(
322: 				ctx,
323: 				ep.GetNode(),
324: 				ep.GetIfaceName(),
325: 			); err != nil {
326: 				return err
327: 			}
328: 		}
329: 	}
330: 
331: 	return nil
332: }

334: // try to preserve the existing addressing instead of reallocation.
335: func (c *CLab) collectExistingManagementAddresses(
336: 	currentNodes map[string]*runtimeNodeGroup,
337: ) []clabtypes.ExistingAddress {
338: 	var existing []clabtypes.ExistingAddress
339: 	for name, group := range currentNodes {
340: 		for _, ctr := range group.containers {
341: 			if c.mgmtNetByNetwork(ctr.NetworkName).Network != ctr.NetworkName {
342: 				continue
343: 			}
344: 			for _, value := range []string{ctr.NetworkSettings.IPv4addr, ctr.NetworkSettings.IPv6addr} {
345: 				if ip, err := netip.ParseAddr(value); err == nil {
346: 					existing = append(
347: 						existing,
348: 						clabtypes.ExistingAddress{NodeName: name, ContainerID: ctr.ID, Address: ip},
349: 					)
350: 				}
351: 			}
352: 		}
353: 	}
354: 	return existing
355: }

164: 			}

166: 			if ctrBridge == "" {

168: 			}

171: 				continue
172: 			}

174: 				return fmt.Errorf(

176: 					bridge,
177: 					ctrBridge,
178: 				)
179: 			}
180: 		}
181: 	}
182: 
183: 	if bridge != "" {

185: 	}
186: 
187: 	return nil
188: }

213: func runtimeContainerNodeName(ctr clabruntime.GenericContainer) string {

215: 		return name
216: 	}
217: 	if len(ctr.Names) > 0 {

223: func runtimeContainerLess(a, b clabruntime.GenericContainer) bool {
224: 	// internal holders own the network namespace of the other containers in the group,
225: 	// so they sort first to be deleted last.
226: 	aInternal := a.Labels[clabconstants.InternalNode] == "true"
227: 	bInternal := b.Labels[clabconstants.InternalNode] == "true"
228: 	if aInternal != bInternal {
229: 		return aInternal
230: 	}
231: 
232: 	aName := runtimeContainerNodeName(a)
233: 	bName := runtimeContainerNodeName(b)
234: 
235: 	aOrder := runtimeComponentSortOrder(aName)
236: 	bOrder := runtimeComponentSortOrder(bName)
237: 	if aOrder != bOrder {
238: 		return aOrder < bOrder
239: 	}
240: 
241: 	return aName < bName
242: }
243: 
244: func runtimeComponentSortOrder(name string) int {
245: 	idx := strings.LastIndex(name, "-")
246: 	if idx < 0 || idx == len(name)-1 {
247: 		return 0
248: 	}
249: 
250: 	slot := strings.ToUpper(name[idx+1:])
251: 	if len(slot) == 1 && slot[0] >= 'A' && slot[0] <= 'Z' {
252: 		return 100 - int(slot[0])
253: 	}
254: 
255: 	var n int
256: 	for _, r := range slot {
257: 		if r < '0' || r > '9' {
258: 			return 0
259: 		}
260: 		n = n*10 + int(r-'0')
261: 	}
262: 
263: 	return n
264: }

112: func (c *CLab) discoverTailscaleContainers(ctx context.Context, filter []string) (
113: 	[]clabruntime.GenericContainer, error,
114: ) {
115: 	containers, err := c.ListContainers(ctx,
116: 		WithListLabName(c.Config.Name),
117: 		WithListFromCliArgs([]string{clabconstants.InternalNode + "=true"}),
118: 	)
119: 	if err != nil {
120: 		return nil, err
121: 	}
122: 	var result []clabruntime.GenericContainer
123: 	for _, ctr := range containers {
124: 		proxy := ctr.Labels[clabconstants.ToolType] == clabnodestailscale.ToolType
125: 		sidecar := ctr.Labels[clabconstants.NodeKind] == clabnodestailscale.KindName &&
126: 			ctr.Labels[clabconstants.InternalNode] == "true"
127: 		if !proxy && !sidecar {
128: 			continue
129: 		}
130: 		if len(filter) > 0 &&
131: 			(proxy || !slices.Contains(filter, ctr.Labels[clabnodestailscale.ParentLabel])) {
132: 			continue
133: 		}
134: 		result = append(result, ctr)
135: 	}
136: 	return result, nil
137: }

139: // verifyTailscaleProxy checks that the SSO proxy container name is free and that every
140: // /ts listen port is unique on the proxy.
141: func (c *CLab) verifyTailscaleProxy() error {
142: 	if !c.tailscaleProxyEnabled() {
143: 		return nil
144: 	}
145: 	if _, exists := c.Nodes[clabnodestailscale.ProxyName]; exists {
146: 		return fmt.Errorf(
147: 			"node name %q is reserved for the Tailscale SSO proxy",
148: 			clabnodestailscale.ProxyName,
149: 		)
150: 	}
151: 
152: 	owners := map[uint16]string{}
153: 	for _, name := range sortedNodeNames(c.Nodes) {
154: 		cfg := c.Nodes[name].Config()
155: 		if len(cfg.TailscalePorts) > 0 && !cfg.ManagementIPAMEligible() {
156: 			log.Warn("Tailscale /ts ports need a node management IP, ignoring", "node", name)
157: 			continue
158: 		}
159: 		if len(cfg.TailscalePorts) > 0 && cfg.MgmtNet != c.tailscaleMgmtNet().Network {
160: 			log.Warn(
161: 				"Tailscale /ts ports need the node on the tailscale management network, ignoring",
162: 				"node",
163: 				name,
164: 				"network",
165: 				c.tailscaleMgmtNet().Network,
166: 			)
167: 			continue
168: 		}
169: 		for _, p := range cfg.TailscalePorts {
170: 			if owner, exists := owners[p.Listen]; exists {
171: 				return fmt.Errorf(
172: 					"Tailscale listen port %d is used by nodes %q and %q",
173: 					p.Listen, owner, name,
174: 				)
175: 			}
176: 			owners[p.Listen] = name
177: 		}
178: 	}
179: 
180: 	return nil
181: }

183: // syncTailscaleProxy reconciles the SSO proxy tool container with mgmt.tailscale. It removes
184: // the proxy when SSO is off, using the Serve config file as a marker that a proxy was
185: // created so labs without one skip the runtime lookup; otherwise it rewrites the Serve config from
186: // the nodes' current
187: // /ts ports and management IPs, which a running proxy reloads without a restart, and creates
188: // the proxy when it is missing. Node runtime info must be current.
189: func (c *CLab) syncTailscaleProxy(ctx context.Context) error {
190: 	labDir := c.TopoPaths.NodeDir(clabnodestailscale.ProxyName)
191: 	serveFile := filepath.Join(labDir, clabnodestailscale.ServeFile)
192: 	if !c.tailscaleProxyEnabled() && !clabutils.FileExists(serveFile) {
193: 		return nil
194: 	}
195: 
196: 	existing, err := c.ListContainers(
197: 		ctx,
198: 		WithListLabName(c.Config.Name),
199: 		WithListToolType(clabnodestailscale.ToolType),
200: 	)
201: 	if err != nil {
202: 		return fmt.Errorf("listing Tailscale proxy: %w", err)
203: 	}
204: 
205: 	if !c.tailscaleProxyEnabled() {
206: 		for idx := range existing {
207: 			name := strings.TrimPrefix(existing[idx].Names[0], "/")
208: 			log.Info("Removing Tailscale proxy", "container", name)
209: 			c.logoutTailscaleContainer(ctx, existing[idx])
210: 			if err := c.globalRuntime().DeleteContainer(ctx, name); err != nil {
211: 				return fmt.Errorf("removing Tailscale proxy %q: %w", name, err)
212: 			}
213: 		}
214: 		return os.Remove(serveFile)
215: 	}
216: 	if c.skipMgmtNetwork(c.tailscaleMgmtNet()) {
217: 		log.Warn("Tailscale SSO proxy needs the management network, skipping",
218: 			"network", c.tailscaleMgmtNet().Network)
219: 		return nil
220: 	}
221: 
222: 	clabutils.CreateDirectory(labDir, clabconstants.PermissionsOpen)
223: 	if err := clabnodestailscale.WriteServeConfig(labDir, c.tailscaleNodes()); err != nil {
224: 		return fmt.Errorf("writing Tailscale Serve config: %w", err)
225: 	}
226: 	if len(existing) > 0 {
227: 		return nil
228: 	}
229: 
230: 	return c.createTailscaleProxy(ctx, labDir)
231: }
232: 
233: func (c *CLab) createTailscaleProxy(ctx context.Context, labDir string) error {
234: 	ts := c.tailscaleMgmtNet()
235: 	rt, err := c.mgmtRuntime(c.globalRuntimeName, ts)
236: 	if err != nil {
237: 		return err
238: 	}
239: 	cfg := clabnodestailscale.ProxyConfig(
240: 		c.Config.Name,
241: 		c.nodeLongName(clabnodestailscale.ProxyName),
242: 		ts.Network,
243: 		labDir,
244: 	)
245: 	c.addDefaultLabels(cfg)
246: 	cfg.Labels[clabconstants.ToolType] = clabnodestailscale.ToolType
247: 	cfg.Labels[clabconstants.InternalNode] = "true"
248: 
249: 	if err := rt.PullImage(ctx, cfg.Image, clabtypes.PullPolicyIfNotPresent); err != nil {
250: 		return fmt.Errorf("pulling Tailscale proxy image: %w", err)
251: 	}
252: 	if err := c.AllocateToolManagementIPs(ctx, cfg); err != nil {
253: 		return fmt.Errorf("allocating Tailscale proxy management address: %w", err)
254: 	}
255: 
256: 	log.Info("Creating Tailscale SSO proxy", "container", cfg.LongName)
257: 	id, err := rt.CreateContainer(ctx, cfg)
258: 	if err != nil {
259: 		return fmt.Errorf("creating Tailscale proxy: %w", err)
260: 	}
261: 	if _, err := rt.StartContainer(ctx, id, clabruntime.NewEndpointlessNode(cfg)); err != nil {
262: 		rt.DeleteContainer(ctx, cfg.LongName)
263: 		return fmt.Errorf("starting Tailscale proxy: %w", err)
264: 	}
265: 
266: 	log.Info("Tailscale SSO proxy started; if it has not joined the tailnet yet, "+
267: 		"open the login URL shown in its logs",
268: 		"container", cfg.LongName, "logs", "docker logs "+cfg.LongName)
269: 
270: 	return nil

Now check topology_reconcile.go planApply / recreate handling for srl with holder — e.g., when the srl node needs recreation, does the holder get recreated too? plan operates on node names. deleteApplyNodes deletes all containers in the group (srl first, then holder). But parkRecreatedNodes/restoreRecreatedNodes: parked endpoints. Let me check those functions in topology_reconcile.go. Park/restore uses node's endpoints and GetNSPath. When the srl group is deleted (both containers), the parked endpoints live in the parking netns (host-level named netns), so they survive deletion of the srl container and holder. Then restoreRecreatedNodes restores them into the new holder's netns via GetNSPath. But wait — order: deleteApplyNodes deletes containers, then deployApplyNodes creates new ones, then restoreRecreatedNodes. GetNSPath at restore time points to new holder netns. Good.

But there's a subtlety in park: parked endpoints moved to parking netns — the parking netns is a named netns on the host (managed by links package). Fine.

Now, more importantly: linkNetns and GetNSPath for link deployment. Links attach endpoints into the node's netns via GetNSPath → holder's netns path. The holder's netns path is resolved via runtime.GetNSPath(ctx, holder container name). Good.

The runtime rejects network settings for such containers, as they\n// belong to the holder.\nfunc (n *srl) containerConfig() *clabtypes.NodeConfig {\n\tcfg := *n.Cfg\n\tcfg.NetworkMode = \"container:\" + n.netnsNode.GetShortName()\n\tcfg.DNS = nil\n\tcfg.ExtraHosts = nil\n\tcfg.MacAddress = \"\"\n\tcfg.PortBindings = nil\n\tcfg.PortSet = nil\n\n\treturn &cfg\n}\n\n// linkNetns points the node's netns symlink to the holder, as the namespace path of the\n// SR Linux container changes whenever the container restarts.\nfunc (n *srl) linkNetns(ctx context.Context) error {\n\tnsPath, err := n.netnsNode.GetNSPath(ctx)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\treturn clabutils.LinkContainerNS(nsPath, n.Cfg.LongName)\n}\n\n// GetNSPath retrieves the Namespace Path.\nfunc (n *srl) GetNSPath(ctx context.Context) (string, error) {\n\tif n.netnsNode == nil {\n\t\treturn n.DefaultNode.GetNSPath(ctx)\n\t}\n\n\treturn n.netnsNode.GetNSPath(ctx)\n}\n\n// DeleteNetnsSymlink deletes the symlink file created for the container netns.\nfunc (n *srl) DeleteNetnsSymlink() error {\n\tif n.netnsNode == nil {\n\t\treturn n.DefaultNode.DeleteNetnsSymlink()\n\t}\n\n\treturn errors.Join(n.DefaultNode.DeleteNetnsSymlink(), n.netnsNode.DeleteNetnsSymlink())\n}",

163: 	return nil
164: }
165: 
166: func (d *DefaultNode) PullImage(ctx context.Context) error {
167: 	for imageKey, imageName := range d.OverwriteNode.GetImages(ctx) {
168: 		if imageName == "" {
169: 			return fmt.Errorf(
170: 				"missing required %q attribute for node %q",
171: 				imageKey,
172: 				d.Cfg.ShortName,
173: 			)
174: 		}
175: 		err := d.Runtime.PullImage(ctx, imageName, d.Config().ImagePullPolicy)
176: 		if err != nil {
177: 			return err
178: 		}
179: 	}
180: 	return nil
181: }
182: 
183: func (d *DefaultNode) VerifyHostRequirements() error {
184: 	return d.HostRequirements.Verify(d.Cfg.Kind, d.Cfg.ShortName)
185: }
186: 
187: func (d *DefaultNode) Deploy(ctx context.Context, _ *DeployParams) error {
188: 	// Set the "CLAB_INTFS" variable to the number of interfaces (endpoints) a node has.
189: 	// This env var does not count in the eth0 interface that is automatically created by the
190: 	// container runtime. This env var is used by some containers (e.g. vrnetlab systems) to
191: 	// postpone the startup until all interfaces
192: 	// have been added to the container namespace.
193: 	d.Config().Env[clabconstants.ClabEnvIntfs] = strconv.Itoa(len(d.GetEndpoints()))
194: 
195: 	// create the container
196: 	cID, err := d.Runtime.CreateContainer(ctx, d.Cfg)
197: 	if err != nil {
198: 		return err
199: 	}
200: 
201: 	// start the container
202: 	_, err = d.Runtime.StartContainer(ctx, cID, d)
203: 	if err != nil {
204: 		return err
205: 	}
206: 
207: 	// Update the nodes state
208: 	d.SetState(clabnodesstate.Deployed)
209: 
210: 	return nil
211: }

213: // GetNSPath retrieves the nodes nspath.
214: func (d *DefaultNode) GetNSPath(ctx context.Context) (string, error) {
215: 	var err error
216: 	nsp := ""
217: 
218: 	if d.Cfg.IsRootNamespaceBased {
219: 		netns, err := ns.GetCurrentNS()
220: 		if err != nil {
221: 			return "", err
222: 		}
223: 		nsp = netns.Path()
224: 	}
225: 	if nsp == "" {
226: 		nsp, err = d.Runtime.GetNSPath(ctx, d.OverwriteNode.GetContainerName())
227: 		if err != nil {
228: 			log.Errorf("Unable to determine NetNS Path for node %s: %v", d.Cfg.ShortName, err)
229: 			return "", err
230: 		}
231: 	}
232: 
233: 	return nsp, err
234: }
235: 
236: // ShouldSkipLifecycle reports whether lifecycle operations should no-op for this node.
237: func (d *DefaultNode) ShouldSkipLifecycle() bool {
238: 	return d.Cfg.IsRootNamespaceBased || d.Cfg.AutoRemove
239: }
240: 
241: // LinkApplyMode returns the conservative default for node kinds that do not
242: // explicitly opt into live hotplug or restart handling.
243: func (d *DefaultNode) LinkApplyMode(ctx context.Context) LinkApplyMode {
244: 	if d.Cfg != nil && (d.Cfg.IsRootNamespaceBased || d.Cfg.SkipUniquenessCheck) {
245: 		return LinkApplyModeLive
246: 	}
247: 	return d.ImageLinkApplyMode(ctx, LinkApplyModeRecreate)
248: }
249: 
250: // ImageLinkApplyMode allows node kinds to keep their normal fallback behavior
251: // while opting into live link apply when their image declares support for it.
252: func (d *DefaultNode) ImageLinkApplyMode(
253: 	ctx context.Context,
254: 	fallback LinkApplyMode,
255: ) LinkApplyMode {
256: 	if d.imageHasBoxenVendorLabel(ctx) {
257: 		return LinkApplyModeLive
258: 	}
259: 
260: 	return fallback
261: }
262: 
263: func (d *DefaultNode) imageHasBoxenVendorLabel(ctx context.Context) bool {
264: 	if d == nil || d.Cfg == nil || d.Cfg.Image == "" {
265: 		return false
266: 	}
267: 	if d.Runtime == nil {
268: 		log.Debug("Skipping image label check for apply link hotplug support",
269: 			"image", d.Cfg.Image,
270: 			"reason", "node runtime is not initialized",
271: 		)
272: 		return false
273: 	}
274: 
275: 	inspect, err := d.Runtime.InspectImage(ctx, d.Cfg.Image)
276: 	if err != nil {
277: 		log.Debug("Failed to inspect image for apply link hotplug support",
278: 			"image", d.Cfg.Image,
279: 			"error", err,
280: 		)
281: 		return false
282: 	}
283: 	if inspect == nil || inspect.Config.Labels == nil {
284: 		return false
285: 	}
286: 
287: 	return inspect.Config.Labels[boxenImageVendorLabel] == boxenImageVendorValue
288: }

389: func (d *DefaultNode) ComputeReconcilePlan(diff *clabtypes.TopologyDiff) *ReconcileResult {
390: 	result := &ReconcileResult{Action: clabtypes.TopologyDiffActionNone}
391: 
392: 	if diff == nil || !diff.HasDiff() {
393: 		return result
394: 	}
395: 
396: 	action := diff.DefaultAction()
397: 	result.Action = action
398: 
399: 	switch action {
400: 	case clabtypes.TopologyDiffActionRestart:
401: 		result.Restarted = []string{d.Cfg.LongName}
402: 	case clabtypes.TopologyDiffActionRecreate:
403: 		result.Recreated = []string{d.Cfg.LongName}
404: 	}
405: 
406: 	return result
407: }

The holder's long name = node longname + "-netns" and holder's short name = node short + "-netns". Reasoning
OK, docker CreateContainer supports `unless-stopped`. The srl node config gets unless-stopped restart policy (new default) and the holder inherits it. Note: the srl container with `container:` network mode + restart policy — when the srl container exits on reboot, docker restarts it, it joins the holder netns. Good.

Potential problem: **the holder also restarts on reboot?** No, the holder doesn't exit.

Potential problem: **restart policy `unless-stopped` on the node when user runs `clab stop`** — docker stop marks it stopped permanently; `clab start` → docker start works. OK.

Now: **podman runtime** — does it support `unless-stopped`? Let me check podman restart policy handling. Also does podman support `container:` network mode (yes). Let me check.

Next, check the sros changes and sros_test.go, and the holder deploy for sros — previously sros had its own namespaceNode/ensureNetnsRunning logic. Let me read the sros diff. Let me read base vs head sros/netns.go.

93: func (n *sros) ensureNetnsRunning(ctx context.Context) error {
94: 	switch status := n.netnsNode.GetContainerStatus(ctx); status {
95: 	case clabruntime.Running:
96: 		// The namespace holder intentionally survives regular node lifecycle operations.
97: 	case clabruntime.Created, clabruntime.Stopped:
98: 		if err := n.netnsNode.Start(ctx); err != nil {
99: 			return fmt.Errorf("node %q network namespace container start error: %w",
100: 				n.Cfg.ShortName, err)
101: 		}
102: 	case clabruntime.Paused:
103: 		if err := n.Runtime.UnpauseContainer(ctx, n.netnsNode.Config().LongName); err != nil {
104: 			return fmt.Errorf("node %q network namespace container unpause error: %w",
105: 				n.Cfg.ShortName, err)
106: 		}
107: 	case clabruntime.NotFound:
108: 		return fmt.Errorf(
109: 			"node %q network namespace container %q not found; recreate the node",
110: 			n.Cfg.ShortName, n.netnsNode.Config().LongName,
111: 		)
112: 	default:
113: 		return fmt.Errorf("node %q network namespace container %q is %s",
114: 			n.Cfg.ShortName, n.netnsNode.Config().LongName, status)
115: 	}
116: 
117: 	return nil
118: }

123: 		return nil
124: 	}

131: 	if n.isStandaloneNode() || (n.isDistributedCardNode() && n.rootCtrName == "") {
132: 		return n.DefaultNode.GetNSPath(ctx)
133: 	} else if n.isDistributedCardNode() {
134: 		return n.Runtime.GetNSPath(ctx, n.rootCtrName)
135: 	}
136: 	return n.netnsNode.GetNSPath(ctx)
137: }

139: // DeleteNetnsSymlink deletes the symlink file created for the container netns.
140: func (n *sros) DeleteNetnsSymlink() error {
141: 	var errs []error
142:

147: 		}

150: 		}
151: 		errs = append(errs, clabutils.DeleteNetnsSymlink(n.Cfg.LongName))
152: 	}
153:

155:

11: // NetnsHolder is an internal container that owns the network namespace of a node. The node's
12: // containers join it, so the links and the management address outlive their restarts.
13: type NetnsHolder struct {
14: 	DefaultNode
15: }
16: 
17: func (n *NetnsHolder) Init(cfg *clabtypes.NodeConfig, opts ...NodeOption) error {
18: 	n.DefaultNode = *NewDefaultNode(n)
19: 	n.Cfg = cfg
20: 	n.StopSignal = clabtypes.SIGTERM
21: 
22: 	for _, o := range opts {
23: 		o(n)
24: 	}
25: 
26: 	return nil
27: }
28: 
29: // EnsureRunning starts or unpauses the holder, so that the containers of node can join it.
30: func (n *NetnsHolder) EnsureRunning(ctx context.Context, node string) error {
31: 	switch status := n.GetContainerStatus(ctx); status {
32: 	case clabruntime.Running:
33: 	case clabruntime.Created, clabruntime.Stopped:
34: 		if err := n.Start(ctx); err != nil {
35: 			return fmt.Errorf("node %q network namespace container start error: %w", node, err)
36: 		}
37: 	case clabruntime.Paused:
38: 		if err := n.Runtime.UnpauseContainer(ctx, n.Cfg.LongName); err != nil {
39: 			return fmt.Errorf("node %q network namespace container unpause error: %w", node, err)
40: 		}
41: 	case clabruntime.NotFound:
42: 		return fmt.Errorf(
43: 			"node %q network namespace container %q not found; recreate the node",
44: 			node, n.Cfg.LongName,
45: 		)
46: 	default:
47: 		return fmt.Errorf("node %q network namespace container %q is %s",
48: 			node, n.Cfg.LongName, status)
49: 	}
50: 
51: 	return nil
52: }

The node's\n// containers join it, so the links and the management address outlive their restarts.\ntype NetnsHolder struct {\n\tDefaultNode\n}\n\nfunc (n *NetnsHolder) Init(cfg *clabtypes.NodeConfig, opts ...NodeOption) error {\n\tn.DefaultNode = *NewDefaultNode(n)\n\tn.Cfg = cfg\n\tn.StopSignal = clabtypes.SIGTERM\n\n\tfor _, o := range opts {\n\t\to(n)\n\t}\n\n\treturn nil\n}\n\n// EnsureRunning starts or unpauses the holder, so that the containers of node can join it.\nfunc (n *NetnsHolder) EnsureRunning(ctx context.Context, node string) error {\n\tswitch status := n.GetContainerStatus(ctx); status {\n\tcase clabruntime.Running:\n\tcase clabruntime.Created, clabruntime.Stopped:\n\t\tif err := n.Start(ctx); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"node %q network namespace container start error: %w\", node, err)\n\t\t}\n\tcase clabruntime.Paused:\n\t\tif err := n.Runtime.UnpauseContainer(ctx, n.Cfg.LongName); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"node %q network namespace container unpause error: %w\", node, err)\n\t\t}\n\tcase clabruntime.NotFound:\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\n\t\t\t\"node %q network namespace container %q not found; recreate the node\",\n\t\t\tnode, n.Cfg.LongName,\n\t\t)\n\tdefault:\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"node %q network namespace container %q is %s\",\n\t\t\tnode, n.Cfg.LongName, status)\n\t}\n\n\treturn nil\n}",

98:  func runtimeContainerLess(a, b clabruntime.GenericContainer) bool {
99: +	// internal holders own the network namespace of the other containers in the group,
100: +	// so they sort first to be deleted last.
101: +	aInternal := a.Labels[clabconstants.InternalNode] == "true"
102: +	bInternal := b.Labels[clabconstants.InternalNode] == "true"
103: +	if aInternal != bInternal {
104: +		return aInternal
105: +	}
106: +
107:  	aName := runtimeContainerNodeName(a)
108:  	bName := runtimeContainerNodeName(b)

112: diff --git a/docs/manual/kinds/srl.md b/docs/manual/kinds/srl.md
113: index fa4fa2a..269d4ba 100644
114: --- a/docs/manual/kinds/srl.md
115: +++ b/docs/manual/kinds/srl.md
116: @@ -464,10 +464,20 @@ Containerlab will configure the `netconf-mgmt` ssh server running over port 830
117:  SR Linux container can run without a license emulating the datacenter types (7220 IXR) :partying_face:.  
118:  In that license-less mode, the datapath is limited to 1000 PPS and the `sr_linux` process will restart once a week.
119:  
120:  The license file lifts these limitations as well as unlocks chassis-based platform variants and a path to it can be provided with [`license`](../nodes.md#license) directive.
121:  
122: +### Reboot
123: +
124: +A reboot issued from within the node, for example with `tools platform chassis reboot`, restarts the SR Linux container. The node comes back with its links, saved configuration and management address intact.
125: +
126: +To support that, SR Linux nodes default to the `unless-stopped` [restart policy](../nodes.md#restart-policy), and containerlab keeps the links and the management address of each node in an internal `<node-name>-netns` container. The internal container is only listed by `containerlab inspect --all`, and it is removed together with the node.
127: +
128: +Use `containerlab stop`, `start` and `restart` to manage the lifecycle of SR Linux nodes instead of restarting the containers with the container runtime directly.
129: +
130: +Nodes with a user-defined [`network-mode`](../nodes.md#network-mode) do not use the internal container.
131: +
132:  ## Container configuration
133:  
134:  To start an SR Linux NOS containerlab uses the configuration that is described in SR Linux Software Installation Guide
135:  
136:  /// tab | Startup command
137: diff --git a/docs/manual/nodes.md b/docs/manual/nodes.md
138: index f9b8ba3..d5c0171 100644
139: --- a/docs/manual/nodes.md
140: +++ b/docs/manual/nodes.md
141: @@ -140,11 +140,11 @@ Valid values are:
142:  - `no` - Don't automatically restart the container.
143:  - `on-failure` - Restart the container if it exits due to an error, which manifests as a non-zero exit code. The on-failure policy only prompts a restart if the container exits with a failure. It doesn't restart the container if the daemon restarts.
144:  - `always` - Always restart the container if it stops. If it's manually stopped, it's restarted only when Docker daemon restarts or the container itself is manually restarted.
145:  - `unless-stopped` Similar to always, except that when the container is stopped (manually or otherwise), it isn't restarted even after Docker daemon restarts.
146:  
147: -`no` is the default restart policy value for all kinds, but `linux`. Linux kind defaults to `always`.
148: +`no` is the default restart policy value for all kinds, but `linux` and `nokia_srlinux`. Linux kind defaults to `always`, and [SR Linux](kinds/srl.md#reboot) kind defaults to `unless-stopped`.
149:

151:  topology:
152:    nodes:
153:      srl:
154: diff --git a/nodes/netns_holder.go b/nodes/netns_holder.go
155: new file mode 100644
156: index 0000000..7d1e9fd
157: --- /dev/null
158: +++ b/nodes/netns_holder.go
159: @@ -0,0 +1,52 @@
160: +package nodes
161: +
162: +import (
163: +	"context"
164: +	"fmt"
165: +
166: +	clabruntime "github.com/srl-labs/containerlab/runtime"
167: +	clabtypes "github.com/srl-labs/containerlab/types"
168: +)
169: +
170: +// NetnsHolder is an internal container that owns the network namespace of a node. The node's
171: +// containers join it, so the links and the management address outlive their restarts.
172: +type NetnsHolder struct {
173: +	DefaultNode
174: +}
175: +
176: +func (n *NetnsHolder) Init(cfg *clabtypes.NodeConfig, opts ...NodeOption) error {
177: +	n.DefaultNode = *NewDefaultNode(n)
178: +	n.Cfg = cfg
179: +	n.StopSignal = clabtypes.SIGTERM
180: +
181: +	for _, o := range opts {
182: +		o(n)
183: +	}
184: +
185: +	return nil
186: +}
187: +
188: +// EnsureRunning starts or unpauses the holder, so that the containers of node can join it.
189: +func (n *NetnsHolder) EnsureRunning(ctx context.Context, node string) error {
190: +	switch status := n.GetContainerStatus(ctx); status {
191: +	case clabruntime.Running:
192: +	case clabruntime.Created, clabruntime.Stopped:
193: +		if err := n.Start(ctx); err != nil {
194: +			return fmt.Errorf("node %q network namespace container start error: %w", node, err)
195: +		}
196: +	case clabruntime.Paused:
197: +		if err := n.Runtime.UnpauseContainer(ctx, n.Cfg.LongName); err != nil {
198: +			return fmt.Errorf("node %q network namespace container unpause error: %w", node, err)
199: +		}
200: +	case clabruntime.NotFound:
201: +		return fmt.Errorf(
202: +			"node %q network namespace container %q not found; recreate the node",
203: +			node, n.Cfg.LongName,
204: +		)
205: +	default:
206: +		return fmt.Errorf("node %q network namespace container %q is %s",
207: +			node, n.Cfg.LongName, status)
208: +	}
209: +
210: +	return nil
211: +}

213: new file mode 100644
214: index 0000000..6deb309
215: --- /dev/null
216: +++ b/nodes/srl/netns.go
217: @@ -0,0 +1,132 @@
218: +package srl
219: +
220: +import (
221: +	"context"
222: +	"errors"
223: +	"maps"
224: +
225: +	clabconstants "github.com/srl-labs/containerlab/constants"
226: +	clabnodes "github.com/srl-labs/containerlab/nodes"
227: +	clabtypes "github.com/srl-labs/containerlab/types"
228: +	clabutils "github.com/srl-labs/containerlab/utils"
229: +)
230: +
231: +const netnsNodeType = "srl-netns"
232: +
233: +// usesNetnsNode reports whether the node runs in the network namespace of a holder container.
234: +// Nodes with a user-defined network mode keep the network namespace of their own container.
235: +func (n *srl) usesNetnsNode() bool {
236: +	return n.Cfg.NetworkMode == "" && !n.Cfg.IsRootNamespaceBased
237: +}
238: +
239: +func (n *srl) initNetnsNode() error {
240: +	if !n.usesNetnsNode() {
241: +		return nil
242: +	}
243: +
244: +	n.netnsNode = new(clabnodes.NetnsHolder)
245: +
246: +	return n.netnsNode.Init(n.newNetnsConfig(), clabnodes.WithRuntime(n.GetRuntime()))
247: +}
248: +
249: +func (n *srl) newNetnsConfig() *clabtypes.NodeConfig {
250: +	labels := maps.Clone(n.Cfg.Labels)
251: +
252: +	if labels == nil {
253: +		labels = map[string]string{}
254: +	}
255: +
256: +	shortName := n.Cfg.ShortName + "-netns"
257: +	labels[clabconstants.NodeName] = shortName
258: +
259: +	longName := n.Cfg.LongName + "-netns"
260: +	labels[clabconstants.LongName] = longName
261: +
262: +	labels[clabconstants.NodeType] = netnsNodeType
263: +	labels[clabconstants.InternalNode] = "true"
264: +
265: +	labels[clabconstants.RootNodeName] = n.Cfg.ShortName
266: +	labels[clabconstants.RootNodeLongName] = n.Cfg.LongName
267: +
268: +	return &clabtypes.NodeConfig{
269: +		ShortName:             shortName,
270: +		LongName:              longName,
271: +		Hostname:              n.Cfg.GetHostname(),
272: +		Fqdn:                  n.Cfg.Fqdn,
273: +		LabDir:                n.Cfg.LabDir,
274: +		Index:                 n.Cfg.Index,
275: +		Kind:                  n.Cfg.Kind,
276: +		NodeType:              netnsNodeType,
277: +		Image:                 n.Cfg.Image,
278: +		ImagePullPolicy:       n.Cfg.ImagePullPolicy,
279: +		RestartPolicy:         n.Cfg.RestartPolicy,
280: +		Sysctls:               maps.Clone(n.Cfg.Sysctls),
281: +		User:                  "0:0",
282: +		Entrypoint:            "/bin/sh",
283: +		Cmd:                   `-c "trap 'exit 0' TERM INT; sleep infinity & wait $!"`,
284: +		Env:                   map[string]string{},
285: +		PortBindings:          n.Cfg.PortBindings,
286: +		PortSet:               n.Cfg.PortSet,
287: +		MgmtNet:               n.Cfg.MgmtNet,
288: +		MgmtIntf:              n.Cfg.MgmtIntf,
289: +		MgmtIPv4Address:       n.Cfg.MgmtIPv4Address,
290: +		MgmtIPv4AddressAuto:   n.Cfg.MgmtIPv4AddressAuto,
291: +		MgmtIPv4PrefixLength:  n.Cfg.MgmtIPv4PrefixLength,
292: +		MgmtIPv6Address:       n.Cfg.MgmtIPv6Address,
293: +		MgmtIPv6AddressAuto:   n.Cfg.MgmtIPv6AddressAuto,
294: +		MgmtIPv6PrefixLength:  n.Cfg.MgmtIPv6PrefixLength,
295: +		MgmtIPv4Gateway:       n.Cfg.MgmtIPv4Gateway,
296: +		MgmtIPv6Gateway:       n.Cfg.MgmtIPv6Gateway,
297: +		MacAddress:            n.Cfg.MacAddress,
298: +		Aliases:               n.Cfg.Aliases,
299: +		DNS:                   n.Cfg.DNS,
300: +		ExtraHosts:            n.Cfg.ExtraHosts,
301: +		Labels:                labels,
302: +		Runtime:               n.Cfg.Runtime,
303: +		ResultingPortBindings: n.Cfg.ResultingPortBindings,
304: +	}
305: +}
306: +
307: +// containerConfig returns the config of the SR Linux container attached to the holder's
308: +// network namespace. The runtime rejects network settings for such containers, as they
309: +// belong to the holder.
310: +func (n *srl) containerConfig() *clabtypes.NodeConfig {
311: +	cfg := *n.Cfg
312: +	cfg.NetworkMode = "container:" + n.netnsNode.GetShortName()
313: +	cfg.DNS = nil
314: +	cfg.ExtraHosts = nil
315: +	cfg.MacAddress = ""
316: +	cfg.PortBindings = nil
317: +	cfg.PortSet = nil
318: +
319: +	return &cfg
320: +}
321: +
322: +// linkNetns points the node's netns symlink to the holder, as the namespace path of the
323: +// SR Linux container changes whenever the container restarts.
324: +func (n *srl) linkNetns(ctx context.Context) error {
325: +	nsPath, err := n.netnsNode.GetNSPath(ctx)
326: +	if err != nil {
327: +		return err
328: +	}
329: +
330: +	return clabutils.LinkContainerNS(nsPath, n.Cfg.LongName)
331: +}
332: +
333: +// GetNSPath retrieves the Namespace Path.
334: +func (n *srl) GetNSPath(ctx context.Context) (string, error) {
335: +	if n.netnsNode == nil {
336: +		return n.DefaultNode.GetNSPath(ctx)
337: +	}
338: +
339: +	return n.netnsNode.GetNSPath(ctx)
340: +}
341: +
342: +// DeleteNetnsSymlink deletes the symlink file created for the container netns.
343: +func (n *srl) DeleteNetnsSymlink() error {
344: +	if n.netnsNode == nil {
345: +		return n.DefaultNode.DeleteNetnsSymlink()
346: +	}
347: +
348: +	return errors.Join(n.DefaultNode.DeleteNetnsSymlink(), n.netnsNode.DeleteNetnsSymlink())
349: +}

680: +	if _, err := n.Runtime.StartContainer(ctx, cID, n); err != nil {
681: +		return err
682: +	}
683: +
684: +	if err := n.linkNetns(ctx); err != nil {
685: +		return err
686: +	}
687: +
688: +	n.SetState(clabnodesstate.Deployed)
689: +
690: +	return nil
691: +}
692: +
693: +func (n *srl) Start(ctx context.Context) error {
694: +	if n.netnsNode == nil {
695: +		return n.DefaultNode.Start(ctx)
696: +	}
697: +
698: +	if err := n.netnsNode.EnsureRunning(ctx, n.Cfg.ShortName); err != nil {
699: +		return err
700: +	}
701: +
702: +	if err := n.DefaultNode.Start(ctx); err != nil {
703: +		return err
704: +	}
705: +
706: +	return n.linkNetns(ctx)
707: +}
708: +
709: +// Stop also stops the holder, so that the next start gets a fresh network namespace without
710: +// interfaces left behind by the stopped SR Linux container.
711: +func (n *srl) Stop(ctx context.Context) error {
712: +	if err := n.DefaultNode.Stop(ctx); err != nil || n.netnsNode == nil {
713: +		return err
714: +	}
715: +
716: +	if n.netnsNode.GetContainerStatus(ctx) != clabruntime.Running {
717: +		return nil
718: +	}
719: +
720: +	return n.Runtime.StopContainer(ctx, n.netnsNode.Config().LongName, n.netnsNode.StopSignal)
721: +}
722: +
723: +func (n *srl) Delete(ctx context.Context) error {
724: +	if n.netnsNode == nil {
725: +		return n.DefaultNode.Delete(ctx)
726: +	}
727: +
728: +	return errors.Join(n.DefaultNode.Delete(ctx), n.netnsNode.Delete(ctx))
729: +}
730: +

732: +// When only the holder exists, it is returned so that it is not orphaned on destroy.
733: +func (n *srl) GetContainers(ctx context.Context) ([]clabruntime.GenericContainer, error) {
734: +	cnts, err := n.DefaultNode.GetContainers(ctx)
735: +	if n.netnsNode == nil {
736: +		return cnts, err
737: +	}
738: +
739: +	if err != nil {
740: +		if errors.Is(err, clabnodes.ErrContainersNotFound) {
741: +			return n.netnsNode.GetContainers(ctx)
742: +		}
743: +
744: +		return nil, err
745: +	}
746: +
747: +	holder, err := n.netnsNode.GetContainers(ctx)
748: +	if err != nil {
749: +		if errors.Is(err, clabnodes.ErrContainersNotFound) {
750: +			return cnts, nil
751: +		}
752: +
753: +		return nil, err
754: +	}
755: +
756: +	cnts[0].NetworkName = holder[0].NetworkName
757: +	cnts[0].NetworkSettings = holder[0].NetworkSettings
758: +	cnts[0].Ports = holder[0].Ports
759: +
760: +	return cnts, nil
761: +}

Reasoning
Now I have the full diff. Let me analyze remaining questions:

**A. `srl.Stop` — holder stop after node stop.** DefaultNode.Stop calls ParkEndpoints first, which moves endpoints to the parking netns — so after stopping the node, endpoints are safe in parking netns. Then stopping the holder kills the node netns. On `Start`, EnsureRunning starts holder, DefaultNode.Start starts node container, RestoreEndpoints restores into GetNSPath (holder netns). Wait — DefaultNode.Start calls d.RestoreEndpoints which uses parkingNode.RestoreTo(ctx, d) — d is the srl node, RestoreTo uses d.GetNSPath() which resolves to the holder's netns. Good.

But there's an issue: `srl.Stop` → `DefaultNode.Stop` — for a running srl container with restart policy `unless-stopped`, `docker stop` marks the container as manually stopped; that's fine.

But note: the srl container has restart policy `unless-stopped`. When the holder is stopped while the srl container is still running (race), the srl container dies abruptly. Order in srl.Stop: node stop first, then holder. Fine.

**B. `Stop` when the holder was started but srl node is NotFound**: DefaultNode.Stop returns error "not found". OK.

**C. Potential issue — `srl.Stop` stops the holder even when the holder is "Paused"?** Check status != Running → return nil, so Paused holder is left paused. Minor.

**D. Restarting via `clab restart`**: robot test uses `clab restart -t ... --node srl1`. How is restart implemented? Probably Stop then Start. srl.Stop stops node then holder; srl.Start starts holder (EnsureRunning) then node, then linkNetns. Good.

**E. Deploy ordering issue — holder Deploy uses DefaultNode.Deploy which sets `d.Config().Env[ClabEnvIntfs]`.** Fine.

**F. Potential bug: `srl.Deploy` — if the holder Deploy succeeds but `CreateContainer` fails, the holder remains running (leaked). Minor; destroy handles orphans.

**G. `GetContainers` when node exists: it calls DefaultNode.GetContainers — which lists containers by node name; srl container exists. Then merges holder's network info. Good. But what if both missing → returns holder containers (comment says "so that it is not orphaned on destroy"). destroy path uses ListContainers with lab name filter presumably, not GetContainers. OK.

**H. Key concern 1: the `unless-stopped` default restart policy for ALL srl nodes, including those with user-defined network-mode or root-ns-based.** IsRootNamespaceBased srl? srl with `network-mode: host`? usesNetnsNode false → no holder, but restart policy still unless-stopped. That changes behavior for all srl deployments: previously `no`. Now any srl container that exits will be restarted by docker, e.g., after `clab destroy`... destroy deletes containers, fine. But what about srl containers that are stopped by users manually — with unless-stopped, a daemon restart won't restart them (that's the point of unless-stopped). OK.

**I. Key concern 2: holder restart policy when user sets `restart-policy: always`** — holder inherits. When srl node is stopped via `clab stop` and later destroy — fine.

**J. Key concern 3: mgmt IP allocation & duplicates.** The holder takes the node's mgmt IP settings. Two srl nodes with explicit mgmt IPs — holder A and holder B — each gets its own. Duplicate detection across the lab: does the mgmt allocation consider the holder configs (netnsNode configs) as separate "nodes" for IP allocation? The holder is not in c.Nodes; its config is built from the node's config, so the node's own MgmtIPv4Address is also applied to the node's container create call... but for container: mode, docker ignores IPAM. The holder gets the IP. But is the mgmt IP allocation done before Init (via clab.Cfg) — node config's MgmtIPv4Address is set by the mgmt IP allocator over c.Nodes. The holder copies it. Good.

But wait — is there an IPAM uniqueness check that scans containers on the mgmt network (e.g., `verifyDuplicateAddresses` or podman IP allocation counting existing containers)? For apply flows, `collectExistingManagementAddresses` iterates group containers and records (NodeName=group name? No—`NodeName: name` where name is the group name = "srl1", ContainerID = ctr.ID). The holder's ID is stored under the node's name "srl1". So on recreate, the node's mgmt IP can be preserved via the holder's address. Good design.

**K. Key concern 4: `inventory.go` / `graph.go` / `sshconfig.go` internal-node filtering** — these work off runtime container lists with the InternalNode label; the holder has the label, so it's excluded. Pre-existing mechanism from tailscale sidecars. Good.

**L. `events/netlink.go` line 219: RootNodeName label — related to interface add/remove events mapping to nodes. When an interface appears in the holder netns... the events watcher resolves the netns of interfaces to nodes? Let me check netlink.go around 219. This matters: when links are added (e.g., hot-apply), the interface is created in the holder netns; the event maps the netns to a node. With RootNodeName label handling, presumably the netlink watcher resolves container by netns and maps to root node. Pre-existing for sros; now srl benefits. OK.

**M. Big one: `runtimeContainerLess` ordering vs. deleteApplyNodes reverse iteration.** In `deleteApplyNodes`, containers are iterated in reverse: `for i := len(...)-1; i >= 0; i--`. Sorted: internal first → reverse: non-internal deleted first, internal last. Test asserts node deleted before holder. Consistent.

But wait — what about destroy (not apply)? In destroy, nodes are deleted via `node.Delete()` per node (srl.Delete → node then holder). Fine.

**N. Now check `planApply` / `topology_reconcile.go` for how groups map to nodes and whether internal containers cause issues.** E.g., `reconcileNodes` might compare container labels vs node configs. The holder container has NodeType "srl-netns" and NodeName "srl1-netns" — is there a check "runtime containers not matching topology nodes" that would flag the holder as orphan? Let me look at topology_reconcile.go more closely, especially how it decides deletions/recreations and how it matches nodes.

Also `checkApplyTopologyDefinition` → verifyLinks etc.

Let me read topology_reconcile.go.
