66: 		len(p.staleEndpoints) == 0
67: }
68: 
69: func newApplyPlan(currentNodes map[string]*runtimeNodeGroup, state *LabState) *applyPlan {
70: 	return &applyPlan{
71: 		currentNodes:       currentNodes,
72: 		addedNodeSet:       map[string]struct{}{},
73: 		deletedNodeSet:     map[string]struct{}{},
74: 		recreatedNodeSet:   map[string]struct{}{},
75: 		parkedNodeSet:      map[string]struct{}{},
76: 		startNodeSet:       map[string]struct{}{},
77: 		restartNodeSet:     map[string]struct{}{},
78: 		linkRestartNodeSet: map[string]struct{}{},
79: 		nodeDiffs:          map[string]*clabtypes.TopologyDiff{},
80: 		plannedLinkSet:     map[int]struct{}{},
81: 		desiredEndpointSet: map[applyEndpointKey]struct{}{},
82: 		liveEndpointSet:    map[applyEndpointKey]struct{}{},
83: 		liveEndpointInfo:   map[applyEndpointKey]clablinks.OwnedInterface{},
84: 		endpointNodes:      map[string]clablinks.Node{},
85: 		state:              state,
86: 		nodeChangeReasons:  map[string]string{},
87: 	}
88: }
89: 
90: func (p *applyPlan) isExternallyManaged(nodeName string) bool {
91: 	if p == nil {
92: 		return false
93: 	}
94: 	node := p.currentNodes[nodeName]
95: 	return node != nil && node.external
96: }
97: 
98: func (p *applyPlan) isRootNamespaceNode(nodeName string) bool {
99: 	if p == nil {
100: 		return false
101: 	}
102: 	node := p.currentNodes[nodeName]
103: 	return node != nil && node.rootNamespaceBased
104: }
105: 
106: func (p *applyPlan) isNonContainerNode(nodeName string) bool {
107: 	return p.isExternallyManaged(nodeName) || p.isRootNamespaceNode(nodeName)
108: }
109: 
110: // isNewNonContainerNode reports whether a non-container node (bridge, host,
111: // ext-container) is absent from the previously deployed topology. Such nodes
112: // exist outside the lab, so they are always listed as current nodes, even
113: // when the topology has just added them.
114: func (p *applyPlan) isNewNonContainerNode(nodeName string) bool {
115: 	if !p.isNonContainerNode(nodeName) || p.state == nil || p.state.Topology == nil {
116: 		return false
117: 	}
118: 	_, exists := p.state.Topology.Nodes[nodeName]
119: 	return !exists
120: }
121: 
122: // networkModeContainerTarget returns the referenced node name for a
123: // "network-mode: container:<name>" config, or "" if networkMode does not
124: // share another container's network namespace.
125: func networkModeContainerTarget(networkMode string) string {
126: 	if target, shared := strings.CutPrefix(networkMode, "container:"); shared {
127: 		return target
128: 	}
129: 	return ""
130: }
131: 
132: // checkApplyNetworkModeTargets rejects apply when a node's network-mode:
133: // container:<target> target is being removed from the topology while the
134: // dependent node stays desired. Deleting the target would leave the
135: // dependent silently attached to a defunct network namespace.
136: func (c *CLab) checkApplyNetworkModeTargets(plan *applyPlan) error {
137: 	if plan == nil {
138: 		return nil
139: 	}
140: 
141: 	for _, nodeName := range sortedNodeNames(c.Nodes) {
142: 		networkMode := c.Nodes[nodeName].Config().NetworkMode
143: 		target := networkModeContainerTarget(networkMode)
144: 		if target == "" {
145: 			continue
146: 		}
147: 		if _, deleted := plan.deletedNodeSet[target]; deleted {
148: 			return fmt.Errorf(
149: 				"node %q has network-mode %q, but %q is being removed from the topology; "+
150: 					"remove or retarget %q as well",
151: 				nodeName,
152: 				networkMode,
153: 				target,
154: 				nodeName,
155: 			)
156: 		}
157: 	}
158: 
159: 	return nil
160: }
161: 
162: // planNetworkModeCascade forces recreation of nodes whose network-mode:
163: // container:<target> target is itself being recreated. Docker binds
164: // NetworkMode to the target container's ID at creation time, so a plain
165: // restart of the dependent cannot rebind it to the target's new container;
166: // only recreating the dependent does. A reverse dependency graph visits each
167: // node and dependency at most once, including long namespace-sharing chains.
168: func (c *CLab) planNetworkModeCascade(plan *applyPlan) {
169: 	if plan == nil || len(plan.recreatedNodeSet) == 0 {
170: 		return
171: 	}
172: 
173: 	dependents := make(map[string][]string)
174: 	for name, node := range c.Nodes {
175: 		if target := networkModeContainerTarget(node.Config().NetworkMode); target != "" {
176: 			dependents[target] = append(dependents[target], name)
177: 		}
178: 	}
179: 	queue := make([]string, 0, len(c.Nodes))
180: 	for name := range plan.recreatedNodeSet {
181: 		queue = append(queue, name)
182: 	}
183: 	for i := 0; i < len(queue); i++ {
184: 		target := queue[i]
185: 		for _, nodeName := range dependents[target] {
186: 			if _, recreated := plan.recreatedNodeSet[nodeName]; recreated {
187: 				continue
188: 			}
189: 			if _, added := plan.addedNodeSet[nodeName]; added {
190: 				continue
191: 			}
192: 
193: 			plan.recreatedNodeSet[nodeName] = struct{}{}
194: 			delete(plan.restartNodeSet, nodeName)
195: 			delete(plan.linkRestartNodeSet, nodeName)
196: 			plan.nodeChangeReasons[nodeName] = fmt.Sprintf(
197: 				"network-mode target %q recreated", target,
198: 			)
199: 			queue = append(queue, nodeName)
200: 		}
201: 	}
202: }
203: 
204: func (c *CLab) planApply(
205: 	ctx context.Context,
206: 	currentNodes map[string]*runtimeNodeGroup,
207: ) (*applyPlan, error) {
208: 	state, err := c.LoadState()
209: 	if err != nil {
210: 		log.Warn("Failed to load state file", "error", err)
211: 	}
212: 
213: 	plan := newApplyPlan(currentNodes, state)
214: 
215: 	for _, nodeName := range sortedNodeNames(c.Nodes) {
216: 		if _, exists := currentNodes[nodeName]; !exists {
217: 			status := c.Nodes[nodeName].GetContainerStatus(ctx)
218: 			if status != clabruntime.NotFound {
219: 				return nil, fmt.Errorf(
220: 					"node %q container %q already exists outside the runtime lab state",
221: 					nodeName,
222: 					c.Nodes[nodeName].Config().LongName,
223: 				)
224: 			}
225: 
226: 			plan.addedNodeSet[nodeName] = struct{}{}
227: 			continue
228: 		}
229: 
230: 		if plan.isNewNonContainerNode(nodeName) {
231: 			plan.addedNodeSet[nodeName] = struct{}{}
232: 		}
233: 	}
234: 
235: 	for _, nodeName := range sortedRuntimeNodeGroupNames(currentNodes) {
236: 		if _, exists := c.Nodes[nodeName]; !exists {
237: 			plan.deletedNodeSet[nodeName] = struct{}{}
238: 		}
239: 	}
240: 
241: 	if err := c.checkApplyNetworkModeTargets(plan); err != nil {
242: 		return nil, err
243: 	}
244: 
245: 	if err := c.planNodeReconciliation(ctx, plan); err != nil {
246: 		return nil, err
247: 	}
248: 
249: 	c.planParkedNodes(ctx, plan)
250: 	c.planStoppedNodes(ctx, plan)
251: 
252: 	for _, linkIdx := range sortedLinkIndexes(c.Links) {
253: 		for _, ep := range clablinks.RuntimeEndpoints(c.Links[linkIdx]) {
254: 			plan.desiredEndpointSet[endpointKeyFromEndpoint(ep)] = struct{}{}
255: 		}
256: 	}
257: 
258: 	if err := c.discoverLiveApplyEndpoints(ctx, plan); err != nil {
259: 		return nil, err
260: 	}
261: 
262: 	if err := c.validateDesiredEndpointOwnership(ctx, plan); err != nil {
263: 		return nil, err
264: 	}
265: 
266: 	c.planDeletedEndpoints(ctx, plan)
267: 
268: 	for _, linkIdx := range sortedLinkIndexes(c.Links) {
269: 		link := c.Links[linkIdx]
270: 		if !plan.linkNeedsDeploy(link) {
271: 			continue
272: 		}
273: 
274: 		plan.addDeployApplyLink(linkIdx, link)
275: 
276: 		for _, ep := range clablinks.RuntimeEndpoints(link) {
277: 			nodeName := ep.GetNode().GetShortName()
278: 			if _, exists := currentNodes[nodeName]; !exists {
279: 				continue
280: 			}
281: 			if _, added := plan.addedNodeSet[nodeName]; added {
282: 				continue
283: 			}
284: 
285: 			c.planAffectedApplyNode(ctx, plan, nodeName, "added link")
286: 		}
287: 	}
288: 
289: 	// Link reconciliation can request additional recreations. Propagate namespace
290: 	// dependencies only after those decisions, then park every affected live node.
291: 	c.planNetworkModeCascade(plan)
292: 	c.planTailscaleSidecarRecreates(plan)
293: 	c.planParkedNodes(ctx, plan)
294: 	c.planRecreatedNodeLinks(plan)
295: 	for nodeName := range plan.recreatedNodeSet {
296: 		delete(plan.restartNodeSet, nodeName)
297: 		delete(plan.linkRestartNodeSet, nodeName)
298: 		delete(plan.startNodeSet, nodeName)
299: 	}
300: 	if err := c.planNetworkModeRestarts(plan); err != nil {
301: 		return nil, err
302: 	}
303: 
304: 	return plan, nil
305: }
306: 
307: func (p *applyPlan) addDeployApplyLink(linkIdx int, link clablinks.Link) {
308: 	if _, planned := p.plannedLinkSet[linkIdx]; planned {
309: 		return
310: 	}
311: 
312: 	p.plannedLinkSet[linkIdx] = struct{}{}
313: 	p.addedLinks = append(p.addedLinks, link)
314: }
315: 
316: func (c *CLab) planParkedNodes(ctx context.Context, plan *applyPlan) {
317: 	if plan == nil {
318: 		return
319: 	}
320: 
321: 	for nodeName := range plan.recreatedNodeSet {
322: 		if _, parked := plan.parkedNodeSet[nodeName]; parked {
323: 			continue
324: 		}
325: 		node, exists := c.Nodes[nodeName]
326: 		if !exists {
327: 			continue
328: 		}
329: 		if clabruntime.ContainerHasJoinableNetns(node.GetContainerStatus(ctx)) {
330: 			plan.parkedNodeSet[nodeName] = struct{}{}
331: 		}
332: 	}
333: }
334: 
335: func (c *CLab) planStoppedNodes(ctx context.Context, plan *applyPlan) {
336: 	if plan == nil {
337: 		return
338: 	}
339: 
340: 	for nodeName := range plan.currentNodes {
341: 		if plan.isNonContainerNode(nodeName) {
342: 			continue
343: 		}
344: 		node, exists := c.Nodes[nodeName]
345: 		if !exists {
346: 			continue
347: 		}
348: 		if _, deleted := plan.deletedNodeSet[nodeName]; deleted {
349: 			continue
350: 		}
351: 		if _, added := plan.addedNodeSet[nodeName]; added {
352: 			continue
353: 		}
354: 		if _, recreated := plan.recreatedNodeSet[nodeName]; recreated {
355: 			continue
356: 		}
357: 
358: 		switch node.GetContainerStatus(ctx) {
359: 		case clabruntime.Stopped, clabruntime.Created:
360: 			plan.startNodeSet[nodeName] = struct{}{}
361: 		}
362: 	}
363: }
364: 
365: func (c *CLab) planRecreatedNodeLinks(plan *applyPlan) {
366: 	if plan == nil || len(plan.recreatedNodeSet) == 0 {
367: 		return
368: 	}
369: 
370: 	rebuildSet := make(map[string]struct{}, len(plan.recreatedNodeSet))
371: 	for nodeName := range plan.recreatedNodeSet {
372: 		if _, parked := plan.parkedNodeSet[nodeName]; parked {
373: 			continue
374: 		}
375: 		rebuildSet[nodeName] = struct{}{}
376: 	}
377: 
378: 	for _, linkIdx := range sortedLinkIndexes(c.Links) {
379: 		link := c.Links[linkIdx]
380: 		if !linkTouchesNodeSet(link, rebuildSet) {
381: 			continue
382: 		}
383: 
384: 		plan.addDeployApplyLink(linkIdx, link)
385: 	}
386: }
387: 
388: func linkTouchesNodeSet(link clablinks.Link, nodeSet map[string]struct{}) bool {
389: 	if len(nodeSet) == 0 {
390: 		return false
391: 	}
392: 
393: 	for _, ep := range clablinks.RuntimeEndpoints(link) {
394: 		key := endpointKeyFromEndpoint(ep)
395: 		if _, exists := nodeSet[key.node]; exists {
396: 			return true
397: 		}
398: 	}
399: 
400: 	return false
401: }
402: 
403: func (c *CLab) planDeletedEndpoints(ctx context.Context, plan *applyPlan) {
404: 	plannedEndpointSet := map[applyEndpointKey]struct{}{}
405: 
406: 	for _, key := range sortedEndpointKeys(plan.liveEndpointSet) {
407: 		if _, exists := plan.desiredEndpointSet[key]; exists {
408: 			continue
409: 		}
410: 		c.addStaleApplyEndpoint(ctx, plan, plannedEndpointSet, key)
411: 	}
412: }
413: 
414: func (c *CLab) addStaleApplyEndpoint(
415: 	ctx context.Context,
416: 	plan *applyPlan,
417: 	plannedEndpointSet map[applyEndpointKey]struct{},
418: 	key applyEndpointKey,
419: ) {
420: 	if key.node == "" || key.iface == "" {
421: 		return
422: 	}
423: 	if _, exists := plannedEndpointSet[key]; exists {
424: 		return
425: 	}
426: 	if _, desired := plan.desiredEndpointSet[key]; desired {
427: 		return
428: 	}
429: 
430: 	node, exists := plan.endpointNode(key.node)
431: 	if !exists {
432: 		node, exists = c.applyLinkNode(key.node)
433: 	}
434: 	if !exists {
435: 		return
436: 	}
437: 
438: 	plannedEndpointSet[key] = struct{}{}
439: 	plan.staleEndpoints = append(plan.staleEndpoints, applyEndpointRef{key: key, node: node})
440: 
441: 	if _, exists := c.Nodes[key.node]; exists {
442: 		if _, added := plan.addedNodeSet[key.node]; !added {
443: 			c.planAffectedApplyNode(ctx, plan, key.node, "deleted endpoint")
444: 		}
445: 	}
446: 
447: 	c.addDerivedHostStaleEndpoints(plan, plannedEndpointSet, key)
448: }
449: 
450: func (c *CLab) addDerivedHostStaleEndpoints(
451: 	plan *applyPlan,
452: 	plannedEndpointSet map[applyEndpointKey]struct{},
453: 	key applyEndpointKey,
454: ) {
455: 	if key.node == "host" {
456: 		return
457: 	}
458: 	if _, exists := c.Nodes[key.node]; !exists {
459: 		return
460: 	}
461: 
462: 	hostNode, exists := c.applyLinkNode("host")
463: 	if !exists {
464: 		return
465: 	}
466: 
467: 	for _, iface := range []string{
468: 		fmt.Sprintf("ve-%s_%s", key.node, key.iface),
469: 		fmt.Sprintf("vx-%s_%s", key.node, key.iface),
470: 	} {
471: 		hostKey := applyEndpointKey{node: "host", iface: iface}
472: 		if _, planned := plannedEndpointSet[hostKey]; planned {
473: 			continue
474: 		}
475: 		if _, desired := plan.desiredEndpointSet[hostKey]; desired {
476: 			continue
477: 		}
478: 
479: 		plannedEndpointSet[hostKey] = struct{}{}
480: 		plan.staleEndpoints = append(
481: 			plan.staleEndpoints,
482: 			applyEndpointRef{key: hostKey, node: hostNode, bestEffort: true},
483: 		)
484: 	}
485: }
486: 
487: func (c *CLab) discoverLiveApplyEndpoints(
488: 	ctx context.Context,
489: 	plan *applyPlan,
490: ) error {
491: 	desiredNodes := c.applyEndpointDiscoveryNodes(plan)
492: 	for _, nodeName := range sortedLinkNodeNames(desiredNodes) {
493: 		n := desiredNodes[nodeName]
494: 		if _, exists := plan.currentNodes[nodeName]; !exists && !isApplySpecialNode(nodeName) {
495: 			continue
496: 		}
497: 
498: 		if _, recreate := plan.recreatedNodeSet[nodeName]; recreate {
499: 			if _, parked := plan.parkedNodeSet[nodeName]; !parked {
500: 				continue
501: 			}
502: 		}
503: 		if _, added := plan.addedNodeSet[nodeName]; added {
504: 			if _, parked := plan.parkedNodeSet[nodeName]; !parked {
505: 				continue
506: 			}
507: 		}
508: 		if _, start := plan.startNodeSet[nodeName]; start {
509: 			parkingNode, ok := c.applyParkingLinkNode(nodeName)
510: 			if !ok {
511: 				continue
512: 			}
513: 			n = parkingNode
514: 		} else if !isApplySpecialNode(nodeName) && !plan.isRootNamespaceNode(nodeName) {
515: 			status := c.Nodes[nodeName].GetContainerStatus(ctx)
516: 			if !clabruntime.ContainerHasJoinableNetns(status) {
517: 				if plan.isExternallyManaged(nodeName) {
518: 					return fmt.Errorf(
519: 						"externally managed node %q is %s; "+
520: 							"start it outside containerlab before running apply",
521: 						nodeName,
522: 						status,
523: 					)
524: 				}
525: 				return fmt.Errorf(
526: 					"node %q is %s; apply requires existing nodes to have a joinable network namespace",
527: 					nodeName,
528: 					status,
529: 				)
530: 			}
531: 		}
532: 
533: 		plan.setEndpointNode(nodeName, n)
534: 
535: 		interfaces, err := clablinks.DiscoverOwnedInterfacesFor(
536: 			ctx,
537: 			n,
538: 			nodeName,
539: 			c.applyKnownEndpointNames(plan, nodeName),
540: 		)
541: 		if err != nil {
542: 			return fmt.Errorf(
543: 				"failed to discover runtime interfaces for node %q: %w",
544: 				nodeName,
545: 				err,
546: 			)
547: 		}
548: 
549: 		for _, iface := range interfaces {
550: 			key := applyEndpointKey{node: nodeName, iface: iface.Name}
551: 			plan.liveEndpointSet[key] = struct{}{}
552: 			plan.liveEndpointInfo[key] = iface
553: 		}
554: 	}
555: 
556: 	return nil
557: }
558: 
559: func (c *CLab) validateDesiredEndpointOwnership(
560: 	ctx context.Context,
561: 	plan *applyPlan,
562: ) error {
563: 	for _, key := range sortedEndpointKeys(plan.desiredEndpointSet) {
564: 		if _, added := plan.addedNodeSet[key.node]; added {
565: 			continue
566: 		}
567: 
568: 		node, exists := plan.endpointNode(key.node)
569: 		if !exists {
570: 			node, exists = c.applyLinkNode(key.node)
571: 		}
572: 		if !exists {
573: 			continue
574: 		}
575: 
576: 		if err := clablinks.ValidateOwnedInterfaceFor(
577: 			ctx,
578: 			node,
579: 			key.node,
580: 			key.iface,
581: 		); err != nil {
582: 			return fmt.Errorf(
583: 				"desired endpoint %s cannot be reconciled: %w",
584: 				key.String(),
585: 				err,
586: 			)
587: 		}
588: 	}
589: 
590: 	return nil
591: }
592: 
593: func (c *CLab) applyParkingLinkNode(nodeName string) (clablinks.Node, bool) {
594: 	node, exists := c.Nodes[nodeName]
595: 	if !exists || node.Config() == nil || node.Config().LongName == "" {
596: 		return nil, false
597: 	}
598: 
599: 	parkPath, err := clabutils.GetNamedNetNS(
600: 		clabutils.ParkingNetnsName(node.Config().LongName),
601: 	)
602: 	if err != nil {
603: 		return nil, false
604: 	}
605: 
606: 	return clablinks.NewParkingNode(node.Config().LongName, parkPath), true
607: }
608: 
609: func (c *CLab) applyKnownEndpointNames(
610: 	plan *applyPlan,
611: 	nodeName string,
612: ) map[string]struct{} {
613: 	if !isApplySpecialNode(nodeName) {
614: 		return nil
615: 	}
616: 
617: 	names := map[string]struct{}{}
618: 	for key := range plan.desiredEndpointSet {
619: 		if key.node == nodeName {
620: 			names[key.iface] = struct{}{}
621: 		}
622: 	}
623: 
624: 	return names
625: }
626: 
627: func (c *CLab) applyEndpointDiscoveryNodes(plan *applyPlan) map[string]clablinks.Node {
628: 	nodes := make(map[string]clablinks.Node, len(c.Nodes)+2)
629: 	for nodeName, node := range c.Nodes {
630: 		nodes[nodeName] = node
631: 	}
632: 
633: 	for _, key := range sortedEndpointKeys(plan.desiredEndpointSet) {
634: 		if _, exists := nodes[key.node]; exists {
635: 			continue
636: 		}
637: 		if node, exists := c.applyLinkNode(key.node); exists {
638: 			nodes[key.node] = node
639: 		}
640: 	}
641: 
642: 	return nodes
643: }
644: 
645: func (c *CLab) applyLinkNode(nodeName string) (clablinks.Node, bool) {
646: 	if node, exists := c.Nodes[nodeName]; exists {
647: 		return node, true
648: 	}
649: 	node, exists := c.getSpecialLinkNodes()[nodeName]
650: 	return node, exists
651: }
652: 
653: func isApplySpecialNode(nodeName string) bool {
654: 	return nodeName == "host" || nodeName == "mgmt-net"
655: }
656: 
657: func (c *CLab) planAffectedApplyNode(
658: 	ctx context.Context,
659: 	plan *applyPlan,
660: 	nodeName string,
661: 	change string,
662: ) {
663: 	if nodeName == "" {
664: 		return
665: 	}
666: 	if _, planned := plan.linkRestartNodeSet[nodeName]; planned {
667: 		return
668: 	}
669: 	if _, planned := plan.recreatedNodeSet[nodeName]; planned {
670: 		return
671: 	}
672: 
673: 	node, exists := c.Nodes[nodeName]
674: 	if !exists {
675: 		return
676: 	}
677: 	if plan.isExternallyManaged(nodeName) {
678: 		log.Info(
679: 			"Applying link change without node lifecycle action",
680: 			"node", nodeName,
681: 			"change", change,
682: 			"externally-managed", true,
683: 		)
684: 		return
685: 	}
686: 
687: 	overridden := clabnodes.LinkApplyModeOverrideForNode(node) != ""
688: 
689: 	switch clabnodes.LinkApplyModeForNode(ctx, node) {
690: 	case clabnodes.LinkApplyModeLive:
691: 		log.Info(
692: 			"Applying link change without node lifecycle action",
693: 			"node",
694: 			nodeName,
695: 			"change",
696: 			change,
697: 		)
698: 	case clabnodes.LinkApplyModeRestart:
699: 		plan.linkRestartNodeSet[nodeName] = struct{}{}
700: 		plan.nodeChangeReasons[nodeName] = change
701: 		log.Info("Node will be restarted to apply link change", "node", nodeName, "change", change)
702: 	case clabnodes.LinkApplyModeRecreate:
703: 		plan.recreatedNodeSet[nodeName] = struct{}{}
704: 		delete(plan.restartNodeSet, nodeName)
705: 		delete(plan.linkRestartNodeSet, nodeName)
706: 		plan.nodeChangeReasons[nodeName] = change
707: 
708: 		if overridden {

715: 					"link-apply-mode: live on the node to avoid the recreation",
716: 				"node", nodeName,
717: 				"change", change,
718: 			)

720: 	}

767: 		NetworkMode:  topo.GetNodeNetworkMode(nodeName),

772: 		Memory:       topo.GetNodeMemory(nodeName),
773: 		License:      topo.GetNodeLicense(nodeName),

787: func (c *CLab) planNodeReconciliation(ctx context.Context, plan *applyPlan) error {
788: 	if plan == nil || plan.currentNodes == nil {
789: 		return nil
790: 	}
791: 
792: 	var oldTopo *clabtypes.Topology
793: 	if plan.state != nil {
794: 		oldTopo = plan.state.Topology
795: 	}
796: 
797: 	for nodeName := range plan.currentNodes {
798: 		node, exists := c.Nodes[nodeName]
799: 		if !exists {
800: 			continue
801: 		}
802: 		if _, added := plan.addedNodeSet[nodeName]; added {
803: 			continue
804: 		}
805: 
806: 		oldNodeConfig := c.resolveNodeConfigFromTopology(oldTopo, nodeName)
807: 		newNodeConfig := c.resolveNodeConfigFromTopology(c.Config.Topology, nodeName)
808: 		diff := node.ComputeDiff(oldNodeConfig, newNodeConfig)
809: 		plan.nodeDiffs[nodeName] = diff
810: 
811: 		result, err := node.GetReconcilePlan(ctx, diff)
812: 		if err != nil {
813: 			return fmt.Errorf("reconcile planning failed for node %q: %w", nodeName, err)
814: 		}
815: 		if plan.isNonContainerNode(nodeName) && result.Action != clabtypes.TopologyDiffActionNone {
816: 			return fmt.Errorf(
817: 				"node %q is externally managed and cannot be %s for %s",
818: 				nodeName,
819: 				result.Action,
820: 				configDriftReason(diff),
821: 			)
822: 		}
823: 
824: 		switch result.Action {
825: 		case clabtypes.TopologyDiffActionRestart:
826: 			plan.restartNodeSet[nodeName] = struct{}{}
827: 			plan.nodeChangeReasons[nodeName] = configDriftReason(diff)
828: 		case clabtypes.TopologyDiffActionRecreate:
829: 			plan.recreatedNodeSet[nodeName] = struct{}{}
830: 			plan.nodeChangeReasons[nodeName] = configDriftReason(diff)
831: 		}
832: 	}
833: 
834: 	return nil
835: }
836: 
837: func configDriftReason(diff *clabtypes.TopologyDiff) string {
838: 	if diff == nil || len(diff.Fields) == 0 {
839: 		return "config drift"
840: 	}
841: 
842: 	return "config drift: " + strings.Join(diff.Fields, ", ")
843: }

845: func (c *CLab) reconcileNodes(ctx context.Context, plan *applyPlan) error {
846: 	if plan == nil || plan.currentNodes == nil {
847: 		return nil
848: 	}
849: 
850: 	for nodeName := range plan.currentNodes {
851: 		node, exists := c.Nodes[nodeName]
852: 		if !exists {
853: 			continue
854: 		}
855: 		if _, added := plan.addedNodeSet[nodeName]; added {
856: 			continue
857: 		}
858: 		if plan.isRootNamespaceNode(nodeName) {
859: 			continue
860: 		}
861: 		// Recreated nodes are handled exclusively by the apply pipeline
862: 		// (park -> delete -> deploy -> restore). Calling Reconcile here would
863: 		// delete the container before parkRecreatedNodes can capture its
864: 		// interfaces, breaking the recreate flow.
865: 		if _, recreated := plan.recreatedNodeSet[nodeName]; recreated {
866: 			continue
867: 		}
868: 
869: 		diff := plan.nodeDiffs[nodeName]
870: 
871: 		result, err := node.Reconcile(ctx, diff)
872: 		if err != nil {
873: 			return fmt.Errorf("reconcile failed for node %q: %w", nodeName, err)
874: 		}
875: 
876: 		if result.Action == clabtypes.TopologyDiffActionRestart {
877: 			if err := c.waitNodeRunning(ctx, node); err != nil {
878: 				return err
879: 			}
880: 			if err := c.waitNodeHealthyIfAvailable(ctx, node); err != nil {
881: 				return err
882: 			}
883: 		}
884: 	}
885: 
886: 	return nil
887: }

889: func (p *applyPlan) linkNeedsDeploy(link clablinks.Link) bool {
890: 	for _, ep := range clablinks.RuntimeEndpoints(link) {
891: 		key := endpointKeyFromEndpoint(ep)
892: 		if _, parked := p.parkedNodeSet[key.node]; !parked {
893: 			if _, added := p.addedNodeSet[key.node]; added {
894: 				return true
895: 			}
896: 		}
897: 		if _, live := p.liveEndpointSet[key]; !live {
898: 			return true
899: 		}
900: 	}
901: 
902: 	return !p.linkIntact(link)
903: }

905: func (p *applyPlan) linkIntact(link clablinks.Link) bool {
906: 	endpoints := clablinks.RuntimeEndpoints(link)
907: 	if len(endpoints) != 2 || len(p.liveEndpointInfo) == 0 {
908: 		return true
909: 	}
910: 
911: 	left, leftOK := p.liveEndpointInfo[endpointKeyFromEndpoint(endpoints[0])]
912: 	right, rightOK := p.liveEndpointInfo[endpointKeyFromEndpoint(endpoints[1])]
913: 	if !leftOK || !rightOK {
914: 		return false
915: 	}
916: 
917: 	if bridgeMasterMismatch(endpoints[0], left) || bridgeMasterMismatch(endpoints[1], right) {
918: 		return false
919: 	}
920: 
921: 	return left.PeerIndex != 0 &&
922: 		right.PeerIndex != 0 &&
923: 		left.PeerIndex == right.Index &&
924: 		right.PeerIndex == left.Index
925: }
926: 
927: // bridgeMasterMismatch reports whether the live interface of a bridge endpoint is
928: // attached to a bridge other than the one the endpoint resolves to, e.g. after a
929: // mgmt-net link moved to another management network. mgmt-net endpoints whose
930: // management network bridge is not resolved are not checked.
931: func bridgeMasterMismatch(ep clablinks.Endpoint, live clablinks.OwnedInterface) bool {
932: 	node := ep.GetNode()
933: 	if node.GetLinkEndpointType() != clablinks.LinkEndpointTypeBridge ||
934: 		clablinks.IsUnresolvedMgmtBridgeEndpoint(ep) {
935: 		return false
936: 	}
937: 
938: 	return live.MasterName != node.GetShortName()
939: }

!exists {\n\t\t\tplan.deletedNodeSet[nodeName] = struct{}{}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tif err := c.checkApplyNetworkModeTargets(plan); err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\n\tif err := c.planNodeReconciliation(ctx, plan); err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\n\tc.planParkedNodes(ctx, plan)\n\tc.planStoppedNodes(ctx, plan)\n\n\tfor _, linkIdx := range sortedLinkIndexes(c.Links) {\n\t\tfor _, ep := range clablinks.RuntimeEndpoints(c.Links[linkIdx]) {\n\t\t\tplan.desiredEndpointSet[endpointKeyFromEndpoint(ep)] = struct{}{}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tif err := c.discoverLiveApplyEndpoints(ctx, plan); err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\n\tif err := c.validateDesiredEndpointOwnership(ctx, plan); err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\n\tc.planDeletedEndpoints(ctx, plan)\n\n\tfor _, linkIdx := range sortedLinkIndexes(c.Links) {\n\t\tlink := c.Links[linkIdx]\n\t\tif !plan.linkNeedsDeploy(link) {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tplan.addDeployApplyLink(linkIdx, link)\n\n\t\tfor _, ep := range clablinks.RuntimeEndpoints(link) {\n\t\t\tnodeName := ep.GetNode().GetShortName()\n\t\t\tif _, exists := currentNodes[nodeName]; !exists {\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif _, added := plan.addedNodeSet[nodeName]; added {\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\tc.planAffectedApplyNode(ctx, plan, nodeName, \"added link\")\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// Link reconciliation can request additional recreations. Propagate namespace\n\t// dependencies only after those decisions, then park every affected live node.\n\tc.planNetworkModeCascade(plan)\n\tc.planTailscaleSidecarRecreates(plan)\n\tc.planParkedNodes(ctx, plan)\n\tc.planRecreatedNodeLinks(plan)\n\tfor nodeName := range plan.recreatedNodeSet {\n\t\tdelete(plan.restartNodeSet, nodeName)\n\t\tdelete(plan.linkRestartNodeSet, nodeName)\n\t\tdelete(plan.startNodeSet, nodeName)\n\t}\n\tif err := c.planNetworkModeRestarts(plan); err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\n\treturn plan, nil\n}\n\nfunc (p *applyPlan) addDeployApplyLink(linkIdx int, link clablinks.Link) {\n\tif _, planned := p.plannedLinkSet[linkIdx]; planned {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\n\tp.plannedLinkSet[linkIdx] = struct{}{}\n\tp.addedLinks = append(p.addedLinks, link)\n}\n\nfunc (c *CLab) planParkedNodes(ctx context.Context, plan *applyPlan) {\n\tif plan == nil {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\n\tfor nodeName := range plan.recreatedNodeSet {\n\t\tif _, parked := plan.parkedNodeSet[nodeName]; parked {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tnode, exists := c.Nodes[nodeName]\n\t\tif !exists {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tif clabruntime.ContainerHasJoinableNetns(node.GetContainerStatus(ctx)) {\n\t\t\tplan.parkedNodeSet[nodeName] = struct{}{}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (c *CLab) planStoppedNodes(ctx context.Context, plan *applyPlan) {\n\tif plan == nil {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\n\tfor nodeName := range plan.currentNodes {\n\t\tif plan.isNonContainerNode(nodeName) {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tnode, exists := c.Nodes[nodeName]\n\t\tif !exists {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tif _, deleted := plan.deletedNodeSet[nodeName]; deleted {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tif _, added := plan.addedNodeSet[nodeName]; added {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tif _, recreated := plan.recreatedNodeSet[nodeName]; recreated {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tswitch node.GetContainerStatus(ctx) {\n\t\tcase clabruntime.Stopped, clabruntime.Created:\n\t\t\tplan.startNodeSet[nodeName] = struct{}{}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (c *CLab) planRecreatedNodeLinks(plan *applyPlan) {\n\tif plan == nil || len(plan.recreatedNodeSet) == 0 {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\n\trebuildSet := make(map[string]struct{}, len(plan.recreatedNodeSet))\n\tfor nodeName := range plan.recreatedNodeSet {\n\t\tif _, parked := plan.parkedNodeSet[nodeName]; parked {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\trebuildSet[nodeName] = struct{}{}\n\t}\n\n\tfor _, linkIdx := range sortedLinkIndexes(c.Links) {\n\t\tlink := c.Links[linkIdx]\n\t\tif !linkTouchesNodeSet(link, rebuildSet) {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tplan.addDeployApplyLink(linkIdx, link)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc linkTouchesNodeSet(link clablinks.Link, nodeSet map[string]struct{}) bool {\n\tif len(nodeSet) == 0 {\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\n\tfor _, ep := range clablinks.RuntimeEndpoints(link) {\n\t\tkey := endpointKeyFromEndpoint(ep)\n\t\tif _, exists := nodeSet[key.node]; exists {\n\t\t\treturn true\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\treturn false\n}\n\nfunc (c *CLab) planDeletedEndpoints(ctx context.Context, plan *applyPlan) {\n\tplannedEndpointSet := map[applyEndpointKey]struct{}{}\n\n\tfor _, key := range sortedEndpointKeys(plan.liveEndpointSet) {\n\t\tif _, exists := plan.desiredEndpointSet[key]; exists {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tc.addStaleApplyEndpoint(ctx, plan, plannedEndpointSet, key)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (c *CLab) addStaleApplyEndpoint(\n\tctx context.Context,\n\tplan *applyPlan,\n\tplannedEndpointSet map[applyEndpointKey]struct{},\n\tkey applyEndpointKey,\n) {\n\tif key.node == \"\" || key.iface == \"\" {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif _, exists := plannedEndpointSet[key]; exists {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif _, desired := plan.desiredEndpointSet[key]; desired {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\n\tnode, exists := plan.endpointNode(key.node)\n\tif !exists {\n\t\tnode, exists = c.applyLinkNode(key.node)\n\t}\n\tif !exists {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\n\tplannedEndpointSet[key] = struct{}{}\n\tplan.staleEndpoints = append(plan.staleEndpoints, applyEndpointRef{key: key, node: node})\n\n\tif _, exists := c.Nodes[key.node]; exists {\n\t\tif _, added := plan.addedNodeSet[key.node]; !added {\n\t\t\tc.planAffectedApplyNode(ctx, plan, key.node, \"deleted endpoint\")\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tc.addDerivedHostStaleEndpoints(plan, plannedEndpointSet, key)\n}\n\nfunc (c *CLab) addDerivedHostStaleEndpoints(\n\tplan *applyPlan,\n\tplannedEndpointSet map[applyEndpointKey]struct{},\n\tkey applyEndpointKey,\n) {\n\tif key.node == \"host\" {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif _, exists := c.Nodes[key.node]; !exists {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\n\thostNode, exists := c.applyLinkNode(\"host\")\n\tif !exists {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\n\tfor _, iface := range []string{\n\t\tfmt.Sprintf(\"ve-%s_%s\", key.node, key.iface),\n\t\tfmt.Sprintf(\"vx-%s_%s\", key.node, key.iface),\n\t} {\n\t\thostKey := applyEndpointKey{node: \"host\", iface: iface}\n\t\tif _, planned := plannedEndpointSet[hostKey]; planned {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tif _, desired := plan.desiredEndpointSet[hostKey]; desired {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tplannedEndpointSet[hostKey] = struct{}{}\n\t\tplan.staleEndpoints = append(\n\t\t\tplan.staleEndpoints,\n\t\t\tapplyEndpointRef{key: hostKey, node: hostNode, bestEffort: true},\n\t\t)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (c *CLab) discoverLiveApplyEndpoints(\n\tctx context.Context,\n\tplan *applyPlan,\n) error {\n\tdesiredNodes := c.applyEndpointDiscoveryNodes(plan)\n\tfor _, nodeName := range sortedLinkNodeNames(desiredNodes) {\n\t\tn := desiredNodes[nodeName]\n\t\tif _, exists := plan.currentNodes[nodeName]; !exists && !isApplySpecialNode(nodeName) {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tif _, recreate := plan.recreatedNodeSet[nodeName]; recreate {\n\t\t\tif _, parked := plan.parkedNodeSet[nodeName]; !parked {\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tif _, added := plan.addedNodeSet[nodeName]; added {\n\t\t\tif _, parked := plan.parkedNodeSet[nodeName]; !parked {\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tif _, start := plan.startNodeSet[nodeName]; start {\n\t\t\tparkingNode, ok := c.applyParkingLinkNode(nodeName)\n\t\t\tif !ok {\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tn = parkingNode\n\t\t} else if !isApplySpecialNode(nodeName) && !plan.isRootNamespaceNode(nodeName) {\n\t\t\tstatus := c.Nodes[nodeName].GetContainerStatus(ctx)\n\t\t\tif !clabruntime.ContainerHasJoinableNetns(status) {\n\t\t\t\tif plan.isExternallyManaged(nodeName) {\n\t\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\"externally managed node %q is %s; \"+\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\"start it outside containerlab before running apply\",\n\t\t\t\t\t\tnodeName,\n\t\t\t\t\t\tstatus,\n\t\t\t\t\t)\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\n\t\t\t\t\t\"node %q is %s; apply requires existing nodes to have a joinable network namespace\",\n\t\t\t\t\tnodeName,\n\t\t\t\t\tstatus,\n\t\t\t\t)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tplan.setEndpointNode(nodeName, n)\n\n\t\tinterfaces, err := clablinks.DiscoverOwnedInterfacesFor(\n\t\t\tctx,\n\t\t\tn,\n\t\t\tnodeName,\n\t\t\tc.applyKnownEndpointNames(plan, nodeName),\n\t\t)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\n\t\t\t\t\"failed to discover runtime interfaces for node %q: %w\",\n\t\t\t\tnodeName,\n\t\t\t\terr,\n\t\t\t)\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tfor _, iface := range interfaces {\n\t\t\tkey := applyEndpointKey{node: nodeName, iface: iface.Name}\n\t\t\tplan.liveEndpointSet[key] = struct{}{}\n\t\t\tplan.liveEndpointInfo[key] = iface\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\treturn nil\n}\n\nfunc (c *CLab) validateDesiredEndpointOwnership(\n\tctx context.Context,\n\tplan *applyPlan,\n) error {\n\tfor _, key := range sortedEndpointKeys(plan.desiredEndpointSet) {\n\t\tif _, added := plan.addedNodeSet[key.node]; added {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tnode, exists := plan.endpointNode(key.node)\n\t\tif !exists {\n\t\t\tnode, exists = c.applyLinkNode(key.node)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif !exists {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tif err := clablinks.ValidateOwnedInterfaceFor(\n\t\t\tctx,\n\t\t\tnode,\n\t\t\tkey.node,\n\t\t\tkey.iface,\n\t\t); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\n\t\t\t\t\"desired endpoint %s cannot be reconciled: %w\",\n\t\t\t\tkey.String(),\n\t\t\t\terr,\n\t\t\t)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\treturn nil\n}\n\nfunc (c *CLab) applyParkingLinkNode(nodeName string) (clablinks.Node, bool) {\n\tnode, exists := c.Nodes[nodeName]\n\tif !exists || node.Config() == nil || node.Config().LongName == \"\" {\n\t\treturn nil, false\n\t}\n\n\tparkPath, err := clabutils.GetNamedNetNS(\n\t\tclabutils.ParkingNetnsName(node.Config().LongName),\n\t)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, false\n\t}\n\n\treturn clablinks.NewParkingNode(node.Config().LongName, parkPath), true\n}\n\nfunc (c *CLab) applyKnownEndpointNames(\n\tplan *applyPlan,\n\tnodeName string,\n) map[string]struct{} {\n\tif !isApplySpecialNode(nodeName) {\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\n\tnames := map[string]struct{}{}\n\tfor key := range plan.desiredEndpointSet {\n\t\tif key.node == nodeName {\n\t\t\tnames[key.iface] = struct{}{}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\treturn names\n}\n\nfunc (c *CLab) applyEndpointDiscoveryNodes(plan *applyPlan) map[string]clablinks.Node {\n\tnodes := make(map[string]clablinks.Node, len(c.Nodes)+2)\n\tfor nodeName, node := range c.Nodes {\n\t\tnodes[nodeName] = node\n\t}\n\n\tfor _, key := range sortedEndpointKeys(plan.desiredEndpointSet) {\n\t\tif _, exists := nodes[key.node]; exists {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tif node, exists := c.applyLinkNode(key.node); exists {\n\t\t\tnodes[key.node] = node\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\treturn nodes\n}\n\nfunc (c *CLab) applyLinkNode(nodeName string) (clablinks.Node, bool) {\n\tif node, exists := c.Nodes[nodeName]; exists {\n\t\treturn node, true\n\t}\n\tnode, exists := c.getSpecialLinkNodes()[nodeName]\n\treturn node, exists\n}\n\nfunc isApplySpecialNode(nodeName string) bool {\n\treturn nodeName == \"host\" || nodeName == \"mgmt-net\"\n}\n\nfunc (c *CLab) planAffectedApplyNode(\n\tctx context.Context,\n\tplan *applyPlan,\n\tnodeName string,\n\tchange string,\n) {\n\tif nodeName == \"\" {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif _, planned := plan.linkRestartNodeSet[nodeName]; planned {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif _, planned := plan.recreatedNodeSet[nodeName]; planned {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\n\tnode, exists := c.Nodes[nodeName]\n\tif !exists {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif plan.isExternallyManaged(nodeName) {\n\t\tlog.Info(\n\t\t\t\"Applying link change without node lifecycle action\",\n\t\t\t\"node\", nodeName,\n\t\t\t\"change\", change,\n\t\t\t\"externally-managed\", true,\n\t\t)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\n\toverridden := clabnodes.LinkApplyModeOverrideForNode(node) != \"\"\n\n\tswitch clabnodes.LinkApplyModeForNode(ctx, node) {\n\tcase clabnodes.LinkApplyModeLive:\n\t\tlog.Info(\n\t\t\t\"Applying link change without node lifecycle action\",\n\t\t\t\"node\",\n\t\t\tnodeName,\n\t\t\t\"change\",\n\t\t\tchange,\n\t\t)\n\tcase clabnodes.LinkApplyModeRestart:\n\t\tplan.linkRestartNodeSet[nodeName] = struct{}{}\n\t\tplan.nodeChangeReasons[nodeName] = change\n\t\tlog.Info(\"Node will be restarted to apply link change\", \"node\", nodeName, \"change\", change)\n\tcase clabnodes.LinkApplyModeRecreate:\n\t\tplan.recreatedNodeSet[nodeName] = struct{}{}\n\t\tdelete(plan.restartNodeSet, nodeName)\n\t\tdelete(plan.linkRestartNodeSet, nodeName)\n\t\tplan.nodeChangeReasons[nodeName] = change\n\n\t\tif overridden {\n\t\t\tlog.Info(\"Node will be recreated to apply link change\",\n\t\t\t\t\"node\", nodeName, \"change\", change, \"link-apply-mode\", \"recreate\")\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tlog.Info(\n\t\t\t\t\"Node will be recreated to apply link change since its kind does not declare \"+\n\t\t\t\t\t\"live link support; if the NOS detects hot-plugged interfaces, set \"+\n\t\t\t\t\t\"link-apply-mode: live on the node to avoid the recreation\",\n\t\t\t\t\"node\", nodeName,\n\t\t\t\t\"change\", change,\n\t\t\t)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (c *CLab) resolveNodeConfigFromTopology(\n\ttopo *clabtypes.Topology,\n\tnodeName string,\n) *clabtypes.NodeConfig {\n\tif topo == nil {\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\tif topo.GetNodeKind(nodeName) == clabnodestailscale.KindName &&\n\t\ttopo.GetNodeLabels(nodeName)[clabconstants.InternalNode] == \"true\" {\n\t\ttopo = &clabtypes.Topology{Nodes: map[string]*clabtypes.NodeDefinition{\n\t\t\tnodeName: topo.Nodes[nodeName],\n\t\t}}\n\t}\n\n\tbinds, _ := topo.GetNodeBinds(nodeName)\n\tportSet, _, _ := topo.GetNodePorts(nodeName)\n\tkind := topo.GetNodeKind(nodeName)\n\tprivileged := topo.GetNodePrivileged(\n\t\tnodeName,\n\t\tc.privilegedByDefault(strings.ToLower(kind)),\n\t)\n\n\tnodeCfg := &clabtypes.NodeConfig{\n\t\tShortName:    nodeName,\n\t\tHostname:     topo.GetNodeHostname(nodeName),\n\t\tKind:         kind,\n\t\tNodeType:     topo.GetNodeType(nodeName),\n\t\tImage:        topo.GetNodeImage(nodeName),\n\t\tEntrypoint:   topo.GetNodeEntrypoint(nodeName),\n\t\tCmd:          topo.GetNodeCmd(nodeName),\n\t\tExec:         topo.GetNodeExec(nodeName),\n\t\tEnv:          topo.GetNodeEnv(nodeName),\n\t\tBinds:        binds,\n\t\tDevices:      topo.GetNodeDevices(nodeName),\n\t\tCapAdd:       topo.GetNodeCapAdd(nodeName),\n\t\tPrivileged:   privileged,\n\t\tCgroupnsMode: topo.GetNodeCgroupnsMode(nodeName),\n\t\tCgroupParent: topo.GetNodeCgroupParent(nodeName),\n\t\tPidMode:      topo.GetNodePidMode(nodeName),\n\t\tTmpfs:        topo.GetNodeTmpfs(nodeName),\n\t\tSecurityOpts: topo.GetNodeSecurityOpts(nodeName),\n\t\tShmSize:      topo.GetNodeShmSize(nodeName),\n\t\tPortSet:      portSet,\n\t\tUser:         topo.GetNodeUser(nodeName),\n\t\tNetworkMode:  topo.GetNodeNetworkMode(nodeName),\n\t\tMgmtNet:      topo.GetNodeMgmtNet(nodeName),\n\t\tRuntime:      topo.GetNodeRuntime(nodeName),\n\t\tCPU:          topo.GetNodeCPU(nodeName),\n\t\tCPUSet:       topo.GetNodeCPUSet(nodeName),\n\t\tMemory:       topo.GetNodeMemory(nodeName),\n\t\tLicense:      topo.GetNodeLicense(nodeName),\n\t}\n\n\tkindSpecificConfig, err := c.decodeKindSpecificConfig(topo, nodeName, strings.ToLower(kind))\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\t// A state file can hold keys a later release rejects; such a node counts as changed.\n\t\tkindSpecificConfig = clabnodes.InvalidKindSpecificConfig{Err: err.Error()}\n\t}\n\n\tnodeCfg.KindSpecificConfig = kindSpecificConfig\n\n\treturn nodeCfg\n}\n\nfunc (c *CLab) planNodeReconciliation(ctx context.Context, plan *applyPlan) error {\n\tif plan == nil || plan.currentNodes == nil {\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\n\tvar oldTopo *clabtypes.Topology\n\tif plan.state != nil {\n\t\toldTopo = plan.state.Topology\n\t}\n\n\tfor nodeName := range plan.currentNodes {\n\t\tnode, exists := c.Nodes[nodeName]\n\t\tif !exists {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tif _, added := plan.addedNodeSet[nodeName]; added {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\n\t\toldNodeConfig := c.resolveNodeConfigFromTopology(oldTopo, nodeName)\n\t\tnewNodeConfig := c.resolveNodeConfigFromTopology(c.Config.Topology, nodeName)\n\t\tdiff := node.ComputeDiff(oldNodeConfig, newNodeConfig)\n\t\tplan.nodeDiffs[nodeName] = diff\n\n\t\tresult, err := node.GetReconcilePlan(ctx, diff)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"reconcile planning failed for node %q: %w\", nodeName, err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif plan.isNonContainerNode(nodeName) && result.Action != clabtypes.TopologyDiffActionNone {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\n\t\t\t\t\"node %q is externally managed and cannot be %s for %s\",\n\t\t\t\tnodeName,\n\t\t\t\tresult.Action,\n\t\t\t\tconfigDriftReason(diff),\n\t\t\t)\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tswitch result.Action {\n\t\tcase clabtypes.TopologyDiffActionRestart:\n\t\t\tplan.restartNodeSet[nodeName] = struct{}{}\n\t\t\tplan.nodeChangeReasons[nodeName] = configDriftReason(diff)\n\t\tcase clabtypes.TopologyDiffActionRecreate:\n\t\t\tplan.recreatedNodeSet[nodeName] = struct{}{}\n\t\t\tplan.nodeChangeReasons[nodeName] = configDriftReason(diff)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\treturn nil\n}\n\nfunc configDriftReason(diff *clabtypes.TopologyDiff) string {\n\tif diff == nil || len(diff.Fields) == 0 {\n\t\treturn \"config drift\"\n\t}\n\n\treturn \"config drift: \" + strings.Join(diff.Fields, \", \")\n}\n\nfunc (c *CLab) reconcileNodes(ctx context.Context, plan *applyPlan) error {\n\tif plan == nil || plan.currentNodes == nil {\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\n\tfor nodeName := range plan.currentNodes {\n\t\tnode, exists := c.Nodes[nodeName]\n\t\tif !exists {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tif _, added := plan.addedNodeSet[nodeName]; added {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tif plan.isRootNamespaceNode(nodeName) {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\t// Recreated nodes are handled exclusively by the apply pipeline\n\t\t// (park -> delete -> deploy -> restore). Calling Reconcile here would\n\t\t// delete the container before parkRecreatedNodes can capture its\n\t\t// interfaces, breaking the recreate flow.\n\t\tif _, recreated := plan.recreatedNodeSet[nodeName]; recreated {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tdiff := plan.nodeDiffs[nodeName]\n\n\t\tresult, err := node.Reconcile(ctx, diff)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn 521: // mgmtNetworksForCleanup returns the management networks to delete on destroy:
522: // the topology-defined ones plus any network a previous deployment recorded in
523: // the lab state but that the current topology no longer defines. Without the
524: // state record a network dropped from the mgmt list would never be removed.
525: func (c *CLab) mgmtNetworksForCleanup() clabtypes.MgmtNetworks {
526: 	networks := c.allMgmtNetworks()
527: 
528: 	state, err := c.LoadState()
529: 	if err != nil {
530: 		log.Warn("Unable to load the management networks recorded in the lab state", "error", err)
531: 		return networks
532: 	}
533: 	if state == nil {
534: 		return networks
535: 	}
536: 
537: 	defined := make(map[string]bool, len(networks))
538: 	for _, m := range networks {
539: 		defined[m.Network] = true
540: 	}
541: 	for _, name := range state.MgmtNetworks {
542: 		if defined[name] {
543: 			continue
544: 		}
545: 		defined[name] = true
546: 		// ExternalAccess mirrors the default every management network gets, so
547: 		// the forwarding rule installed for the network is cleaned up too.
548: 		networks = append(networks, &clabtypes.MgmtNet{
549: 			Network:        name,
550: 			ExternalAccess: new(true),
551: 		})
552: 	}
553: 
554: 	return networks
555: }

557: func (c *CLab) deleteApplyNodes(ctx context.Context, plan *applyPlan) error {
558: 	nodeNames := make([]string, 0, len(plan.deletedNodeSet)+len(plan.recreatedNodeSet))
559: 	for nodeName := range plan.deletedNodeSet {
560: 		nodeNames = append(nodeNames, nodeName)
561: 	}
562: 	for nodeName := range plan.recreatedNodeSet {
563: 		nodeNames = append(nodeNames, nodeName)
564: 	}
565: 	sort.Strings(nodeNames)
566: 
567: 	hookNodes := make([]clabnodes.Node, 0, len(nodeNames))
568: 	var tailscaleContainers []clabruntime.GenericContainer
569: 	for _, nodeName := range nodeNames {
570: 		runtimeNode := plan.currentNodes[nodeName]
571: 		if runtimeNode == nil {
572: 			return fmt.Errorf("runtime node %q not found", nodeName)
573: 		}
574: 		if runtimeNode.external || runtimeNode.rootNamespaceBased {
575: 			continue
576: 		}
577: 		if len(runtimeNode.containers) > 0 &&
578: 			runtimeNode.containers[0].Labels[clabconstants.NodeKind] == clabnodestailscale.KindName {
579: 			tailscaleContainers = append(tailscaleContainers, runtimeNode.containers...)
580: 			continue
581: 		}
582: 		if node, ok := c.Nodes[nodeName]; ok {
583: 			hookNodes = append(hookNodes, node)
584: 		}
585: 	}
586: 	var logoutWg sync.WaitGroup
587: 	for _, ctr := range tailscaleContainers {
588: 		logoutWg.Go(func() { c.logoutTailscaleContainer(ctx, ctr) })
589: 	}
590: 	c.preDestroyNodes(ctx, hookNodes, 0)
591: 	logoutWg.Wait()
592: 
593: 	for _, nodeName := range nodeNames {
594: 		runtimeNode := plan.currentNodes[nodeName]
595: 		if runtimeNode.external || runtimeNode.rootNamespaceBased {
596: 			continue
597: 		}
598: 
599: 		for i := len(runtimeNode.containers) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
600: 			ctr := runtimeNode.containers[i]

602: 				return fmt.Errorf("runtime container for node %q has no name", nodeName)
603: 			}
604: 
605: 			runtime := ctr.Runtime
606: 			if runtime == nil {
607: 				runtime = c.globalRuntime()
608: 			}
609: 
610: 			action := "Deleting node"
611: 			if _, recreate := plan.recreatedNodeSet[nodeName]; recreate {
612: 				action = "Deleting node for recreate"
613: 			}
614: 			log.Info(action, "node", nodeName, "container", ctr.Names[0])
615: 			if err := runtime.DeleteContainer(ctx, ctr.Names[0]); err != nil {
616: 				return fmt.Errorf("failed deleting node %q: %w", nodeName, err)
617: 			}
618: 
619: 			_ = clabutils.DeleteNetnsSymlink(ctr.Names[0])
620: 		}
621: 	}
622: 
623: 	return nil
624: }

Reasoning
Confirmed:
- `deleteApplyNodes` iterates `for i := len(...)-1; i >= 0; i--` per group — reverse of the internal-first sort → internal (holder) container deleted last. Consistent with the new test.
- `GetContainer` uses exact name match (`^%s$`) → `processNetworkMode` resolving `container:<holder-short>` via SplitN produces full holder name `clab-<lab>-srl1-netns`... wait: `contName = SplitN(node.LongName, node.ShortName, 2)[0] + netMode[1]`. node.LongName = `clab-<lab>-srl1`, node.ShortName = `srl1` → SplitN → ["clab-<lab>-" , ""] → prefix "clab-<lab>-" + "srl1-netns" = `clab-<lab>-srl1-netns` — correct.

Now, one important issue: user-defined network-mode like `network-mode: container:srl1` for another node pointing at the srl node — `processNetworkMode` resolves it as `clab-<lab>-srl1` (the srl container), fine. But `checkApplyNetworkModeTargets`/`planNetworkModeCascade`: if the srl node is recreated, dependents with `network-mode: container:srl1` get recreated too — but the srl container is recreated in the holder's netns which survives, so actually the dependent could stay alive... but conservative recreate is fine.

More interesting: does the srl node's own NetworkMode get set in Cfg to `container:srl1-netns`? Yes — srl.containerConfig sets `c.NetworkMode = fmt.Sprintf("container:%s", n.netnsNode.GetShortName())`. This Cfg.NetworkMode is what the runtime sees AND what `networkModeContainerTarget` sees in apply! That means:

- `checkApplyNetworkModeTargets`: target = "srl1-netns". Is "srl1-netns" in `plan.deletedNodeSet`? deletedNodeSet is built from `currentNodes` (runtime groups keyed by group name = RootNodeName "srl1") minus c.Nodes. Group name for the holder = RootNodeName label = "srl1", NOT "srl1-netns". So "srl1-netns" never appears in currentNodes → deletedNodeSet. So no false error. Good.

- `planNetworkModeCascade`: dependents map: `dependents["srl1-netns"] = ["srl1"]`. If srl1 is being recreated, queue contains "srl1"... dependents["srl1"] — for other nodes referencing `container:srl1` explicitly, they'd be recreated. dependents["srl1-netns"] is only reached if some node's NetworkMode is `container:srl1-netns` — that's only srl1 itself. So no cascade loop. Fine. But wait: does the internal cascade accidentally recreate srl1 because of its own NetworkMode? The dependent lookup is by target name "srl1-netns", and only srl1 has that target. When srl1 is recreated, dependents["srl1"]... hmm, dependents built from `node.Config().NetworkMode` — srl1's Cfg.NetworkMode after Init is `container:srl1-netns`. So dependents["srl1-netns"] = ["srl1"]. RecreatedNodeSet contains "srl1" → queue=["srl1"] → dependents["srl1"] = nil → no work. Good, no infinite recursion.

- `networkModeNodeOrder` / dependency manager: `createNamespaceSharingDependency` and deploy ordering use NetworkMode targets. For deployNodes (fresh deploy), the srl node's NetworkMode = "container:srl1-netns" and target "srl1-netns" is not a node in c.Nodes! Let me check `networkModeNodeOrder` and `waitForNodeDeployTarget`: `target = networkModeContainerTarget(...)` → "srl1-netns"; if target not in nodeNames → probably treated as no dependency. And `createNamespaceSharingDependency` — need to check it doesn't fail when target is not a node.

Let me check deploy.go networkModeNodeOrder and createNamespaceSharingDependency.

1: package core

3: import "fmt"
4: 
5: // networkModeNodeOrder orders selected nodes before their namespace dependents.
6: // References outside the selection are handled by the caller.
7: func (c *CLab) networkModeNodeOrder(nodeNames []string) ([]string, error) {
8: 	selected := make(map[string]struct{}, len(nodeNames))
9: 	for _, name := range nodeNames {
10: 		if _, exists := c.Nodes[name]; !exists {
11: 			return nil, fmt.Errorf("node %q not found", name)
12: 		}
13: 		if _, duplicate := selected[name]; duplicate {
14: 			return nil, fmt.Errorf("node %q selected more than once", name)
15: 		}
16: 		selected[name] = struct{}{}
17: 	}
18: 	dependents := make(map[string][]string)
19: 	order := make([]string, 0, len(nodeNames))
20: 	for _, name := range nodeNames {
21: 		target := networkModeContainerTarget(c.Nodes[name].Config().NetworkMode)
22: 		if _, internal := selected[target]; internal {
23: 			dependents[target] = append(dependents[target], name)
24: 		} else {
25: 			order = append(order, name)
26: 		}
27: 	}
28: 	for i := 0; i < len(order); i++ {
29: 		order = append(order, dependents[order[i]]...)
30: 	}
31: 	if len(order) != len(nodeNames) {
32: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("cyclic network-mode container dependencies")
33: 	}
34: 	return order, nil
35: }
36: 
37: // planNetworkModeRestarts rebinds dependents after their target's namespace
38: // changes. Link restarts happen after deployment, so even a freshly deployed
39: // dependent must restart after a target that is restarted for a link change.
40: func (c *CLab) planNetworkModeRestarts(plan *applyPlan) error {
41: 	order, err := c.networkModeNodeOrder(sortedNodeNames(c.Nodes))
42: 	if err != nil {
43: 		return err
44: 	}
45: 	for _, name := range order {
46: 		if _, restarting := plan.linkRestartNodeSet[name]; restarting {
47: 			continue
48: 		}
49: 		target := networkModeContainerTarget(c.Nodes[name].Config().NetworkMode)
50: 		_, earlyRestart := plan.restartNodeSet[target]
51: 		_, starting := plan.startNodeSet[target]
52: 		_, lateRestart := plan.linkRestartNodeSet[target]
53: 		if !earlyRestart && !starting && !lateRestart {
54: 			continue
55: 		}
56: 		if !lateRestart {
57: 			if _, starting := plan.startNodeSet[name]; starting {
58: 				continue
59: 			}
60: 			if _, added := plan.addedNodeSet[name]; added {
61: 				continue
62: 			}
63: 			if _, recreated := plan.recreatedNodeSet[name]; recreated {
64: 				continue
65: 			}
66: 		}
67: 		plan.linkRestartNodeSet[name] = struct{}{}
68: 		reason := fmt.Sprintf("network-mode target %q restarted", target)
69: 		if previous := plan.nodeChangeReasons[name]; previous != "" {
70: 			reason = previous + "; " + reason
71: 		}
72: 		plan.nodeChangeReasons[name] = reason
73: 	}
74: 	return nil
75: }

This results in nodes with\n// static mgmt IP to be scheduled before dynamic ones.\nfunc (c *CLab) createStaticDynamicDependency() error {\n\tstaticIPNodes := make(map[string]*clabcoredependency_manager.DependencyNode)\n\tdynIPNodes := make(map[string]*clabcoredependency_manager.DependencyNode)\n\n\t// divide the nodes into static and dynamic mgmt IP nodes.\n\tfor name, n := range c.dependencyManager.GetNodes() {\n\t\tif n.Config().MgmtIPv4Address != \"\" || n.Config().MgmtIPv6Address != \"\" {\n\t\t\tstaticIPNodes[name] = n\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tdynIPNodes[name] = n\n\t}\n\n\t// go through all the dynamic ip nodes\n\tfor _, dynNode := range dynIPNodes {\n\t\t// and add their wait group to the static nodes, while increasing the waitgroup\n\t\tfor _, staticNode := range staticIPNodes {\n\t\t\terr := staticNode.AddDepender(clabtypes.WaitForCreate, dynNode, clabtypes.WaitForCreate)\n\t\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\t\treturn err\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n",

Also `srl.containerConfig` sets NetworkMode on the srl node's Cfg — this Cfg is also persisted in the state file (state.json contains node configs?). If the state file stores Cfg with NetworkMode "container:srl1-netns", then on a later `destroy`, nothing breaks.

But there's a subtle interplay with **`linkNetns` re-application during apply**: if the srl node container is recreated (e.g., config drift), the new container is created with NetworkMode `container:srl1-netns` and its netns is the holder's existing netns. Then linkNetns sets netns symlink for the new container. Endpoints were parked/re-attached to holder netns via newNamespace sharing — actually on recreate, planParkedNodes → parking into node.GetNSPath() = holder netns path (via srl GetNSPath override). Wait — parking: `parkRecreatedNodes` calls node.ParkEndpoints? Let me check: ParkEndpoints uses d.parkingNode and interfaces — the interfaces live in the holder netns. Hmm, for srl with netnsNode, GetNSPath returns holder's netns path, so endpoints are parked from the holder's netns into the parking netns, then restored after new container starts. That works but loses nothing. Actually since holder netns persists across srl container recreation, parking isn't even necessary — but harmless. Hmm, wait: is it harmless? During recreate: park (interfaces moved from holder netns to parking netns) → delete srl container → deploy new srl container (holder netns reused) → restore endpoints into holder netns (via GetNSPath) → linkNetns rewrites symlink. Net effect equals original. OK.

But there's a wrinkle: `discoverLiveApplyEndpoints` — discovery of live interfaces uses `c.Nodes[nodeName]` as the discovery node → `DiscoverOwnedInterfacesFor(ctx, n, nodeName, known)` where n is the srl node → its netns = holder's netns (via GetNSPath) → discovered interfaces are those in the holder netns → keys (srl1, eth1). Good.

Now, potential issue: **`planStoppedNodes` + srl node status Stopped but holder Running**? With restart policy unless-stopped, if a user runs `docker stop clab-...-srl1`, the holder keeps running (its own unless-stopped policy is satisfied since it wasn't stopped). Then apply: srl1 status = Stopped → startNodeSet → node.Start → EnsureRunning: holder is Running → ok. Good.

In inventory/inspect, the srl container's network settings show its IP inside the shared netns (same as holder). OK.

**Potential issue: mgmt network termination / static IP uniqueness**: the holder and the srl node both carry the same MgmtIPv4Address in their Cfg, but only the holder's is enforced. Fine.

**`waitNodeHealthyIfAvailable`** after restart — srl has healthcheck? Fine.

662: +func (n *srl) Deploy(ctx context.Context, params *clabnodes.DeployParams) error {
663: +	if n.netnsNode == nil {
664: +		return n.DefaultNode.Deploy(ctx, params)
665: +	}
666: +
667: +	// network settings are finalized after Init, so the holder config is rebuilt here.
668: +	*n.netnsNode.Config() = *n.newNetnsConfig()
669: +	if err := n.netnsNode.Deploy(ctx, params); err != nil {
670: +		return fmt.Errorf("deploy network namespace node %q: %w", n.netnsNode.GetShortName(), err)
671: +	}
672: +
673: +	n.Cfg.Env[clabconstants.ClabEnvIntfs] = strconv.Itoa(len(n.GetEndpoints()))
674: +
675: +	cID, err := n.Runtime.CreateContainer(ctx, n.containerConfig())
676: +	if err != nil {
677: +		return err
678: +	}
679: +
680: +	if _, err := n.Runtime.StartContainer(ctx, cID, n); err != nil {
681: +		return err
682: +	}
683: +
684: +	if err := n.linkNetns(ctx); err != nil {
685: +		return err
686: +	}
687: +
688: +	n.SetState(clabnodesstate.Deployed)
689: +
690: +	return nil
691: +}

693: +func (n *srl) Start(ctx context.Context) error {
694: +	if n.netnsNode == nil {
695: +		return n.DefaultNode.Start(ctx)
696: +	}
697: +
698: +	if err := n.netnsNode.EnsureRunning(ctx, n.Cfg.ShortName); err != nil {
699: +		return err
700: +	}
701: +
702: +	if err := n.DefaultNode.Start(ctx); err != nil {
703: +		return err
704: +	}
705: +
706: +	return n.linkNetns(ctx)
707: +}
708: +
709: +// Stop also stops the holder, so that the next start gets a fresh network namespace without
710: +// interfaces left behind by the stopped SR Linux container.
711: +func (n *srl) Stop(ctx context.Context) error {
712: +	if err := n.DefaultNode.Stop(ctx); err != nil || n.netnsNode == nil {
713: +		return err
714: +	}
715: +
716: +	if n.netnsNode.GetContainerStatus(ctx) != clabruntime.Running {
717: +		return nil
718: +	}
719: +
720: +	return n.Runtime.StopContainer(ctx, n.netnsNode.Config().LongName, n.netnsNode.StopSignal)
721: +}
722: +
723: +func (n *srl) Delete(ctx context.Context) error {
724: +	if n.netnsNode == nil {
725: +		return n.DefaultNode.Delete(ctx)
726: +	}
727: +
728: +	return errors.Join(n.DefaultNode.Delete(ctx), n.netnsNode.Delete(ctx))
729: +}

731: +// GetContainers returns the SR Linux container with the network settings of the holder.
732: +// When only the holder exists, it is returned so that it is not orphaned on destroy.
733: +func (n *srl) GetContainers(ctx context.Context) ([]clabruntime.GenericContainer, error) {
734: +	cnts, err := n.DefaultNode.GetContainers(ctx)
735: +	if n.netnsNode == nil {
736: +		return cnts, err
737: +	}
738: +
739: +	if err != nil {
740: +		if errors.Is(err, clabnodes.ErrContainersNotFound) {
741: +			return n.netnsNode.GetContainers(ctx)
742: +		}
743: +
744: +		return nil, err
745: +	}
746: +
747: +	holder, err := n.netnsNode.GetContainers(ctx)
748: +	if err != nil {
749: +		if errors.Is(err, clabnodes.ErrContainersNotFound) {
750: +			return cnts, nil
751: +		}
752: +
753: +		return nil, err
754: +	}
755: +
756: +	cnts[0].NetworkName = holder[0].NetworkName
757: +	cnts[0].NetworkSettings = holder[0].NetworkSettings
758: +	cnts[0].Ports = holder[0].Ports
759: +
760: +	return cnts, nil
761: +}

116: @@ -464,10 +464,20 @@ Containerlab will configure the `netconf-mgmt` ssh server running over port 830
117:  SR Linux container can run without a license emulating the datacenter types (7220 IXR) :partying_face:.  
118:  In that license-less mode, the datapath is limited to 1000 PPS and the `sr_linux` process will restart once a week.
119:  
120:  The license file lifts these limitations as well as unlocks chassis-based platform variants and a path to it can be provided with [`license`](../nodes.md#license) directive.
121:  
122: +### Reboot
123: +
124: +A reboot issued from within the node, for example with `tools platform chassis reboot`, restarts the SR Linux container. The node comes back with its links, saved configuration and management address intact.
125: +
126: +To support that, SR Linux nodes default to the `unless-stopped` [restart policy](../nodes.md#restart-policy), and containerlab keeps the links and the management address of each node in an internal `<node-name>-netns` container. The internal container is only listed by `containerlab inspect --all`, and it is removed together with the node.
127: +
128: +Use `containerlab stop`, `start` and `restart` to manage the lifecycle of SR Linux nodes instead of restarting the containers with the container runtime directly.
129: +
130: +Nodes with a user-defined [`network-mode`](../nodes.md#network-mode) do not use the internal container.
131: +
132:  ## Container configuration
133:  
134:  To start an SR Linux NOS containerlab uses the configuration that is described in SR Linux Software Installation Guide
135:

154: diff --git a/nodes/netns_holder.go b/nodes/netns_holder.go
155: new file mode 100644
156: index 0000000..7d1e9fd
157: --- /dev/null
158: +++ b/nodes/netns_holder.go
159: @@ -0,0 +1,52 @@
160: +package nodes
161: +
162: +import (
163: +	"context"
164: +	"fmt"
165: +
166: +	clabruntime "github.com/srl-labs/containerlab/runtime"
167: +	clabtypes "github.com/srl-labs/containerlab/types"
168: +)
169: +
170: +// NetnsHolder is an internal container that owns the network namespace of a node. The node's
171: +// containers join it, so the links and the management address outlive their restarts.
172: +type NetnsHolder struct {
173: +	DefaultNode
174: +}
175: +
176: +func (n *NetnsHolder) Init(cfg *clabtypes.NodeConfig, opts ...NodeOption) error {
177: +	n.DefaultNode = *NewDefaultNode(n)
178: +	n.Cfg = cfg
179: +	n.StopSignal = clabtypes.SIGTERM
180: +
181: +	for _, o := range opts {
182: +		o(n)
183: +	}
184: +
185: +	return nil
186: +}
187: +
188: +// EnsureRunning starts or unpauses the holder, so that the containers of node can join it.
189: +func (n *NetnsHolder) EnsureRunning(ctx context.Context, node string) error {
190: +	switch status := n.GetContainerStatus(ctx); status {
191: +	case clabruntime.Running:
192: +	case clabruntime.Created, clabruntime.Stopped:
193: +		if err := n.Start(ctx); err != nil {
194: +			return fmt.Errorf("node %q network namespace container start error: %w", node, err)
195: +		}
196: +	case clabruntime.Paused:
197: +		if err := n.Runtime.UnpauseContainer(ctx, n.Cfg.LongName); err != nil {
198: +			return fmt.Errorf("node %q network namespace container unpause error: %w", node, err)
199: +		}
200: +	case clabruntime.NotFound:
201: +		return fmt.Errorf(
202: +			"node %q network namespace container %q not found; recreate the node",
203: +			node, n.Cfg.LongName,
204: +		)
205: +	default:
206: +		return fmt.Errorf("node %q network namespace container %q is %s",
207: +			node, n.Cfg.LongName, status)
208: +	}
209: +
210: +	return nil
211: +}

216: +++ b/nodes/srl/netns.go
217: @@ -0,0 +1,132 @@
218: +package srl
219: +
220: +import (
221: +	"context"
222: +	"errors"
223: +	"maps"
224: +
225: +	clabconstants "github.com/srl-labs/containerlab/constants"
226: +	clabnodes "github.com/srl-labs/containerlab/nodes"
227: +	clabtypes "github.com/srl-labs/containerlab/types"
228: +	clabutils "github.com/srl-labs/containerlab/utils"
229: +)
230: +
231: +const netnsNodeType = "srl-netns"
232: +
233: +// usesNetnsNode reports whether the node runs in the network namespace of a holder container.
234: +// Nodes with a user-defined network mode keep the network namespace of their own container.
235: +func (n *srl) usesNetnsNode() bool {
236: +	return n.Cfg.NetworkMode == "" && !n.Cfg.IsRootNamespaceBased
237: +}
238: +
239: +func (n *srl) initNetnsNode() error {
240: +	if !n.usesNetnsNode() {
241: +		return nil
242: +	}
243: +
244: +	n.netnsNode = new(clabnodes.NetnsHolder)
245: +
246: +	return n.netnsNode.Init(n.newNetnsConfig(), clabnodes.WithRuntime(n.GetRuntime()))
247: +}
248: +
249: +func (n *srl) newNetnsConfig() *clabtypes.NodeConfig {
250: +	labels := maps.Clone(n.Cfg.Labels)
251: +
252: +	if labels == nil {
253: +		labels = map[string]string{}
254: +	}
255: +
256: +	shortName := n.Cfg.ShortName + "-netns"
257: +	labels[clabconstants.NodeName] = shortName
258: +
259: +	longName := n.Cfg.LongName + "-netns"
260: +	labels[clabconstants.LongName] = longName
261: +
262: +	labels[clabconstants.NodeType] = netnsNodeType
263: +	labels[clabconstants.InternalNode] = "true"
264: +
265: +	labels[clabconstants.RootNodeName] = n.Cfg.ShortName
266: +	labels[clabconstants.RootNodeLongName] = n.Cfg.LongName
267: +
268: +	return &clabtypes.NodeConfig{
269: +		ShortName:             shortName,
270: +		LongName:              longName,
271: +		Hostname:              n.Cfg.GetHostname(),
272: +		Fqdn:                  n.Cfg.Fqdn,
273: +		LabDir:                n.Cfg.LabDir,
274: +		Index:                 n.Cfg.Index,
275: +		Kind:                  n.Cfg.Kind,
276: +		NodeType:              netnsNodeType,
277: +		Image:                 n.Cfg.Image,
278: +		ImagePullPolicy:       n.Cfg.ImagePullPolicy,
279: +		RestartPolicy:         n.Cfg.RestartPolicy,
280: +		Sysctls:               maps.Clone(n.Cfg.Sysctls),
281: +		User:                  "0:0",
282: +		Entrypoint:            "/bin/sh",
283: +		Cmd:                   `-c "trap 'exit 0' TERM INT; sleep infinity & wait $!"`,
284: +		Env:                   map[string]string{},
285: +		PortBindings:          n.Cfg.PortBindings,
286: +		PortSet:               n.Cfg.PortSet,
287: +		MgmtNet:               n.Cfg.MgmtNet,
288: +		MgmtIntf:              n.Cfg.MgmtIntf,
289: +		MgmtIPv4Address:       n.Cfg.MgmtIPv4Address,
290: +		MgmtIPv4AddressAuto:   n.Cfg.MgmtIPv4AddressAuto,
291: +		MgmtIPv4PrefixLength:  n.Cfg.MgmtIPv4PrefixLength,
292: +		MgmtIPv6Address:       n.Cfg.MgmtIPv6Address,
293: +		MgmtIPv6AddressAuto:   n.Cfg.MgmtIPv6AddressAuto,
294: +		MgmtIPv6PrefixLength:  n.Cfg.MgmtIPv6PrefixLength,
295: +		MgmtIPv4Gateway:       n.Cfg.MgmtIPv4Gateway,
296: +		MgmtIPv6Gateway:       n.Cfg.MgmtIPv6Gateway,
297: +		MacAddress:            n.Cfg.MacAddress,
298: +		Aliases:               n.Cfg.Aliases,
299: +		DNS:                   n.Cfg.DNS,
300: +		ExtraHosts:            n.Cfg.ExtraHosts,
301: +		Labels:                labels,
302: +		Runtime:               n.Cfg.Runtime,
303: +		ResultingPortBindings: n.Cfg.ResultingPortBindings,
304: +	}
305: +}
306: +
307: +// containerConfig returns the config of the SR Linux container attached to the holder's
308: +// network namespace. The runtime rejects network settings for such containers, as they
309: +// belong to the holder.
310: +func (n *srl) containerConfig() *clabtypes.NodeConfig {
311: +	cfg := *n.Cfg
312: +	cfg.NetworkMode = "container:" + n.netnsNode.GetShortName()
313: +	cfg.DNS = nil
314: +	cfg.ExtraHosts = nil
315: +	cfg.MacAddress = ""
316: +	cfg.PortBindings = nil
317: +	cfg.PortSet = nil
318: +
319: +	return &cfg
320: +}
321: +
322: +// linkNetns points the node's netns symlink to the holder, as the namespace path of the
323: +// SR Linux container changes whenever the container restarts.
324: +func (n *srl) linkNetns(ctx context.Context) error {
325: +	nsPath, err := n.netnsNode.GetNSPath(ctx)
326: +	if err != nil {
327: +		return err
328: +	}
329: +
330: +	return clabutils.LinkContainerNS(nsPath, n.Cfg.LongName)
331: +}
332: +
333: +// GetNSPath retrieves the Namespace Path.
334: +func (n *srl) GetNSPath(ctx context.Context) (string, error) {
335: +	if n.netnsNode == nil {
336: +		return n.DefaultNode.GetNSPath(ctx)
337: +	}
338: +
339: +	return n.netnsNode.GetNSPath(ctx)
340: +}
341: +
342: +// DeleteNetnsSymlink deletes the symlink file created for the container netns.
343: +func (n *srl) DeleteNetnsSymlink() error {
344: +	if n.netnsNode == nil {
345: +		return n.DefaultNode.DeleteNetnsSymlink()
346: +	}
347: +
348: +	return errors.Join(n.DefaultNode.DeleteNetnsSymlink(), n.netnsNode.DeleteNetnsSymlink())
349: +}

The internal container is only listed by `containerlab inspect --all`, and it is removed together with the node.\n+\n+Use `containerlab stop`, `start` and `restart` to manage the lifecycle of SR Linux nodes instead of restarting the containers with the container runtime directly.\n+\n+Nodes with a user-defined [`network-mode`](../nodes.md#network-mode) do not use the internal container.\n+\n ## Container configuration\n \n To start an SR Linux NOS containerlab uses the configuration that is described in SR Linux Software Installation Guide\n \n /// tab | Startup command\ndiff --git a/docs/manual/nodes.md b/docs/manual/nodes.md\nindex f9b8ba3..d5c0171 100644\n--- a/docs/manual/nodes.md\n+++ b/docs/manual/nodes.md\n@@ -140,11 +140,11 @@ Valid values are:\n - `no` - Don't automatically restart the container.\n - `on-failure` - Restart the container if it exits due to an error, which manifests as a non-zero exit code. The on-failure policy only prompts a restart if the container exits with a failure. It doesn't restart the container if the daemon restarts.\n - `always` - Always restart the container if it stops. If it's manually stopped, it's restarted only when Docker daemon restarts or the container itself is manually restarted.\n - `unless-stopped` Similar to always, except that when the container is stopped (manually or otherwise), it isn't restarted even after Docker daemon restarts.\n \n-`no` is the default restart policy value for all kinds, but `linux`. Linux kind defaults to `always`.\n+`no` is the default restart policy value for all kinds, but `linux` and `nokia_srlinux`. 260: func (c *CLab) checkApplyTopologyDefinition(ctx context.Context) error {
261: 	params := *clablinks.NewVerifyLinkParams()
262: 	if len(c.Endpoints) > 0 {

264: 		if runtime == nil {
265: 			return fmt.Errorf("container runtime is not initialized")
266: 		}
267: 		config := runtime.Config()
268: 		if config.VerifyLinkParams != nil {
269: 			params = *config.VerifyLinkParams
270: 		}
271: 	}
272: 	params.AllowExistingEndpoint = true
273: 	if err := c.verifyLinks(ctx, &params); err != nil {
274: 		return err
275: 	}
276:

278: 		return err
279: 	}
280:

282: 		if err := c.Nodes[nodeName].CheckDeploymentConditions(ctx); err != nil {
283: 			return err
284: 		}
285: 	}
286:

288: 		return err
289: 	}
290: 
291: 	return c.verifyTailscaleProxy()
292: }

294: func (c *CLab) prepareApply(

318: func (*CLab) removeApplyLinkEndpoints(ctx context.Context, links []clablinks.Link) error {
319: 	for _, link := range links {

321: 			if err := clablinks.RemoveOwnedInterface(
322: 				ctx,
323: 				ep.GetNode(),
324: 				ep.GetIfaceName(),
325: 			); err != nil {
326: 				return err
327: 			}
328: 		}
329: 	}
330: 
331: 	return nil
332: }

334: // try to preserve the existing addressing instead of reallocation.
335: func (c *CLab) collectExistingManagementAddresses(
336: 	currentNodes map[string]*runtimeNodeGroup,
337: ) []clabtypes.ExistingAddress {
338: 	var existing []clabtypes.ExistingAddress
339: 	for name, group := range currentNodes {
340: 		for _, ctr := range group.containers {
341: 			if c.mgmtNetByNetwork(ctr.NetworkName).Network != ctr.NetworkName {
342: 				continue
343: 			}
344: 			for _, value := range []string{ctr.NetworkSettings.IPv4addr, ctr.NetworkSettings.IPv6addr} {
345: 				if ip, err := netip.ParseAddr(value); err == nil {
346: 					existing = append(
347: 						existing,
348: 						clabtypes.ExistingAddress{NodeName: name, ContainerID: ctr.ID, Address: ip},
349: 					)
350: 				}
351: 			}
352: 		}
353: 	}
354: 	return existing
355: }

Reasoning
`restartApplyNodes` calls `node.Stop` then `node.Start`. For srl with netnsNode: Stop parks endpoints into parking netns (from holder netns), stops node container, then stops holder. Start: EnsureRunning (starts holder, new netns), DefaultNode.Start (starts srl container which joins holder's new netns), linkNetns, then... wait — DefaultNode.Start calls `d.RestoreEndpoints(ctx)` — restores parked interfaces into `d.GetNSPath()` → holder's netns. Good. So links re-attached.

Hmm, but there's a subtlety in `parkRecreatedNodes` for a recreated srl node: ParkEndpoints captures interfaces from the holder netns into parking netns. Then `deleteApplyNodes` deletes both node and holder containers. Then `deployApplyNodes` → srl.Deploy: recreates holder, starts it, creates node container joined to new netns, linkNetns. Then `restoreRecreatedNodes` → RestoreEndpoints → RestoreTo(d) → moves interfaces into d.GetNSPath() = holder netns. Good.

But wait — for parked interface restore in the recreate flow, when the parking node restores, does it check interface ownership naming (eth1 → e1-1 mapping)? Existing machinery. Fine.

Now `cmd/restart.go` for the robot test (`clab restart -t ... --node srl1`): let me check what it does — probably stop then start via c.Stop/Start with node filters, or apply? Let me grep.
